title: Multi-Squad Coordination — Drive Several Groups to Different Objectives at Once

raw.realWorldMeaning: Multi-region task allocation under a shared deadline is not a planning problem here — the split is obvious. It tests whether the controller can actually drive several effector groups in parallel instead of completing one objective then the next, which serialized control fails to do in time.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Coordinated multi-robot fleet dispatch: a logistics swarm must place distinct sub-teams at separate depots within one delivery window; one-at-a-time control blows the schedule.
raw.author: openra-bench

summary.en: Multi-region task allocation under a shared deadline is not a planning problem here — the split is obvious. It tests whether the controller can actually drive several effector groups in parallel instead of completing one objective then the next, which serialized control fails to do in time.
summary.zh: 共享截止日期下的多区域任务分配在这里不是规划问题 - 划分是显而易见的。它测试控制器是否实际上可以并行驱动多个效应器组，而不是先完成一个目标然后再完成下一个目标，而串行控制无法及时做到这一点。

en:
Commander, this is a multi-region operation. You are given a tank column on the west edge: 3 medium tanks and 3 light tanks on hold-fire orders. Two enemy buildings sit on the far east of the map — a Construction Yard at the north-east corner and an Ore Refinery at the south-east. Bring at least 2 of your units to each building's vicinity within 2200 ticks.
WIN WHEN: get ≥2 units into region (44,4) r=6 AND get ≥2 units into region (44,34) r=6 AND before game tick 2200.
YOU LOSE IF: (your whole force is destroyed OR not before game tick 2201).
You have at most 30 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Commander, this is a three-region operation. You are given 3 medium tanks, 3 light tanks, and 2 jeeps on the west side, all on hold-fire orders. Three enemy buildings must each be reached: a Construction Yard in the north-east, an Ore Refinery in the south-east, and a Power Plant in the south-west. Small rifle-infantry pickets sit in the middle of the map at roughly mid-height. Bring at least 2 of your units to each building's vicinity within 2800 ticks, holding losses to no more than two.
WIN WHEN: get ≥2 units into region (44,4) r=6 AND get ≥2 units into region (12,36) r=6 AND get ≥2 units into region (44,34) r=6 AND before game tick 2800 AND lose ≤2 of your own units.
YOU LOSE IF: (your whole force is destroyed OR not before game tick 2801).
You have at most 36 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Commander, this is a three-region operation with no exact coordinates given. You are given 3 medium tanks, 3 light tanks, and 2 jeeps on the west side, all on hold-fire orders. Three enemy buildings must each be reached, each labelled by direction only: an enemy Construction Yard in the north-east, an enemy Power Plant in the south-west, and an enemy Ore Refinery in the south-east. The moment one of your units sights a target, an interrupt will reveal its exact location. Bring at least 2 of your units to each building's vicinity within 3300 ticks, holding losses to no more than two.
WIN WHEN: get ≥2 units into the enemy Construction Yard (fact) in the NORTH-EAST AND get ≥2 units into the enemy Power Plant (powr) in the SOUTH-WEST (bottom-left) AND get ≥2 units into the enemy Ore Refinery (proc) in the SOUTH-EAST AND before game tick 3300 AND lose ≤2 of your own units.
YOU LOSE IF: (your whole force is destroyed OR not before game tick 3301).
You have at most 42 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.
zh:
指挥官，这是一次多区域行动。西边有一个坦克纵队：3 辆中型坦克和 3 辆轻型坦克，按停火命令。两座敌方建筑位于地图的远东——东北角有一个建筑场，东南角有一个矿石精炼厂。在 2200 秒内将至少 2 个单位带到每栋建筑物附近。
胜利条件：将 ≥2 个单位放入区域 (44,4) r=6 并且将 ≥2 个单位放入区域 (44,34) r=6 并且在游戏刻 2200 之前。
失败条件：（你的整个部队都被摧毁了，或者在游戏刻 2201 之前没有被摧毁）。
您最多有 30 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

指挥官，这是一次三区域行动。西侧有 3 辆中型坦克、3 辆轻型坦克和 2 辆吉普车，全部处于停火命令。必须到达三座敌方建筑：东北部的建筑场、东南部的矿石精炼厂和西南部的发电厂。小型步枪步兵纠察队位于地图中部，大约中等高度。在 2800 个刻度内将至少 2 个单位带到每栋建筑物附近，将损失控制在不超过 2 个。
胜利条件：将 ≥2 个单位放入区域 (44,4) r=6 并且将 ≥2 个单位放入区域 (12,36) r=6 并且将 ≥2 个单位放入区域 (44,34) r=6 并且在游戏刻 2800 之前并且失去 ≤2 个自己的单位。
失败条件：（你的整个部队都被摧毁了，或者在游戏刻 2801 之前没有被摧毁）。
您最多有 36 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

指挥官，这是一次三区域行动，没有给出确切的坐标。西侧有 3 辆中型坦克、3 辆轻型坦克和 2 辆吉普车，全部处于停火命令。必须分别到达三座敌方建筑，每座建筑仅标有方向：东北方的敌方建筑场、西南方的敌方发电厂和东南方的敌方矿石精炼厂。当你的一个单位发现目标时，中断将显示其确切位置。在 3300 秒内将至少 2 个单位带到每栋建筑物附近，将损失控制在不超过 2 个。
胜利条件：让 ≥2 个单位进入东北方向的敌方建筑场（事实），并让 ≥2 个单位进入西南（左下）的敌方发电厂（powr），并让 ≥2 个单位进入东南方向的敌方矿石精炼厂（proc），并且在游戏刻 3300 之前，损失 ≤2 个己方单位。
失败条件：（你的整个部队都被摧毁了，或者在游戏刻 3301 之前没有被摧毁）。
你最多有 42 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

title: Non-Stop Ordered Route Execution — Run Given Waypoints In Order Without Stalling

raw.realWorldMeaning: The route is already planned; the open problem is faithful, non-stalling execution of an ORDERED objective sequence — reaching each waypoint in turn and issuing the next move the instant a leg completes, rather than idling, re-deliberating, skipping a waypoint, or rushing straight to the end.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Manipulator / mobile-base task sequencing: a robot must hit a fixed ORDERED set of stations (pick → transit → place) within a cycle-time budget; pausing, reordering, or skipping a station misses the takt.
raw.author: openra-bench

summary.en: The route is already planned; the open problem is faithful, non-stalling execution of an ORDERED objective sequence — reaching each waypoint in turn and issuing the next move the instant a leg completes, rather than idling, re-deliberating, skipping a waypoint, or rushing straight to the end.
summary.zh: 路线已经规划好；悬而未决的问题是忠实、不间断地执行有序的目标序列——依次到达每个航路点，并在一条腿完成后立即发出下一步行动，而不是闲置、重新考虑、跳过航路点或直接冲向终点。

en:
Commander, this is an ordered patrol mission. You are given 2 medium tanks and 2 light tanks on the west edge, on hold-fire orders. A three-stop ordered route through enemy territory has been plotted: an enemy Power Plant in the mid-south first, then an Ore Refinery in the north, then a Construction Yard in the far south-east. The waypoints must be visited in that order within 2400 ticks.
WIN WHEN: reach these waypoints IN ORDER (no skipping, no idling): region (16,24) r=3 → then → region (32,6) r=3 → then → region (44,28) r=3 AND before game tick 2400.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 2401 OR your whole force is destroyed).
You have at most 30 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Commander, this is a two-column ordered patrol. You are given one north column (2 medium tanks + 1 light tank) and one south column (2 light tanks + 1 jeep), all on hold-fire orders. Each column has its own ordered route, each waypoint marked by an enemy building. The north column's route runs north→south→north; the south column's route runs south→north→south. Both ordered routes must be completed within 3000 ticks, holding losses to one or fewer.
WIN WHEN: reach these waypoints IN ORDER (no skipping, no idling): region (16,8) r=3 → then → region (32,32) r=3 → then → region (44,8) r=3 AND reach these waypoints IN ORDER (no skipping, no idling): region (16,32) r=3 → then → region (32,8) r=3 → then → region (44,32) r=3 AND before game tick 3000 AND lose ≤1 of your own units.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 3001 OR NOT (lose ≤1 of your own units) OR your whole force is destroyed).
You have at most 36 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Commander, this is a long-range ordered patrol on a large 80x48 map. You are given two columns of 6 units each (2 medium tanks + 2 light tanks + 2 jeeps), one deployed far north and one far south, all on hold-fire orders. Each column must run a four-stop ordered route, with stops labelled by relative direction (north, centre, east, far corner). Coordinates are NOT given — each waypoint is an enemy building hidden in fog. When a unit sights one, an interrupt will reveal its exact location. Both ordered routes must be completed within 5000 ticks, holding losses to one or fewer.
WIN WHEN: reach these waypoints IN ORDER (no skipping, no idling): the far NORTH-WEST — western edge, northern band → then → the SOUTH-CENTRE — mid map left-to-right, southern band → then → the EAST side — eastern third, northern band → then → the far SOUTH-EAST corner — extreme east, extreme south AND reach these waypoints IN ORDER (no skipping, no idling): the far SOUTH-WEST — western edge, southern band → then → the NORTH-CENTRE — mid map left-to-right, northern band → then → the EAST side — eastern third, southern band → then → the far NORTH-EAST corner — extreme east, extreme north AND before game tick 5000 AND lose ≤1 of your own units.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 5001 OR NOT (lose ≤1 of your own units) OR your whole force is destroyed).
You have at most 70 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.
zh:
指挥官，这是命令巡逻任务。西边有 2 辆中型坦克和 2 辆轻型坦克，按停火命令。一条穿过敌方领土的三站有序路线已经被绘制出来：首先是中南部的敌方发电厂，然后是北部的矿石精炼厂，然后是东南部的建筑场。必须在 2400 个刻度内按该顺序访问航路点。
胜利条件：按顺序到达这些航路点（不跳过，不空转）：区域 (16,24) r=3 → 然后 → 区域 (32,6) r=3 → 然后 → 区域 (44,28) r=3 并且在游戏刻 2400 之前。
失败条件：（不是在游戏刻 2401 之前或你的整个部队被摧毁之前）。
您最多有 30 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

指挥官，这是两纵队的有序巡逻。您将获得一支北纵队（2 辆中型坦克 + 1 辆轻型坦克）和一支南纵队（2 辆轻型坦克 + 1 辆吉普车），全部执行暂停开火命令。每个纵队都有自己的有序路线，每个路径点都由敌方建筑物标记。北纵队的路线为北→南→北；南纵队的路线为南→北→南。两条订购的路线必须在 3000 个刻度内完成，将损失控制在 1 或更少。
胜利条件：按顺序到达这些航点（无跳跃，无空转）：区域 (16,8) r=3 → 然后 → 区域 (32,32) r=3 → 然后 → 区域 (44,8) r=3 并按顺序到达这些航点（无跳跃，无空转）：区域 (16,32) r=3 → 然后 → 区域 (32,8) r=3 → 然后 → 区域 (44,32) r=3 并且在游戏开始前3000 并损失 ≤1 个自己的单位。
失败条件：（不在游戏刻 3001 之前，否则（损失 ≤1 个自己的单位）或你的整个部队被摧毁）。
您最多有 36 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

指挥官，这是在 80x48 的大地图上进行的远程有序巡逻。你有两列，每列有 6 辆坦克（2 辆中型坦克 + 2 辆轻型坦克 + 2 辆吉普车），一队部署在远北地区，一队部署在远南地区，全部执行暂停开火命令。每列必须运行四站有序路线，并按相对方向（北、中、东、远角）标记站点。没有给出坐标——每个路径点都是隐藏在雾中的敌方建筑。当一个单位发现一个时，中断将显示其确切位置。两条订购的路线必须在 5000 个刻度内完成，将损失控制在 1 或更少。
胜利条件：按顺序到达这些航路点（禁止跳跃、禁止空转）：最远的西北 — 西部边缘、北带 → 然后 → 中南部 — 地图中间从左到右、南带 → 然后 → 东侧 — 东部第三、北带 → 然后 → 最远的东南角 — 最东、最南 按顺序到达这些航路点（禁止跳跃、禁止空转）： 最远的西南 — 西边缘、南部带→然后→中北部 - 地图中间从左到右，北带→然后→东边 - 东部第三，南带→然后→远东北角 - 极东，极北并且在游戏前勾选5000并失去≤1个自己的单位。
失败条件：（不在游戏前勾选 5001 或不（损失 ≤1 个自己的单位）或你的整个部队被摧毁）。
您最多有 70 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

title: Asymmetric Underdog — 2 Mediums Must Beat a Stronger Garrison via Flank-Pick

raw.realWorldMeaning: Two medium tanks must inflict enough kills on a stronger enemy garrison (a wall of rifle infantry plus a heavy tank on medium and hard) to satisfy a kill bar — without losing the pair. Head-on combat is a decisive LOSS: the heavy out-trades the medium column at close range and the infantry wall holds the pair in place long enough for the heavy to close. The only winning play is asymmetric: stage off-axis, approach the infantry on a flank that keeps the mediums outside the heavy's aggro envelope, pick off the infantry one at a time from the flank, and retreat past the heavy's leash any time it lunges. The skill measured is weaker-side reasoning: which sub-target to commit to (the soft infantry, not the hard heavy), which approach vector keeps the column outside the strongest threat's fire envelope, and when to disengage before being fixed.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Asymmetric / guerrilla doctrine for a force-on-force multi-robot encounter: a numerically and qualitatively weaker team must refuse decisive engagement with the strongest opposing asset, exploit terrain and mobility advantages, and pick off weaker support assets piecemeal where the local force ratio is favourable. The decision under test is approach-vector planning (stay outside the strongest threat's effective radius) and sub-target prioritisation (engage soft targets, not hard ones).
raw.benchmarkAnchor: SC2 asymmetric, asymmetric warfare, guerrilla tactics
raw.author: openra-bench

title: Scout-then-Counter — Hard Counter Selection Across Seeded Enemy Compositions

raw.realWorldMeaning: A fixed budget funds EITHER an armoured fist (medium tanks), OR a rocket squad (anti-tank infantry), OR a rifle company. The enemy archetype ROTATES per seed across four compositions (rifle swarm / heavy tank column / rocket cluster / second rifle swarm), each demanding a DIFFERENT counter. Pre-committing to one composition LOSES on at least one seed. The capability under test is the observation-driven counter SELECTION loop: scout the enemy with the starter jeeps, infer the threat profile, then commit the whole budget to the matching counter. There is no dominant single build — the right answer depends on what the scout reveals.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Threat-driven procurement under uncertainty: a fixed capital budget funds anti-armour platforms OR anti-infantry platforms OR foot soldiers; telemetry from forward scouts must confirm the threat profile BEFORE the commit. Pre-committing to an anti-tank loadout against an infantry threat (or vice-versa) is a cost-per-effect waste that loses the engagement. The decision under test is the read-then-commit loop, not a single memorised build.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: SC2 hard-counter / scout-and-pivot doctrine, game-theoretic best response under composition uncertainty, military RPS (tank-vs-infantry / infantry-vs-rocket / rocket-vs-tank), capability-based defense procurement under uncertainty, PlanBench replanning on new observation
raw.author: openra-bench

title: 1v1 Combat Duel — Beat a Reactive Enemy at Close Range

raw.realWorldMeaning: A close-quarters force-on-force fight against an enemy that shoots back: the decision is combat micro — concentrate fire on one target, retreat damaged units, trade favourably. The enemy starts just to the east, in or near sight, so this is a DUEL, not a search (finding scattered enemies on a big map is tested separately). Difficulty escalates the opponent, not the search.

raw.benchmarkAnchor: SC2 unit micro, MicroRTS, adversarial multi-agent engagement
raw.author: openra-bench

title: The Long Way Round — Take a Costly Detour Because the Direct Path Is Lethal

raw.realWorldMeaning: 迂直之计 — "make the devious route the most direct." A LEASHED GUARD line (engine scripted bot 'guard') walls the short west→east lane to the objective: every guard auto-fires in range, lunges at any unit that comes within its aggro radius, and snaps back to post. Driving the column straight down that lane gets the whole force shot apart in a turn. The only winning policy abandons the short axis entirely — climb to the open flank, run the long way around the END of the wall, then turn in — a route whose progress toward the objective stays flat or dips for ~20 turns before it pays off. Tests temporal credit assignment over a long horizon against a greedy shortest-path / "just charge it" bias; idling never commits and loses on the clock.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Hazard-aware long-horizon routing: reject the locally optimal short path through a lethal interdiction zone for a circuitous survivable one (around the obstacle's flank) whose payoff is far delayed.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: military doctrine, ARC spatial reasoning, hazard-aware long-horizon routing
raw.author: openra-bench

summary.en: 迂直之计 — "make the devious route the most direct." A LEASHED GUARD line (engine scripted bot 'guard') walls the short west→east lane to the objective: every guard auto-fires in range, lunges at any unit that comes within its aggro radius, and snaps back to post. Driving the column straight down that lane gets the whole force shot apart in a turn. The only winning policy abandons the short axis entirely — climb to the open flank, run the long way around the END of the wall, then turn in — a route whose progress toward the objective stays flat or dips for ~20 turns before it pays off. Tests temporal credit assignment over a long horizon against a greedy shortest-path / "just charge it" bias; idling never commits and loses on the clock.
summary.zh: 迂直之计——“让迂回的路线成为最直接的”。一条被拴住的守卫线（引擎编写的机器人“守卫”）围住了通往目标的短西→东车道：每个守卫都会在射程内自动射击，冲向其仇恨半径内的任何单位，然后迅速返回岗位。沿着那条车道笔直驾驶纵队，整个部队在转弯时就会被击散。唯一获胜的策略是完全放弃短轴——爬到开放的侧翼，绕着墙的尽头跑很长一段路，然后转向——这条路线在实现目标之前会保持平坦或下降约 20 个转弯，然后才会得到回报。针对贪婪的最短路径/“只收取费用”偏差，在长期范围内测试时间信用分配；空转永远不会发生并且会丢失时间。

title: Lure the Tiger Off the Mountain — Pull the Strong Defender Off the Lane, Then Run the Main Force Past It

raw.realWorldMeaning: 调虎离山 — "lure the tiger off the mountain." A STRONG leashed GUARD line (engine scripted bot 'guard') walls the only lane to the objective: every guard holds its post, auto-fires anything in range, lunges at the nearest foe within its aggro radius, and snaps straight back to its post the instant nothing threatens it. Driving the durable main body straight down the lane runs it into the full line (anti-tank rockets) and it is shot apart before it gets through. The only winning policy commits the fast bait on a DIVERGENT vector that comes just close enough to the line to make a segment of it lunge OUT after the bait — off the lane, toward its leash — then, in that transient window while the tiger is off the mountain, runs the main body through the briefly-open slot to the far objective before the line snaps back. Phase 1 (pulling the tiger off) yields ZERO objective progress and looks locally negative (the bait draws all the fire); only phase 2, through the vacated slot, scores. The distinction from decoy-sacrifice: here the credit problem is DISPLACE-AND-EXPLOIT — the bait must lure the defender off and the main force must exploit the *reversible* vacancy in time; preserving the force is what is rewarded, not spending a sacrificial decoy. Greedy "just charge the lane" and "do nothing" both fail; a bait that never gets close enough never displaces the tiger.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Two-phase manipulation against a reactive guarding obstacle: a no-reward enabling action (entice a leashed interceptor off the only corridor with a decoy on a divergent vector) must precede and temporally overlap the rewarded objective action (run the payload through the briefly-cleared corridor before the interceptor snaps back).
raw.benchmarkAnchor: military doctrine, SC2 unit micro, multi-phase deception maneuver
raw.author: openra-bench

The only winning policy commits the fast bait on a DIVERGENT vector that comes just close enough to the line to make a segment of it lunge OUT after the bait — off the lane, toward its leash — then, in that transient window while the tiger is off the mountain, runs the main body through the briefly-open slot to the far objective before the line snaps back. The distinction from decoy-sacrifice: here the credit problem is DISPLACE-AND-EXPLOIT — the bait must lure the defender off and the main force must exploit the *reversible* vacancy in time; preserving the force is what is rewarded, not spending a sacrificial decoy. Greedy "just charge the lane" and "do nothing" both fail; a bait that never gets close enough never displaces the tiger.
summary.zh: 调虎离山——“引虎下山”。一条强有力的拴着的守卫线（引擎编写的机器人“守卫”）围住了通往目标的唯一通道：每个守卫都坚守自己的岗位，自动射击范围内的任何东西，向其仇恨半径内最近的敌人猛冲，并在没有任何威胁时立即迅速回到自己的岗位。沿着车道直线驾驶耐用的主体，使其进入整线（反坦克火箭），并在通过之前被击碎。唯一获胜的策略是将快速诱饵投入到一个发散向量上，该向量距离线足够近，使其一部分在诱饵后猛冲出去——离开车道，朝向它的皮带——然后，在老虎离开山的短暂窗口中，在线弹回之前，将主体穿过短暂打开的槽到达远处的目标。第一阶段（把老虎拉走）的目标进展为零，并且局部看起来是负面的（诱饵吸引了所有的火力）；只有第2阶段，通过空出的槽位，得分。与诱饵牺牲的区别：这里的信用问题是排位和利用——诱饵必须引诱防守者，而主力必须及时利用“可逆转”的空缺；保留力量才是回报，而不是牺牲诱饵。贪婪的“只冲线”和“什么都不做”都会失败；永远不够接近的诱饵永远无法取代老虎。

title: Staged Assault — Reach the Waypoints In Order, Then Seize the Citadel

raw.realWorldMeaning: 攻其無備 — strike where unprepared, but only after the prerequisite moves. The mission is a STRICT ordered sub-goal chain: stage at A, then transit B, then seize the citadel C — and only after a deliberate hold (the strike is timed, not rushed). Reward lands only at C; A and B are unrewarded prerequisites whose ORDER is enforced (reaching C without having passed A then B counts for nothing). Long-horizon sub-goal sequencing with delayed terminal credit; a greedy beeline to C, or idling, fails.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Ordered multi-waypoint mission (stage → transit → objective) where only terminal success is rewarded, step order is hard-enforced (not merely graded), and the terminal action must wait out a hold — the Blocksworld/GAIA-style long-horizon plan.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: military doctrine, PlanBench, long-horizon sub-goal sequencing
raw.author: openra-bench

title: Defense Topology — Skirt the Building with a Pillbox in Every Corner

raw.realWorldMeaning: A single high-value building (the construction yard — your construction yard) sits at the centre of the map and is rushed CONCURRENTLY from all four diagonal corners (NE, NW, SE, SW). Right doctrine: a SKIRT of pillboxes — one planted in EACH of the four corner approaches — so every diagonal axis has its own overlapping field of fire. Wrong doctrine: massing every pillbox on a single corner; that satisfies a naive "we built four defences" count and holds one corner, but the three uncovered corner waves stride untouched into the construction yard and raze it. The win predicate makes the topology load-bearing: total pillbox count is not enough — one pillbox must sit inside a radius-4 disc in EVERY corner region, the pillboxes must KILL the rush, AND the construction yard must survive.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Distributed defense / quadrant coverage: when one central asset is threatened from all bearings, finite defensive capacity must be matched to the cardinality of the threat axes — a strongpoint in every quadrant — not massed on the loudest single approach. The same logic as air-defence sector coverage or a multi-front perimeter: an uncovered sector is an open envelopment lane no matter how heavily the others are defended.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: MicroRTS pillbox placement, distributed defense, military quadrant doctrine
raw.author: openra-bench

summary.en: A single high-value building (the construction yard — your construction yard) sits at the centre of the map and is rushed CONCURRENTLY from all four diagonal corners (NE, NW, SE, SW). Right doctrine: a SKIRT of pillboxes — one planted in EACH of the four corner approaches — so every diagonal axis has its own overlapping field of fire. Wrong doctrine: massing every pillbox on a single corner; that satisfies a naive "we built four defences" count and holds one corner, but the three uncovered corner waves stride untouched into the construction yard and raze it. The win predicate makes the topology load-bearing: total pillbox count is not enough — one pillbox must sit inside a radius-4 disc in EVERY corner region, the pillboxes must KILL the rush, AND the construction yard must survive.
summary.zh: 一个高价值建筑物（施工场地 - 你的施工场地）位于地图的中心，并从所有四个对角（东北、西北、东南、西南）同时冲向。正确的原则：碉堡的裙边——四个角落的每个角落都有一个——所以每个对角轴都有自己重叠的火力场。错误的原则：将每个碉堡集中在一个角落；这满足了一种天真的“我们建造了四道防御工事”的计数并占据了一个角落，但三个未覆盖的角落波浪毫发无伤地大步走进施工场地并将其夷为平地。获胜谓词使拓扑具有承重性：碉堡总数不够——每个角落区域必须有一个碉堡位于半径 4 的圆盘内，碉堡必须杀死冲锋，并且施工场地必须幸存。

en:
Four rifle bands will rush your central construction yard from all four diagonal corners at once. Budget $2400. Drop a pillbox inside each corner disc (NE, NW, SE, SW) to shred its incoming wave. Keep the yard standing and put down at least nine attackers within about 60 turns.
WIN WHEN: own ≥4 'pbox' building(s) AND have 1 building(s) near (82,9) AND have 1 building(s) near (46,9) AND have 1 building(s) near (82,31) AND have 1 building(s) near (46,31) AND own ≥1 'fact' building(s) AND destroy ≥9 enemy units AND before game tick 5400.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 5401 OR NOT (own ≥1 'fact' building(s))).
You have at most 60 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Same four-corner rush, but now each band fields four riflemen — sixteen attackers in total. Budget $2400. A pillbox in each corner disc (NE, NW, SE, SW) is the only layout that holds; massing on a single corner leaves three lanes open. Keep the yard alive and kill at least thirteen, within about 60 turns.

title: Defense Topology — Cluster Pillboxes Around the High-Value Building

raw.realWorldMeaning: A single high-value building (the construction yard — your construction yard) is the protected asset, and a concentrated enemy band funnelled through a single narrow corridor charges directly at it. Right doctrine: a TIGHT CLUSTER of pillboxes WRAPPING the construction yard, overlapping fields of fire on the single point that matters. Wrong doctrine: a thin LINE of pillboxes strung between the construction yard and the corridor mouth — the line satisfies a naive "we built N defences" count but cannot stop a focused rush from reaching the construction yard, because the firepower is too dispersed to mass on the threat. The win predicate makes the topology decision load-bearing: total pillbox count alone is not enough; ≥3 of the pillboxes must sit INSIDE the radius-4 disc around the construction yard, AND the construction yard must survive.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Critical-asset protection / defense-in-depth: when ONE node is the irreplaceable principal (the fortress keep, the SAM hub, the data-centre hardened core, the ambassador's residence), the right architecture is dense overlapping enforcement AT that asset, not a thin uniform perimeter that is everywhere but never massed where the threat actually comes. The same logic that gives you a single hardened crypto module behind layered firewalls — concentrate coverage AT the asset, not a uniform spread.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: ERQA, military strongpoint, asset protection, defense-in-depth around critical infrastructure
raw.author: openra-bench

title: Build a Defensive Tower LINE Across a WIDE Front (Not a Cluster, Not a Scatter)

raw.realWorldMeaning: Where do you commit your defensive towers when the threat is a rush spread across the FULL WIDTH of the map — not pinched through a single corridor cell, but advancing on every row of a wide front? Military perimeter doctrine and firewall rule design both say: cover EVERY lane across the front, one post per row, so no enemy unit can slip past on an unguarded row. A single dense cluster on one row wastes overlapping fire on one cell while every other row stays open; a scatter near the base never engages the rush at all. The win predicate makes the LINE topology load-bearing — total pillbox count alone is not enough; ≥1 pillbox must sit on EACH of the front's rung rows (cell-exact via radius 0.5), AND those pillboxes must actually KILL the rush spread across the front.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Network firewall / Web Application Firewall rule placement: when every protocol/port could be the path of compromise, the right architecture is one rule per port across the full inspection surface, not three duplicated rules on one port while the rest stay open. Likewise a physical perimeter patrol covers EVERY approach lane across the front — a cluster at one waypoint or a scatter across unrelated nodes both leave the actual front lanes traversable. Defense in depth across a wide approach demands one responder per lane, not many responders at one waypoint.

A single dense cluster on one row wastes overlapping fire on one cell while every other row stays open; a scatter near the base never engages the rush at all. The win predicate makes the LINE topology load-bearing — total pillbox count alone is not enough; ≥1 pillbox must sit on EACH of the front's rung rows (cell-exact via radius 0.5), AND those pillboxes must actually KILL the rush spread across the front.

title: Build-Engineer: Rebuild Power Plant After Mid-Episode Loss

raw.realWorldMeaning: Reactive replan after exogenous loss of a critical-infrastructure building (the Power Plant) mid-episode. An ongoing operation has its power-grid building unexpectedly destroyed by an enemy strike in the opening; the agent inherits a complete production chain (Construction Yard + Refinery + Power Plant + War Factory + Ore Truck + ore patch) and a reserve cash budget; the deadline is real. The model must notice the destruction (the live building count for the Power Plant drops to zero), commit the reserve to rebuilding the Power Plant (not to army units, not to a different structure, not to nothing) AND place it adjacent to the surviving Construction Yard so production stays online — fast enough that the rebuild closes the happened-before latch before the deadline bites.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Disaster recovery after a critical-infrastructure node is destroyed by an external event mid-mission. The autonomous operator inherits a working processing site, a reserve allowance sufficient for exactly one replacement substation, and a strict operational deadline. Recovery requires identifying the lost asset, committing the reserve to rebuilding the same kind of asset (not to defenders, not to expansion, not to nothing), and siting it safely — close enough to the surviving site that the powered loads stay online, far enough from the lingering threat that the new asset survives.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: PlanBench replanning under exogenous loss, disaster recovery, exogenous loss, SC2 rebuild-after-trade

summary.zh: 关键基础设施建筑（发电厂）中期发生外源性损失后的反应性重新计划。一项正在进行的行动的电网建筑意外地被敌方袭击摧毁；代理人继承完整的生产链（建筑场+炼油厂+发电厂+军工厂+矿石车+矿块）和储备现金预算；截止日期是真实的。该模型必须注意到破坏（发电厂的活动建筑数量降至零），将储备用于重建发电厂（不是军队，不是不同的结构，不是什么都没有），并将其放置在幸存的建筑场附近，以便生产保持在线 - 速度足够快，以便重建在截止日期之前关闭发生之前的闩锁。

title: Power Down Non-Essentials Under Load — Reversible Load-Shedding

raw.realWorldMeaning: Grid load-shedding under a generator-down state: the agent starts with insufficient generation to cover its installed load (one Power Plant supplies 100 power; the installed drains total ~140), so the grid runs at NEGATIVE surplus from tick 0 (the engine slows production 50% in this state). The agent must REVERSIBLY shed non-essential loads via `power_down` (toggle the building off) so that provided ≥ drained — WITHOUT selling structures it will need later. Selling fails the `has_building` clauses on the load-bearing structures it ostensibly needs to keep around; powering-down the lone Power Plant collapses provided power and fails the `power_provided_gte:100` floor; stalling never restores surplus and times out.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Datacentre load-shedding when one generator trips: the operator must turn OFF non-critical lines (cosmetic lighting, secondary HVAC) so the surviving generator can carry the essential ones (life safety, core compute), WITHOUT decommissioning the shed equipment (it will be re-enabled the moment the second generator comes back). The correct primitive is a reversible disable, not a destructive one — this is exactly the `power_down` toggle vs `sell`.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: PlanBench reversible-action planning, operations runbook / load-shedding, SC2 power management, lmgame-Bench resource-constraint reasoning

title: Build Power Online First — Grid Bring-Up Sequencing

raw.realWorldMeaning: Standard-operating-procedure (SOP) compliance under a strict happened-before constraint, exemplified by electrical-grid bring-up: the grid (the Power Plant) must be ONLINE before any powered load (the Refinery, Barracks, War Factory) can come up. The opening decision is the entire test — from a pre-placed Construction Yard and a tight budget, the agent must queue the Power Plant FIRST and only THEN the first production / economy building. A model that "just builds the goal building" (the refinery) first finds the order silently blocked (the engine enforces power plant as a prerequisite of ore refinery), wastes the budget retrying, and times out. A model that stalls or builds an army instead also misses the bar.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Standard operating procedure with a hard happened-before constraint: a robotic operator commissioning a new processing site must energise the substation BEFORE bringing up the refinery (or any other powered load). Attempting the refinery first is rejected by the interlock; reasoning about the order of operations from the spec is the entire decision.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: PlanBench, SOP compliance, electrical-grid bring-up
raw.author: wave7-groupI-buildorder

summary.en: Standard-operating-procedure (SOP) compliance under a strict happened-before constraint, exemplified by electrical-grid bring-up: the grid (the Power Plant) must be ONLINE before any powered load (the Refinery, Barracks, War Factory) can come up. The opening decision is the entire test — from a pre-placed Construction Yard and a tight budget, the agent must queue the Power Plant FIRST and only THEN the first production / economy building. A model that "just builds the goal building" (the refinery) first finds the order silently blocked (the engine enforces power plant as a prerequisite of ore refinery), wastes the budget retrying, and times out. A model that stalls or builds an army instead also misses the bar.
summary.zh: 在严格的事前约束下遵守标准操作程序 (SOP)，例如电网启动：电网（发电厂）必须在任何用电负载（炼油厂、兵营、军工厂）启动之前上线。开放决策是整个测试 - 从预先放置的施工场地和紧张的预算来看，代理商必须首先对发电厂进行排队，然后才对第一个生产/经济建筑进行排队。 “只建造目标建筑”（炼油厂）的模型首先发现订单被默默阻塞（引擎强制发电厂作为矿石炼油厂的先决条件），浪费预算重试，并超时。相反，如果模型拖延或建立一支军队，那么它也达不到标准。

title: Parallel Production Throughput — Build a Second War Factory to Hit the Quota

raw.realWorldMeaning: A delivery deadline forces a manufacturing-throughput decision. A fixed quota of vehicles must ship before a tight clock, and the agent starts with exactly ONE production line (war factory). A single serial line cannot clear the quota in time. The agent has cash for a SECOND identical line; building it and feeding both queues roughly doubles the per-tick output rate (parallel manufacturing — a second assembly line does not split the job, it doubles the service rate). The pack frames the classic queueing-theory call: when one server cannot meet the deadline, add a second server in parallel.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Fleet dispatch throughput under a delivery SLA: a warehouse must ship N orders before a deadline, but a single loading dock (one serial server) clears jobs too slowly to meet it. The operator has budget for a second identical loading dock; commissioning it and routing jobs to both docks doubles the dispatch rate. The decision is a parallelism call — recognise that the single server is the bottleneck and add a second server, rather than pushing harder on the one that is already saturated.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: queueing theory, SC2 multi-factory throughput, manufacturing parallelism
raw.author: openra-bench

title: Set the Rally Point Forward — Production Logistics Under a Deadline

raw.realWorldMeaning: Production logistics / warehouse SLA: a factory whose default ship-to is the loading dock will pile inventory at the dock — pieces never reach the field. The decision is a single ACTION — set the production building's RALLY POINT (its "ship-to" address) to a FORWARD staging area at the front, BEFORE the production clock starts burning. Once the rally is set, every subsequent freshly-built unit auto-routes to the front; the operator does not have to micromanage each batch. Without that one-shot reset, the default rally is right next to the building and the units pile at the base ~38 cells from the action, never engage in time, and the SLA (the tick deadline) is missed.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Production-pipeline standing-order routing: a manufacturing or fulfilment system whose default routing rule sends finished goods to the dock will starve the downstream customer; a single standing-order change ("ship every unit produced at this site to dock B at the forward distribution centre") re-routes the entire pipeline. This is also the SC2 rally-point primitive — one click on the production building, every subsequent unit walks to the rally cell — and the analogue is exactly what real-world logistics calls "set the default ship-to".
raw.benchmarkAnchor: SC2 rally management, production logistics, warehouse SLA
raw.author: openra-bench-wave8

summary.en: Production logistics / warehouse SLA: a factory whose default ship-to is the loading dock will pile inventory at the dock — pieces never reach the field. The decision is a single ACTION — set the production building's RALLY POINT (its "ship-to" address) to a FORWARD staging area at the front, BEFORE the production clock starts burning. Once the rally is set, every subsequent freshly-built unit auto-routes to the front; the operator does not have to micromanage each batch. Without that one-shot reset, the default rally is right next to the building and the units pile at the base ~38 cells from the action, never engage in time, and the SLA (the tick deadline) is missed.
summary.zh: 生产物流/仓库 SLA：默认发货地点是装货码头的工厂将在码头堆放库存 - 零件永远不会到达现场。该决定是一个单一的行动——在生产时钟开始燃烧之前，将生产大楼的集结点（它的“运送到”地址）设置到前面的转发暂存区。一旦集结开始，随后的每个新建造的单位都会自动路由到前面；操作员不必对每个批次进行微观管理。如果没有一次性重置，默认的集会就在建筑物旁边，并且单位堆积在距离行动大约 38 个单元格的底部，永远不会及时参与，并且会错过 SLA（滴答截止日期）。

title: Repair Priority Under Fire — Triage the Refinery, Not the Decoy

raw.realWorldMeaning: Three of your structures are under simultaneous attrition and you have one repair organ to commit. The damage picture is deliberately misleading: the pillbox is pre-damaged to ~30% HP and LOOKS the most damaged, but it is low-value, heavily armoured, and the grenadiers barely scratch it — it survives on its own. The refinery (ore refinery) starts intact but is on a LETHAL trajectory: its grenadier band kills it within a few turns unless you toggle `repair` on it immediately. title: Sell and Rebuild Elsewhere — Recoup Capital, Relocate Production

raw.realWorldMeaning: A forward refinery (ore refinery) sits in the path of an incoming enemy hunt band that will raze it within ~25-30 turns; starting cash alone does not cover building a new ore refinery at the safe target region. The only path to a fresh ore refinery inside the tick budget is to SELL the exposed ore refinery (recouping 50% of its build cost) and use the refund plus starting cash to BUILD a new ore refinery and PLACE it at the safe target region far from the rush. Stalling, building without selling (cash gated), and placing the new ore refinery in the wrong region all lose; only sell-then-rebuild-at-safe-region wins.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Liquidate a deteriorating asset to fund a relocation: a forward production node is about to be lost to environmental damage, and the capital reserve alone is insufficient to commission a replacement node elsewhere. The right move is a deliberate salvage of the at-risk node (recovering ~half the build capital in liquid form) which, combined with the on-hand reserve, funds a new node at a safer site BEFORE the original is lost for zero recovery. Letting the asset be destroyed loses 100% of its capital; salvage-and-redeploy preserves 50% + funds the new site.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: capital reallocation, SC2 sell mechanic, financial reallocation
raw.author: openra-bench

title: Cheapest War Factory — Cost-Minimal powr → proc → weap Build Order

raw.realWorldMeaning: Cost-minimal build-order planning under a fixed, non-replenishing budget: the agent must reach the war factory (`war factory`) by spending the LEAST cash on the ONLY affordable prerequisite chain (power plant → ore refinery → war factory). There is no ore and no income — the starting cash is the entire budget, tuned to exactly the cost of the minimal path. Any detour through a non-load-bearing structure (a barracks, a pillbox, an early infantry unit) bloats the bill of materials and exhausts the budget; the war factory can then never be funded. Tests that the model can plan the minimum-COST prerequisite chain — not merely SOME plan that arrives — under a budget that only the cost-minimal plan can afford. Sibling of build-sequence-tech-fastest (the time-optimal axis); here money, not the clock, is the constraint.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Capital-minimal commissioning of an autonomous manufacturing cell under a fixed procurement budget: the cell must bring a target machine online by buying only the strictly required upstream stations (power → feedstock → assembly). summary.en: Cost-minimal build-order planning under a fixed, non-replenishing budget: the agent must reach the war factory (`war factory`) by spending the LEAST cash on the ONLY affordable prerequisite chain (power plant → ore refinery → war factory). title: Resilient War Factory — Redundant Power Survives a Strike (N+1 Build Order)

raw.realWorldMeaning: Robust build-order planning: reach a tech capability AND keep it through a foreseeable disturbance. The agent must bring a war factory online and field an armoured force, but a mid-episode enemy strike razes one power plant. A build order that provisions only a single power plant is a single point of failure — when the strike lands the factory drops to low power and the army never completes in time. The resilient build order pre-builds a second, redundant power plant before the strike, so the grid stays in surplus and production never slows. Tests whether the model plans for the disturbance (N+1 redundancy on the critical prerequisite) rather than merely planning the shortest path to the goal.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: N+1 redundancy on a critical utility. An autonomous production cell depends on a power feed to run its assembly machine; a known hazard will knock out one feed mid-shift. Resilient planning commissions a second, independent feed BEFORE the outage, so the assembly machine never drops below rated throughput. Provisioning only one feed — the shortest plan to first article — halts the line the moment the hazard strikes and blows the delivery deadline.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: PlanBench robust planning, N+1 resilient design, redundancy
raw.author: openra-bench-wave-11

title: Skip the Unneeded Tech Tier — Clear a Light Garrison with a Basic e1 Swarm

raw.realWorldMeaning: The objective only requires basic units. The agent starts with a Construction Yard and an Allied barracks already standing, so cheap rifle infantry are trainable from turn 1 with no prior tech step, and a light enemy garrison — also basic infantry — is incoming. A rifle infantry swarm clears a light infantry garrison comfortably. The trap is to climb the full tech chain (power plant → refinery → war factory → service depot → medium tanks) to bring a higher tech tier online that the objective never asked for: that whole tier costs budget and, critically, clock — by the deadline no tank has fielded at all. The pack tests whether the model recognises that the goal does not require high tech and skips straight to the cheap path.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Right-sizing the plan to the task. A delivery only needs a basic pick-and-place cell that is already commissioned; provisioning a full high-precision assembly line (extra power, feedstock, an assembly station, a calibration depot) before starting work is a whole capability tier the job never required — it burns budget and blows the cycle-time deadline. The competent planner prunes every step the goal does not consume and executes the minimal plan with the capability already on hand.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: PlanBench unnecessary-step pruning, lean process, YAGNI
raw.author: openra-bench

title: Base Building — Construct Structures Respecting the Tech Tree

raw.realWorldMeaning: Construction planning under dependency and spatial constraints: decide a build order that respects engine-enforced tech-tree prerequisites (a barracks needs power; a pillbox needs the barracks), place structures where the objective requires (a defended direction), and when needed creep the base across the map to found the defensive line in a designated far region. The decision is the plan — order, placement, and relocation — not the motor control of any single build. The prerequisite is genuinely enforced by the engine: a power-less barracks NEVER completes, so a greedy "build the goal building first" policy cannot win.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Autonomous construction / facility-layout planning: a task-graph with prerequisites (B needs A, C needs B) plus spatial goals (assemble in zone Z; relocate and found the depot near region R) under a time budget — out-of-order or mis-placed construction never satisfies the goal.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: StarCraft build order, PlanBench, autonomous construction planning
raw.author: autonomous-loop

summary.en: Construction planning under dependency and spatial constraints: decide a build order that respects engine-enforced tech-tree prerequisites (a barracks needs power; a pillbox needs the barracks), place structures where the objective requires (a defended direction), and when needed creep the base across the map to found the defensive line in a designated far region. The decision is the plan — order, placement, and relocation — not the motor control of any single build. The prerequisite is genuinely enforced by the engine: a power-less barracks NEVER completes, so a greedy "build the goal building first" policy cannot win.
summary.zh: 在依赖性和空间限制下进行建造规划：决定尊重引擎强制技术树先决条件的建造顺序（兵营需要电力；碉堡需要兵营），在目标需要的地方放置结构（防御方向），并在需要时在地图上爬行基地，在指定的远距离区域找到防线。决定是计划——顺序、放置和重新定位——而不是任何单个构建的电机控制。这个先决条件是由引擎真正执行的：无动力的营房永远不会完成，因此贪婪的“首先建立目标”政策无法获胜。

title: Reasoning — Attack from Behind via a Fog-Bypass of the Frontal Line

raw.realWorldMeaning: Four medium tanks (2tnk) at the west edge face a tight vertical wall of pillboxes (pbox) and anti-tank rocket soldiers (e3) at x=24, spanning the engagement band and facing west. The objective is an UNDEFENDED enemy construction yard (fact) at (48,20) — behind the line. Charging head-on along y=18..22 puts the lead tank inside the kill envelope of multiple defenders simultaneously and the column never clears the line in time to raze the fact. The winning play is the FOG FLANK: route the strike force to the far north (y=2..5) or far south (y=35..37) — well outside the line's range AND vision — drive east past the line's longitude, then turn inward to descend on the fact from BEHIND. Same enemy, same forces, but the route of approach controls whether the line's prepared fields of fire can engage at all.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Spatial-reasoning under prepared defenses: an intelligent attacker refuses the defender's chosen geometry (the frontal kill envelope) and routes via a corridor outside the defender's sensor + weapon coverage to reach an undefended high-value target. The decision under test is route planning — recognise that a static defensive line is fixed and bypass-able, not that it must be reduced face-to-face.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: SC2 hidden assault, military surprise attack, fog warfare
raw.author: openra-bench

title: Bait + Counter-Attack — Pull the Guards Off Post, Strike the Undefended Yard

raw.realWorldMeaning: A reactive defending cluster (scripted `guard` bot: holds its post, auto-fires in range, lunges at the nearest foe within an aggro radius, snaps back past a leash) is bunched on the approach side of the enemy construction yard. Driving the strike force straight in eats anti-tank fire from the whole cluster and runs the attrition cap before the objective falls. The winning policy commits a cheap fast bait (jeep) on a DIVERGENT vector that comes just close enough to make a SIDE of the cluster lunge off post after the bait, then runs the strike tanks around through the now-vacated flank to destroy the construction yard while it is briefly undefended. Phase 1 (the bait pull) yields zero objective progress and looks locally negative; phase 2, through the slot the bait opened, scores. The credit problem is FEINT-AND-FLANK: the bait must displace a segment of the cluster and the strike must exploit the reversible vacancy in time; bait-only never razes the yard, brute frontal trades the strike force against the full cluster, stalling loses the clock.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Sacrificial-decoy planning against a reactive guarding obstacle: a no-reward enabling action (entice a leashed interceptor off the objective with a decoy on a divergent vector) must precede and temporally overlap the rewarded objective action (commit the payload force on the briefly-cleared flank to destroy the objective before the interceptor snaps back).
raw.benchmarkAnchor: SC2 bait micro / sacrificial pull, military feint-and-flank doctrine, CICERO / Diplomacy deception
raw.author: openra-bench

summary.zh: 一个反应性防御集群（编写为“守卫”机器人：坚守岗位，在射程内自动射击，向仇恨半径内最近的敌人猛冲，通过皮带快速返回）聚集在敌人建筑场的接近一侧。直接驱使打击力量攻击整个集群的反坦克火力，并在目标落下之前耗尽消耗上限。获胜的策略是在一个发散矢量上投入一个廉价的快速诱饵（吉普车），该诱饵距离足够近，足以使集群的一侧在诱饵后冲出柱子，然后让攻击坦克穿过现在空出的侧翼，在短暂不设防的情况下摧毁建筑工地。第一阶段（诱饵拉动）产生的客观进展为零，并且局部看起来是负面的；第2阶段，通过槽将饵料打开，得分。信用问题是佯攻和侧翼攻击：诱饵必须取代集群的一部分，攻击必须及时利用可逆的空位；仅用诱饵永远不会夷平院子，野蛮的正面攻击会用攻击力对抗整个集群，拖延会失去时间。

title: Combat Reasoning — Divide and Conquer Two Mutually-Supporting Enemy Clusters

raw.realWorldMeaning: Four medium tanks (2tnk) at the west edge face TWO enemy clusters at x=28 — a NORTH cluster at y=14..16 and a SOUTH cluster at y=24..26 — each composed of anti-tank rocket soldiers (e3, Dragon, range ~5) and on medium/hard a light tank (1tnk). The clusters are 10 cells apart; pushing east on the midpoint axis (y=20) puts the lead tank inside weapon range of BOTH clusters at once, and under AttackAnything stance the converging mass concentrates fire on the lead, busting the survival bar before either cluster is cleared. The winning play is divide-and-conquer (defeat in detail): flank well NORTH (e.g. y=5) so only Cluster A's units are in range and line-of-sight; eliminate A while Cluster B is still ≥20 cells away and closing; then pivot SOUTH (y=35) and repeat against B in isolation. Each engagement is a clean 4-vs-N(one cluster) trade instead of a 4-vs-2N mass.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Two-front engagement with mutually-supporting defenders: hitting the midpoint between coupled adversaries lets BOTH fire on the leading agent simultaneously, doubling the incoming DPS share. Spatial positioning that breaks line-of-sight or stays outside the second adversary's aggro / weapon envelope sequences the encounter into two 1-vs-1 trades (favourable force ratio per trade), at the cost of route length and clock.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: SMAC squad-isolation, CICERO splitting, military divide-and-conquer
raw.author: openra-bench

title: Combat Micro — Flank a Frontal Anti-Tank Line Instead of Charging Head-On

raw.realWorldMeaning: Medium tanks at the west edge face a tight vertical line of anti- tank rocket soldiers backed by a rifle shield, behind a central water funnel. The line "faces west" — every defender's weapon envelope covers a tank approaching head-on. Charging head-on puts the lead tank inside Dragon range of every rocket soldier in the stack simultaneously and is squeezed by the water funnel. The winning play is the flank: route off-axis (north or south detour above/below the water) and approach the line END-ON so only one or two defenders are in range at any moment. Same enemy, same forces, but the angle of attack controls how many enemy barrels can bear on the leading tank.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Multi-agent strike-package geometry: the bearing of contact against a static defender controls how much of the defender's firepower can engage simultaneously. The decision under test is spatial routing — refuse the high-attrition frontal trade and approach via an axis that sequences the engagement 1-vs-1 rather than 1-vs-N.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: SC2 flank micro, military flank maneuver doctrine, tactical: avoid frontal trade, force-multiplier through angle of attack
raw.author: openra-bench

summary.en: Medium tanks at the west edge face a tight vertical line of anti- tank rocket soldiers backed by a rifle shield, behind a central water funnel. The line "faces west" — every defender's weapon envelope covers a tank approaching head-on. summary.zh: 西边的中型坦克面对着一排紧密垂直的反坦克火箭兵，他们由步枪盾牌支撑，位于中央漏斗后面。这条线“面向西”——每个防御者的武器范围都覆盖了迎面逼近的坦克。正面冲锋将主坦克同时带入了堆叠中每个火箭兵的龙射程内，并被水漏斗挤压。获胜的策略是侧翼：偏离轴线（在水面上或水下向北或向南绕行）并从一端接近线，这样任何时候只有一两个防守者在射程内。相同的敌人，相同的兵力，但攻击角度控制了有多少敌人的炮管可以对领先的坦克造成影响。

A water-walled funnel runs through the centre east-west; a clear NORTH detour lane runs above the water at y=2-5. Kill at least 3 enemies and keep at least 3 of 4 tanks alive within 3000 ticks.

title: Focus-Fire Priority — Kill the Anti-Tank Threat FIRST

raw.realWorldMeaning: Four medium tanks face a small mixed enemy squad at close range: a single high-DPS rocket soldier (anti-vehicle) escorted by 2-3 rifle infantry, all visible in the centre. The decision is target prioritization: concentrate ALL tanks' fire on the rocket soldier FIRST (4-vs-1 kills it in 1-2 decision turns before it can fire more than a couple of rockets), then mop up the infantry. Spreading fire across the squad — via attack_move auto-targeting or by starting on the closer rifle infantry — leaves the rocket soldier alive long enough to kill ≥2 tanks, busting the attrition cap. A brute attack-anything play LOSES; the focus-fire play WINS.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Military strike-package doctrine — when engaging a mixed enemy package, the high-value / high-DPS asset (AA battery, anti-armour weapon, command vehicle) is neutralised FIRST, even when it is not the nearest target. The lower-DPS escort is mopped up after. Target prioritization under fire is the controlled capability: nearest-first or auto-target spreads damage and lets the priority threat keep firing.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: SC2 focus-fire micro, MicroRTS target prioritization, military strike-package: hit AA first, RPS-counter unit prioritization
raw.author: openra-bench

title: Combat Micro — Tank Wedge Through a Bracketing Fire Corridor

raw.realWorldMeaning: Five medium tanks (medium tank) at the west edge must drive east through a bracketing fire corridor (anti-tank rocket soldiers nested above AND below the engagement axis, plus a single light tank blocker on-axis) and reach an objective region in the east with most of the force intact. Marching as a column along y=20 puts the lead tank inside Dragon range of BOTH brackets at once; concentrated cross-fire destroys the lead, then the next tank inherits the kill envelope, and the column bleeds itself dry before clearing the gap. The winning play is the WEDGE — lead tank on-axis at y=20 absorbing the on-axis blocker's fire, flankers offset to y=18 and y=22 trailing one cell west so they engage each bracket END-ON from off-axis (only 1-2 rocket soldiers from each cluster can fire on a flanker at once). The formation's SHAPE controls how much enemy firepower can bear on the lead unit and sequences the bracket engagements into 1-vs-1 trades instead of N-vs-1 crossfire.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Multi-agent strike-package formation: the geometric SHAPE of the moving formation controls weapon-bearing concurrency on both sides. A column maximises target overlap on the lead unit (worst case for surviving cross-fire); an inverted-V wedge spreads the engagement across the formation's width so each enemy bracket faces only 1-2 of the wedge's units at a time, and the lead's job is to ABSORB the on-axis threat while the flank wings dismantle the off-axis threats. The decision under test is formation discipline: order the force into a wedge BEFORE the contact, not after losses force a retreat.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: military tank-wedge doctrine, SC2 formation micro, combined-arms, strike-package geometry: formation shape vs cross-fire
raw.author: openra-bench

en:
Commander, this is a combat push through hostile fire. You are given 5 medium tanks on the west edge at (6, 18..22), Return-Fire orders. A bracket of 5 anti-tank rocket soldiers (Dragon launchers, range 5) overlooks the lane from the north at (21..25, 16), and a single enemy light tank blocks the road on-axis at (26, 20) on Return-Fire orders. The rocket line is on Defend orders (auto-fire in range, no chase). Drive at least 4 tanks into the rally disc at (46, 20) within 4500 ticks while keeping at least 4 tanks alive.
WIN WHEN: get ≥4 units into region (46,20) r=6 AND keep ≥4 units alive AND before game tick 4500.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 4501 OR fewer than 3 of your units remain).
You have at most 75 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Commander, this is a combat push through a bracketed corridor. You are given 5 medium tanks on the west edge at (6, 18..22), Return-Fire orders. The corridor east is bracketed by anti-tank rocket soldiers (Dragon launchers, range 5) on both flanks — 3 above at (22..24, 16) and 3 below at (22..24, 24), Defend orders — and blocked on-axis by an enemy light tank at (25, 20) on Return-Fire orders. Land at least 3 tanks at the (46, 20) rally disc while killing at least 3 of the line, within 4500 ticks, keeping at least 3 tanks alive.
WIN WHEN: destroy ≥3 enemy units AND get ≥3 units into region (46,20) r=6 AND keep ≥3 units alive AND before game tick 4500.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 4501 OR fewer than 3 of your units remain).
You have at most 75 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Commander, this is a combat push from two staging bands. You are given 10 medium tanks (Return-Fire orders) split between far north (y=10..14) and far south (y=26..30) on the west edge — read your actual starting band from the observation. A dense bracket guards the corridor: 4 rocket soldiers above at (21..24, 16) and 4 below at (21..24, 24) on Defend orders, with TWO on-axis light tank blockers at (25, 20) and (27, 20) on Return-Fire orders. Land at least 3 tanks at the (46, 20) rally disc while killing at least 4 enemies, within 4500 ticks, keeping at least 3 tanks alive.
WIN WHEN: destroy ≥4 enemy units AND get ≥3 units into region (46,20) r=6 AND keep ≥3 units alive AND before game tick 4500.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 4501 OR fewer than 3 of your units remain).
You have at most 75 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.
zh:
指挥官，这是一次穿越敌方火力的战斗推进。您在西边 (6, 18..22) 处收到 5 辆中型坦克，还击命令。一队 5 名反坦克火箭兵（龙发射器，射程 5）在 (21..25, 16) 处从北面俯瞰车道，一辆敌方轻型坦克在 (26, 20) 处按照还击命令封锁轴线上的道路。火箭队处于防御命令（射程内自动射击，不进行追逐）。在 4500 个刻度内将至少 4 辆坦克驶入 (46, 20) 处的集结盘，同时保持至少 4 辆坦克存活。
胜利条件：将 ≥4 个单位放入区域 (46,20) r=6 并保持 ≥4 个单位存活且在游戏刻 4500 之前。
失败条件：（不在游戏刻 4501 之前或您剩余的单位少于 3 个）。
您最多有 75 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

指挥官，这是一次穿过包围走廊的战斗推进。您在西边 (6, 18..22) 处收到 5 辆中型坦克，还击命令。走廊东边的两侧均被反坦克火箭兵（龙发射器，射程 5）包围——上方 3 个位于（22..24, 16），下方 3 个位于（22..24, 24），执行保卫命令——并在轴上被敌方轻型坦克在（25, 20）处按照还击命令封锁。在 4500 个刻度内，将至少 3 辆坦克降落在 (46, 20) 集结盘上，同时杀死至少 3 名坦克，保持至少 3 辆坦克存活。
胜利条件：消灭 ≥3 个敌方单位并让 ≥3 个单位进入区域 (46,20) r=6 并保持 ≥3 个单位存活且在游戏刻 4500 之前。
失败条件：（不在游戏刻 4501 之前或您剩余的单位少于 3 个）。
您最多有 75 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

指挥官，这是两个演出乐队的战斗推演。您将获得 10 辆中型坦克（还击指令），分布在西边的远北 (y=10..14) 和远南 (y=26..30) 之间 — 从观察中读取您的实际起始区域。密集的支架守卫着走廊：根据防御命令，上方有 4 名火箭兵在 (21..24, 16)，下方有 4 名火箭兵在 (21..24, 24)，根据还击命令，在 (25, 20) 和 (27, 20) 处有两个轴上轻型坦克阻击手。在 4500 个刻度内，将至少 3 辆坦克降落在 (46, 20) 集结盘上，同时杀死至少 4 名敌人，并保持至少 3 辆坦克存活。
胜利条件：消灭 ≥4 个敌方单位并让 ≥3 个单位进入区域 (46,20) r=6 并保持 ≥3 个单位存活且在游戏刻 4500 之前。
失败条件：（不在游戏刻 4501 之前或您剩余的单位少于 3 个）。
您最多有 75 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

title: Combat Harass — AGGRO Commit: Fight Through the Defender

raw.realWorldMeaning: A small raider force is staged west; a cluster of enemy harvesters works an ore patch around their refinery in the centre-east, with a single heavy tank standing on-post as the defender. The high-score doctrine is to COMMIT — concentrate fire on the defender first (3-vs-1 tank trade favours the attacker), then mop up the undefended harvesters. Stalling or pure retreat misses the kill bar; attacking the harvesters while ignoring the defender lets the heavier heavy tank pick off the raiders one by one. The intended play accepts some attrition to score both targets: aggro raid doctrine, not skirmish-and-pull-back.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Military forward-attrition / aggressive raid doctrine — a small expeditionary force commits to a higher-impact engagement (defender + payload) rather than disengaging at first contact, accepting losses to achieve the larger objective. The decision is threat-priority and commitment, not micromanagement of retreats.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: SC2 aggressive worker harass with commit, military forward attrition warfare, RTS aggro doctrine: accept losses for higher kill ratio, guerrilla raids with kill-everything objective
raw.author: openra-bench

summary.en: A small raider force is staged west; a cluster of enemy harvesters works an ore patch around their refinery in the centre-east, with a single heavy tank standing on-post as the defender. The high-score doctrine is to COMMIT — concentrate fire on the defender first (3-vs-1 tank trade favours the attacker), then mop up the undefended harvesters. Stalling or pure retreat misses the kill bar; attacking the harvesters while ignoring the defender lets the heavier heavy tank pick off the raiders one by one. The intended play accepts some attrition to score both targets: aggro raid doctrine, not skirmish-and-pull-back.
summary.zh: 一支小规模的袭击者部队正在向西集结；一群敌方收割机在他们位于中东部的炼油厂周围的矿地上作业，一辆重型坦克站在岗哨作为防守者。高分原则是“承诺”——首先将火力集中在防御者身上（3对1坦克交易对攻击者有利），然后扫荡不设防的收割机。拖延或纯粹撤退会错过击杀栏；攻击收割机而无视防御者，让较重的重型坦克一一消灭袭击者。预期的玩法接受一些消耗来得分两个目标：仇恨袭击原则，而不是小规模冲突和撤退。

en:
Commander, this is an aggressive raid against an enemy economy. You are given 4 medium tanks on the west edge (x=4). An enemy Ore Refinery sits at (40,20) with 2 harvesters (unarmed ore-collector trucks) working the patch around it. A single heavy tank (heavier than yours; out-trades a medium tank one-on-one) stands guard at (36,20). Three of your tanks shooting the guard at once still win the trade — focus your fire on the heavy first, then sweep the harvesters. Charging the harvesters while the heavy is alive lets it pick you off. Score 3 kills (the guard plus both harvesters) with at least 1 tank surviving, within about 50 turns.
WIN WHEN: destroy ≥3 enemy units AND keep ≥1 units alive AND before game tick 4500.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 4501 OR your whole force is destroyed).
You have at most 51 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Commander, this is an aggressive raid against an enemy economy. You are given 3 medium tanks on the west edge (x=4). An enemy Ore Refinery sits at (40,20) with 3 harvesters working the patch. A single heavy tank stands guard at (36,20) — it out-trades a medium tank one-on-one, but three of yours firing together still beat it. Focus all three on the guard first, then sweep the harvesters. Splitting fire or attacking the workers while the heavy is alive trades raiders you cannot spare. Score 4 kills (the guard plus all three harvesters), one tank surviving, within about 60 turns.
WIN WHEN: destroy ≥4 enemy units AND keep ≥1 units alive AND before game tick 5400.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 4501 OR your whole force is destroyed).
You have at most 62 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Commander, this is an aggressive raid against an enemy economy. You are given 3 medium tanks staged in the north corridor (y=10..14) or the south corridor (y=26..30) depending on seed. An enemy Ore Refinery sits at (40,20) with 4 harvesters working the patch and TWO heavy tanks on guard — one north at (36,16), one south at (36,24). Each heavy out-trades a medium tank one-on-one. Focus all three of your tanks on ONE guard at a time, then the second, then sweep the four harvesters. Splitting fire across both heavies lets them grind you down. Six kills, one raider surviving, within about 95 turns.
WIN WHEN: destroy ≥6 enemy units AND keep ≥1 units alive AND before game tick 8550.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 4501 OR your whole force is destroyed).
You have at most 95 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.
zh:
指挥官，这是对敌方经济体的一次侵略性袭击。您在西边有 4 辆中型坦克 (x=4)。敌方矿石精炼厂位于 (40,20)，有 2 台收割机（非武装矿石收集卡车）在其周围作业。一辆重型坦克（比你的重；一对一胜过中型坦克）在 (36,20) 处守卫。你的三辆坦克同时射击守卫仍然会赢得交易——首先将你的火力集中在重型坦克上，然后横扫收割机。在重物还活着的时候给收割机充电，让它把你干掉。在大约 50 个回合内，击杀 3 次（守卫加上两台收割机）且至少有 1 辆坦克幸存。
胜利条件：消灭 ≥3 个敌方单位并保持 ≥1 个单位存活且在游戏刻 4500 之前。
失败条件：（不是在游戏刻 4501 之前或你的整个部队被摧毁之前）。
您最多有 51 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

指挥官，这是对敌方经济体的一次侵略性袭击。您在西边有 3 辆中型坦克 (x=4)。敌方矿石精炼厂位于 (40,20)，有 3 台收割机在该区域工作。一辆重型坦克在 (36,20) 处守卫——它一对一地击败了一辆中型坦克，但你的三辆坦克一起射击仍然可以击败它。首先将三个人集中在守卫身上，然后扫荡收割机。在重兵还活着的时候开火或攻击工人会导致你无法饶恕的掠夺者。在大约 60 回合内击杀 4 人（守卫加上所有三台收割机），一辆坦克幸存。
胜利条件：消灭 ≥4 个敌方单位并保持 ≥1 个单位存活且在游戏刻 5400 之前。
失败条件：（不是在游戏刻 4501 之前或你的整个部队被摧毁之前）。
您最多有 62 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

指挥官，这是对敌方经济体的一次侵略性袭击。根据种子的不同，您将获得 3 个中型坦克，分别位于北走廊 (y=10..14) 或南走廊 (y=26..30)。敌方矿石精炼厂位于 (40,20)，有 4 台收割机在该地块工作，还有两辆重型坦克守卫 — 一辆向北位于 (36,16)，一辆向南位于 (36,24)。每辆重型坦克都以一对一的方式击败中型坦克。一次将所有三辆坦克集中攻击一名守卫，然后是第二名，然后扫荡四台收割机。向两个重兵开火可以让他们碾压你。大约 95 回合内，击杀 6 人，幸存 1 名袭击者。
胜利条件：消灭 ≥6 个敌方单位并保持 ≥1 个单位存活并且在游戏刻 8550 之前。
失败条件：（不是在游戏刻 4501 之前或你的整个部队被摧毁之前）。
您最多有 95 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

title: Balanced Hit-and-Run — Pulsed Worker Harass under a Leashed Defender

raw.realWorldMeaning: BALANCED pulsed harassment under a reactive defender. Two fast raiders (jeeps) must score N kills against a cluster of soft enemy workers overwatched by a leashed HEAVY TANK (anti-vehicle, immune to the jeeps' anti-infantry MG and lethal to them in one volley). The defender holds its post a few cells off the cluster but lunges at any foe within AGGRO=16 of the post and snaps back past LEASH=18. Committing inside the guard's cannon envelope until the workers die loses jeeps (cap is 0 on medium — the BALANCED bar is that retreat ACTUALLY worked). Sitting out of aggro never scores. The only winning policy is the pulse: approach to MG range of the workers → strike one → retreat past leash → guard snaps back → re-engage → repeat. Retreat is load-bearing — the first pack in the bench where it is required, not merely permitted.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Pulsed manipulation under a reactive guarding agent: the policy must complete a sequence of small reward-bearing actions inside the guard's intervention radius, then disengage past the leash before damage is taken, then re-enter — without taking any hit at all. A commit-until-done policy gets damaged; a stand-off policy never scores. The temporal structure of the reward (cycle of engage / disengage) is what is being tested.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: SC2 muta-harass / sentry-harass (pulsed engagement), military guerrilla warfare (hit-and-run doctrine), pulsed-load attack with retaliation avoidance, RTS balanced harass: kill workers without losing raiders
raw.author: openra-bench

title: Heli Flank — Air Mobility Over a Ground Wall

raw.realWorldMeaning: A two-helicopter strike must engage an enemy infantry cluster pinned behind a contiguous wall of pillboxes — a barrier that denies any ground push inside the tick budget. The decision under test is air-mobility recognition: only the helicopter `move_units` / `attack_unit` flight path crosses the wall; sending a ground unit at the same target stalls against the impassable footprint and never reaches the cluster. Stall (`observe` only) never engages; a ground brute push (no air units exist in the agent force, so this degenerates to "no valid plan") fails the kill bar.

title: Combat Micro — Hold a Narrow Pass Against a Larger Force

raw.realWorldMeaning: A small medium-tank squad must defeat a numerically larger enemy light-tank force by HOLDING the chokepoint — a per-tier-wide corridor that is the only path across the map. The terrain caps how many attackers can bring weapons to bear at once: anchored at the corridor mouth, the squad faces only the few enemies that fit the lane abreast and grinds the larger force down piecemeal. The same squad fighting in the OPEN — having charged east through the corridor, or having pulled west and let the enemy spill into the open — is surrounded by the whole force at once and focus-fired down. The decision under test is positional: anchor the squad IN the chokepoint where the geometry does the work.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Defensive positioning at a terrain bottleneck: a small team holds a corridor / doorway / bridge so an adversary's numerical advantage is neutralised by frontage — only as many opponents as the bottleneck is wide can engage simultaneously. Choosing to fight where the geometry caps the enemy's effective force (rather than on open ground where the full force concentrates) is the load-bearing spatial-reasoning decision. Anchors: military chokepoint / defile defense, Thermopylae (480 BC), the StarCraft 2 ramp hold.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: military chokepoint defense, Thermopylae, SC2 ramp hold
raw.author: openra-bench

summary.zh: 一支小型中型坦克班必须通过守住阻塞点（一条每层宽的走廊，也是穿越地图的唯一路径）来击败人数较多的敌方轻型坦克部队。地形限制了可以同时携带武器的攻击者数量：小队锚定在走廊口，只面对少数并排的敌人，并将较大的部队击溃。在开阔地作战的同一个小队——穿过走廊向东冲锋，或者向西拉动，让敌人逃到开阔地——立即被整支部队包围，并集中射击。所测试的决策是位置性的：将小队锚定在几何形状发挥作用的阻塞点。

en:
Commander, this is a defensive engagement on a 96x40 arena. You are given 3 medium tanks (Defend orders, auto-fire in range) at the mouth of a four-cell-wide corridor around (44, y=18..21) and a Construction Yard far west at (8,20). The corridor is the only opening through an impassable water wall that splits the map at x=45..51. Twelve enemy light tanks stage deep in the eastern lobe (AttackAnything orders) and hunt you through the corridor. Score 9 kills, keep at least 2 tanks at the mouth, hold the Construction Yard, within 5400 ticks.
WIN WHEN: destroy ≥9 enemy units AND keep ≥2 units alive AND own ≥1 'fact' building(s) AND get ≥2 units into region (44,20) r=6 AND before game tick 5400.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 5401 OR fewer than 2 of your units remain).
You have at most 75 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

title: Combat Micro — Kite and Pull a Slow Heavy Force

raw.realWorldMeaning: A fast light strike force must destroy a slower, heavier enemy that out-trades it head-on. The only winning play is the hit-and-PULL cycle: each turn, strike the heavy at weapon range, then RETREAT the strike force out of the heavy's lethal close-range window before it can fire back — and repeat. Standing and fighting LOSES: the heavy cannon collapses the light force's HP before its own runs out. The skill being measured is combat micro under a mobility asymmetry — exploit the speed edge by stringing together move-away + attack cycles instead of issuing one beeline charge.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: A fast/light agent team defeating a slow/heavy adversary by exploiting a mobility asymmetry: a closed-loop evade-then-engage policy rather than a one-shot commit. The per-turn decision is proximity control — stay outside the adversary's lethal radius while delivering effect at standoff range.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: SC2 kiting micro, cavalry skirmish doctrine, military fire-and-maneuver doctrine, economy-of-force
raw.author: openra-bench

title: Combat Micro — Fire from range, then retreat a Slow Heavy Tank with Fast Raiders

raw.realWorldMeaning: Three fast tank raiders must kill ONE enemy heavy tank that is actively HUNTING the raiders' centroid. The only winning play is kiting: each turn, if the heavy tank is closing into one-shot range, MOVE the raiders AWAY (using their speed advantage) and attack_unit the heavy from outside its lethal close-range window. Repeat until the heavy falls. Stand-and-fight LOSES — the heavy tank's cannon out-trades raider weapons at close range and a static engagement collapses raider HP before the heavy's. The skill being measured is combat micro: target a moving threat, exploit the unit-speed asymmetry, and string together a sequence of move-away + attack_unit cycles instead of issuing one beeline order.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Fast/light agents defeating a slow/heavy adversary by exploiting a mobility asymmetry: a closed-loop policy of evade-then-engage, rather than a one-shot beeline. The decision under test is per-turn proximity control (stay outside lethal radius, fire at range).
raw.benchmarkAnchor: SC2 kiting micro (vulture/muta-vs-marines), cavalry-vs-pikeman maneuver, military fire-and-maneuver doctrine, skirmisher tactics
raw.author: openra-bench

summary.en: Three fast tank raiders must kill ONE enemy heavy tank that is actively HUNTING the raiders' centroid. The only winning play is kiting: each turn, if the heavy tank is closing into one-shot range, MOVE the raiders AWAY (using their speed advantage) and attack_unit the heavy from outside its lethal close-range window. Repeat until the heavy falls. Stand-and-fight LOSES — the heavy tank's cannon out-trades raider weapons at close range and a static engagement collapses raider HP before the heavy's. The skill being measured is combat micro: target a moving threat, exploit the unit-speed asymmetry, and string together a sequence of move-away + attack_unit cycles instead of issuing one beeline order.
summary.zh: 三辆快速坦克袭击者必须杀死一辆正在积极狩猎袭击者质心的敌方重型坦克。唯一获胜的玩法是放风筝：每一回合，如果重型坦克接近单发射程，则将袭击者移开（利用其速度优势）并从其致命的近距离窗口外攻击重型坦克。重复直到重物落下。站立和战斗失败——重型坦克的火炮在近距离比袭击者武器更胜一筹，静态交战会先于重型坦克摧毁袭击者的生命值。所测量的技能是微观战斗：瞄准移动威胁，利用单位速度不对称性，并将一系列移动+攻击单位循环串在一起，而不是发出一个直线命令。

Fire from range, then retreat: when it closes within seven cells, move your raiders away along the lane,  then attack from outside its lethal close-range window.  All three raiders must survive, within about 50 turns.

YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 4501 OR fewer than 3 of your units remain).

Fire from range, then retreat: when the heavy enters seven cells, move away along the lane; otherwise fire from range. Kill the heavy without losing one of three raiders, within about 50 turns.
WIN WHEN: destroy ≥1 enemy units AND keep ≥3 units alive AND before game tick 4500.

en:
Commander, this is a coastal bombardment. You are given 1 destroyer (a naval warship that floats on water and cannot move onto land) sitting in the western water channel at (15,20). A lone enemy rifleman is dug in on the shore at (18,20), three cells east. The destroyer's naval gun reaches across the shoreline. Move into range if needed and shell the rifleman down, within about 30 turns.
WIN WHEN: destroy ≥1 enemy units AND before game tick 2699.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 2700 OR your whole force is destroyed).
You have at most 32 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Commander, this is a coastal bombardment. You are given 2 destroyers (naval warships that float on water and cannot move onto land) in the western water channel at (15,18) and (15,22). Three enemy rifle infantry are dug in on the shore at x=18 (y=18, 20, 22). The destroyers' naval guns reach across the shoreline. Hold position offshore and shell all three riflemen down, within about 30 turns.
WIN WHEN: destroy ≥3 enemy units AND before game tick 2699.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 2700 OR your whole force is destroyed).
You have at most 32 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Commander, this is a coastal bombardment against a hardened shore. You are given 2 destroyers (naval warships that float on water and cannot move onto land) in the western water channel at (15,18) and (15,22). An enemy shore garrison at x=18 (y=17..23) is composed of 4 riflemen plus 1 anti-tank rocket soldier. The rocket soldier carries an anti-armour launcher that can damage your destroyers; the riflemen cannot — identify and focus-fire the rocket soldier first. Score 5 kills with BOTH destroyers still afloat, within 2699 ticks.
WIN WHEN: destroy ≥5 enemy units AND keep ≥2 units alive AND before game tick 2699.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 2700 OR fewer than 2 of your units remain).
You have at most 32 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.
zh:

胜利条件：消灭 ≥1 个敌方单位并且在游戏刻 2699 之前。
失败条件：（不在游戏刻 2700 之前或你的整个部队被摧毁之前）。
您最多有 32 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

title: Pincer Attack — Two Squads Strike Simultaneously From Two Sides

raw.realWorldMeaning: Two armoured squads start at OPPOSING latitudes on the west edge (one to the north, one to the south) and must converge on a central enemy cluster simultaneously, hitting the defender from two sides at once. Sending a single squad alone fails on two counts: only 3 tanks (not the required 4) can occupy the objective region, and the lone squad is shredded by the cluster's mass anti-armour before clearing it. Sending both squads but not synchronised (one held back, the other commits first) lets the cluster focus on the lead squad and destroy it before the trailing squad arrives, busting the attrition cap. Only a true simultaneous two-prong commit clears the cluster cleanly and leaves the joint force standing on the objective.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Synchronous two-team pincer attack on a contested objective: each team approaches on a different bearing and both must arrive within a common window so the defending agents cannot focus on either team in detail. Serialising one team behind the other lets the defender concentrate fire and destroy the lead team before reinforcement; only the joint simultaneous commit overwhelms the defence and preserves the strike force.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: SC2 multi-prong / two-prong attack timing, military pincer movement doctrine, envelopment from multiple angles, synchronisation of dispersed forces
raw.author: openra-bench

Sending a single squad alone fails on two counts: only 3 tanks (not the required 4) can occupy the objective region, and the lone squad is shredded by the cluster's mass anti-armour before clearing it. Sending both squads but not synchronised (one held back, the other commits first) lets the cluster focus on the lead squad and destroy it before the trailing squad arrives, busting the attrition cap. summary.zh: 两个装甲班从西边的相反纬度出发（一个在北边，一个在南边），必须同时汇聚到中央敌方集群，同时从两侧攻击防御者。单独派遣一个小队会因两个原因而失败：只有 3 辆坦克（不是所需的 4 辆）可以占领目标区域，并且在清除目标区域之前，单独的小队会被集群的大规模反装甲部队撕碎。发送两个小队但不同步（一个被阻止，另一个先提交）可以让集群专注于领先小队并在尾随小队到达之前摧毁它，从而打破消耗上限。只有真正的双管齐下，才能彻底清除集群，让联合部队坚守目标。

en:
Commander, this is a combat engagement on a 72x40 arena. You command two tank squads — three medium tanks (Return-Fire orders) in the north-west at (5,8) and three more in the south-west at (5,32). A mid-map enemy cluster of four riflemen and two rocket soldiers sits at (22,20), Defend orders. Score 6 kills, bring at least 4 tanks into the (22,20) disc (radius 8), and lose no more than 2 tanks, within 4500 ticks.
WIN WHEN: destroy ≥6 enemy units AND get ≥4 units into region (22,20) r=8 AND lose ≤2 of your own units AND before game tick 4500.

title: Combat Encirclement — Establish the Eastern Anvil Before You Strike

raw.realWorldMeaning: A cluster of enemy rifle + rocket infantry holds the centre of the map (stationary, on Defend stance — they do not flee or chase). A head-on column charge brings every tank within rocket range of the cluster and bleeds the strike force below the survival cap. The winning play is the encirclement idiom (anvil + hammer): detach ONE tank on a flank route (around the cluster via y=5..10 or y=30..35, out of rocket range) to take the eastern anvil position at (43,20), then commit the main body of THREE tanks from the west. The win predicate explicitly requires the agent to have ESTABLISHED an eastern cut-off (≥1 own unit at (43,20,r=8)) at the moment the kill bar is met AND to have ≥3 tanks alive. Brute charging without the cut-off bleeds the force under the survival cap; stalling never opens fire, also a LOSS on the clock.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Multi-agent strike geometry: the placement of a "blocker" / "anvil" unit on the opposite side of the target BEFORE the main engagement opens is what converts a shove into a kill. The decision under test is spatial sequencing — establish the cut-off via a path that avoids the enemy's effective weapon envelope, THEN engage; reversing the order forfeits the capability that the cut-off enables.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: military encirclement, Cannae doctrine, SC2 encirclement, the hammer needs an anvil
raw.author: openra-bench

title: Protect the VIP — Escort a Fragile Unit Through the Hazard

raw.realWorldMeaning: A single fragile high-value unit (the VIP — an unarmed harvester, the only one of its kind on the map) must reach the east extraction point. Four medium tanks at the same west staging zone are the protective detail. The VIP cannot fight (no weapon); an enemy interception force — a Soviet heavy tank backed by rifle infantry — patrols the route and runs the lone VIP down. The escort must move AHEAD, destroy the interceptors, and only then let the VIP cross. Sending the VIP alone or at the head of the column gets it caught and killed; the escort's offence preserves the VIP.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Protected-asset transit / VIP detail / diplomatic convoy: a high-value principal (unarmed, fragile) must traverse a contested route. The protective detail moves in bounding formation ahead and to the flanks, neutralising threats along the route before the principal traverses. The principal does not engage directly — its survival depends on the detail's offence, not its own fight.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: SC2 VIP-survival missions, military VIP protection doctrine, diplomatic security / convoy escort, fragile-target preservation tactics
raw.author: openra-bench
