en:
Commander, this is a VIP escort mission across a long 144x40 lane. You are given 1 harvester (an unarmed ore-collector truck — your VIP, cannot fight back, starting at 70% HP) at (6,20), plus 4 medium tank escorts (Return-Fire orders) straddling it at (6, 18/19/21/22). The harvester is the ONLY one of its type on the map; if it dies, the mission is lost. Two enemy forces block the route east: at x=49 sits a guard force of 1 enemy heavy tank (hits harder than your mediums; will lunge at any of your units within ~16 cells of (49,20)) plus 4 riflemen, all on AttackAnything orders. At x=85 sits a smaller picket — 1 anti-tank rocket soldier (Dragon launcher, range 5, anti-armour) with 2 rifle flankers, also AttackAnything. Bring the harvester to the extraction disc at (130,20) radius 6 within 5400 ticks.
WIN WHEN: get ≥1 'harv' units into region (130,20) r=6 AND have ≥1 'harv' AND before game tick 5400.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 5401 OR NOT (have ≥1 'harv')).
You have at most 61 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

title: Combat Retreat — Disengage to Preserve the Force

raw.realWorldMeaning: Four medium tanks face a numerically superior enemy squad (rocket infantry + heavy tanks) at close range. The fight is unwinnable head-on: the rocket infantry and heavy cannons together out-trade the column inside the loss cap. The only winning play is the SC2 retreat-micro idiom: commit briefly to score the kill bar on the soft anti-tank infantry (rocket soldier), then break contact and pull the surviving tanks BACK to the safe rally point in the west before attrition busts the force-preservation cap.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Military tactical-withdrawal doctrine and the SC2 retreat-micro pattern — when a battle goes poorly, the policy must IDENTIFY the losing trade and pull back to a safe rally before the unit is destroyed. The skill is reading the engagement state and issuing a withdrawal order at the right moment; over- or under-commitment both fail.

title: Rocket Soldier vs Heavy Armour — Pick the Hard-Counter Unit Type

raw.realWorldMeaning: A starting cash budget that funds exactly one coherent composition must be allocated against a pre-placed enemy band of HEAVY TANKS (3tnk Soviet heavy on easy/medium, 4tnk Mammoth on hard). The agent must train ROCKET SOLDIERS (e3, the anti-vehicle Dragon launcher), not light tanks (1tnk — the budget buys only ~2, which lose attrition to heavy armour) and not rifle infantry (e1 — no anti-armour weapon, racks up zero kills against tank armour). The decision is the RPS counter CHOICE (matchup-winning unit type) given the visible threat composition.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Anti-armour procurement against an armoured concentration: a fielded inventory of TOW / Javelin / RPG launchers defeats a main-battle-tank column, while an equivalent budget spent on light AFVs or rifle squads is force-on-force inferior. Asset CLASS — not cost or count — determines the engagement outcome.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: SC2 hard-counter, anti-armor procurement, military RPS
raw.author: openra-bench

summary.en: A starting cash budget that funds exactly one coherent composition must be allocated against a pre-placed enemy band of HEAVY TANKS (3tnk Soviet heavy on easy/medium, 4tnk Mammoth on hard). The decision is the RPS counter CHOICE (matchup-winning unit type) given the visible threat composition.
summary.zh: 必须为一个连贯的组合提供资金的起始现金预算分配给预先放置的敌方重型坦克队（3tnk 苏维埃重型坦克用于简单/中型坦克，4tnk 猛犸坦克用于硬坦克）。特工必须训练火箭兵（e3，反车辆龙发射器），而不是轻型坦克（1tnk - 预算只购买〜2，它会失去重型装甲的消耗），而不是步枪步兵（e1 - 没有反装甲武器，对坦克装甲的杀伤力为零）。考虑到可见的威胁构成，决定是 RPS 反击 CHOICE（对决获胜单位类型）。

title: Combat Skirmish — Strike, Score the Kills, Pull Back to Recovery

raw.realWorldMeaning: SKIRMISHER doctrine in the single-engagement frame: four fast raiders (jeeps) must drive east into a slow infantry cluster, score AT LEAST 3 kills, and then PULL BACK to the recovery zone around the western start before the clock expires AND while keeping at least 3 raiders alive. The skill under test is the decision to STOP FIGHTING and disengage — committing until the enemy is wiped or until the strike force is destroyed both LOSE (commit leaves the raiders at the kill site instead of the recovery zone; over-commit on hard loses raiders to the hunt-bot spawn waves). Distinct from the BALANCED pulsed harass-retreat cycle (combat-harass-balanced-hit-and-run, which is many small pulses with zero attrition): this pack is ONE big engagement done well, with a positional recovery bar.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Mission-with-egress: a mobile manipulator must complete a threshold of reward-bearing actions in a contested workspace, then return to a safe staging region before a time or attrition budget expires. Knowing WHEN to stop the productive sub-task and start the egress is the decision under test — a productivity-only policy (greedy accumulation) leaves the agent far from the staging region at deadline and fails the egress clause.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: SC2 skirmisher tactics, military reconnaissance-by-fire, harass-and-disengage doctrine, armoured cavalry doctrine

summary.zh: 单次交战框架中的散兵作战原则：四名快速袭击者（吉普车）必须向东驶入缓慢的步兵集群，取得至少 3 次击杀，然后在时间结束前拉回西部起点周围的恢复区，同时保持至少 3 名袭击者活着。测试的技能是停止战斗和脱离的决定——承诺直到敌人被消灭或直到打击部队被摧毁，两者都失败（承诺让袭击者留在杀戮地点而不是恢复区；过度承诺硬性失败会让袭击者陷入狩猎机器人的重生波）。与平衡脉冲骚扰-撤退循环不同（战斗-骚扰-平衡-打了就跑，这是许多零损耗的小脉冲）：这个包是一次大型交战，做得很好，有一个位置恢复栏。

title: Hunt Authorisation — Lift Stance to Pursue Scattered Enemies

raw.realWorldMeaning: An engagement-authority escalation drill: four medium tanks are pre-staged at the west edge of the arena on RETURN-FIRE (stance:1) — they will not open fire unless attacked. A scattered enemy force (riflemen + a light tank) is spread across the eastern half of the map at positions that don't bring the fight to the agents. The mission is to call `set_stance(units, 3)` to escalate the formation to AttackAnything so the engine's stance:3 hunt path advances each tank to the nearest scattered enemy and wipes them out. Without the escalation the formation idles (return-fire never triggered, hunt never licensed) and the deadline bites as a real LOSS.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: A patrol-vs-pursuit authority switch: a perimeter defence team is on weapons-tight standing orders (return fire only). The operator detects scattered hostiles deep in the perimeter that aren't engaging the defenders. The operator must issue the "weapons free, hunt and clear" command to escalate the team from defensive return-fire to active pursuit. The skill is the operator's decision to ESCALATE the engagement-authority at all — not the precise moment within the engagement window.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: military ROE escalation, SC2 stance micro
raw.author: openra-bench

title: Suicide Charge — Sacrifice the Force to Raze a High-Value Objective

raw.realWorldMeaning: Forlorn hope / military sacrifice doctrine. A high-value enemy construction yard (`fact`) sits at the far east of a tailored 56×40 arena, defended by an anti-armor picket; the agent's small strike package at the west cannot punch through without heavy losses. The OBJECTIVE is the building's destruction — keeping the force intact is NOT required and is not achievable. A "preserve the force" policy that engages carefully and tries to save units loses on the clock (the picket grinds the lead element down and the rest never arrive); a half-commit that advances and halts short of the objective also times out. Only an all-in commit that drives the WHOLE force decisively at the objective and focus-fires through the picket — trading most of the attackers for the kill — actually razes the fact in time. This is delayed-terminal credit assignment with an explicit cost-vs-objective trade-off: every unit lost looks locally negative, but the only successful plan accepts that the bulk of the force is spent and only a remnant survives to land the killing blow.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Expendable strike package / single-use intervention: a fleet of cheap drones must destroy a critical adversary asset under a hard deadline; loiter or stand-off attacks miss the window, so the planner must commit every platform on a one-way attack trajectory, accepting total platform loss as the operating cost of mission success.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: military sacrifice doctrine / forlorn hope (West & East canonical), SC2 expendable strike package (all-in cost-objective trade), MicroRTS / SC2LE attack-the-base under deadline with attrition-OK
raw.author: openra-bench

summary.en: Forlorn hope / military sacrifice doctrine. A high-value enemy construction yard (`fact`) sits at the far east of a tailored 56×40 arena, defended by an anti-armor picket; the agent's small strike package at the west cannot punch through without heavy losses. The OBJECTIVE is the building's destruction — keeping the force intact is NOT required and is not achievable. A "preserve the force" policy that engages carefully and tries to save units loses on the clock (the picket grinds the lead element down and the rest never arrive); a half-commit that advances and halts short of the objective also times out. Only an all-in commit that drives the WHOLE force decisively at the objective and focus-fires through the picket — trading most of the attackers for the kill — actually razes the fact in time. This is delayed-terminal credit assignment with an explicit cost-vs-objective trade-off: every unit lost looks locally negative, but the only successful plan accepts that the bulk of the force is spent and only a remnant survives to land the killing blow.
summary.zh: 绝望的希望/军事牺牲主义。一个高价值的敌方建筑工地（“事实”）位于一个定制的 56×40 竞技场的最东边，由反装甲纠察队保卫；特工在西部的小规模打击计划不可能在没有重大损失的情况下突破。目标是摧毁建筑物——保持力完好无损是不需要的，也是不可能实现的。谨慎参与并试图挽救部队损失的“保存力量”政策（纠察队将领先部队碾压而其余人员永远不会到达）；未达到目标而前进和停止的半承诺也会超时。只有全力以赴，果断地驱动整个部队瞄准目标，集中火力击穿纠察队——用大部分袭击者换取杀戮——才能真正及时消除这一事实。这是延迟的最终信用分配，具有明确的成本与目标权衡：损失的每一个单位在局部看来都是负面的，但唯一成功的计划承认大部分兵力已被消耗，只有剩余的兵力幸存下来以实现致命一击。

The enemy Construction Yard at (50,20) on the far east must be destroyed. title: Tank-vs-Tank Mirror — Focus-Fire, Lanchester Square Law

raw.realWorldMeaning: A three-tank strike force engages a stationary enemy tank line. The decision under test is combat micro: close to cannon range, HOLD the engagement at range, and concentrate `attack_unit` fire on one target at a time — eliminate the nearest enemy, then the next, working down the line. Per the "concentration of force" doctrine and the Lanchester square law, a force that holds and focus-fires removes enemy OUTPUT DPS one whole tank per kill and clears the line keeping its strength; a force that brute `attack_move`s straight INTO the enemy position bunches itself in the enemy's midst, absorbs the whole line's crossfire at once, and is wiped before it can clear the engagement. On medium the agent is numerically out-gunned 4-vs-3, so the controlled engagement is load-bearing: only a held, concentrated focus-fire push clears ≥3 of the 4 enemy tanks while keeping ≥2 of its own. Stalling never engages and loses on the kill bar; the brute drive-in loses on the survival cap / kill bar; only the controlled focus-fire engagement wins.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Military "concentration of force" doctrine (one of the Principles of War): a smaller or equal force concentrated at the decisive point can defeat a numerically equivalent dispersed enemy. The per-kill removal of enemy OUTPUT DPS is the closed-form Lanchester square-law advantage of concentrated fire; the test mirrors the SC2 mirror-tank micro / marine-vs-marine engagement where the side that focus-fires one target at a time wins the trade against a numerically equal foe spreading fire across the whole line.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: SC2 mirror micro, Lanchester square law, concentration of force
raw.author: openra-bench

summary.zh: 由三辆坦克组成的打击部队与固定的敌方坦克阵线交战。正在测试的决策是微观战斗：靠近大炮射程，在射程内保持交战，并将“攻击单元”集中火力一次瞄准一个目标——消灭最近的敌人，然后是下一个，沿线工作。根据“兵力集中”原则和兰彻斯特平方定律，一支能够守住并集中火力的部队每次击杀后可以消除敌人的输出DPS一整辆坦克，并清理战线并保持其力量；一股猛烈的“攻击移动”直接进入敌人阵地的力量在敌人中间聚集，立即吸收全线的交叉火力，并在它能够清除交战之前被消灭。在中型条件下，特工在 4 对 3 的火力上处于优势，因此受控交战是承重的：只有进行集中火力推进才能清除 4 辆敌方坦克中的 ≥3 辆，同时保持自己的 ≥2 辆坦克。失速永远不会发生，并且会在杀伤栏上失败；野蛮的汽车在生存上限/杀戮栏上失败；只有受控的集中火力交战才能获胜。

title: Tanya vs e1 Rush — Hero Engagement

raw.realWorldMeaning: A single Allied commando (Tanya) holds the centre against a small rush of conscript rifle infantry. Tanya is a hero unit: 3x the HP of a basic rifleman, fast, and her sidearm out-DPSes a small rifle infantry pack. But she spawns on hold-fire stance — a do-nothing policy leaves her standing still under fire and she dies. The decision is "actively engage the hero asset" vs "observe / stall". The intended policy issues attack-move (or flips her stance to defend /attack-anything) and wins; stall loses.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Hero / commando doctrine — a single high-DPS asset is force-multiplying only when active. A door-kicker robot held in standby while threats approach is wasted. The capability is "commit the hero asset to the engagement" — operators who fail to commit, lose the asset and the engagement.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: RA hero unit (Tanya commando), RTS micro: engage the hero, asymmetric high-value asset doctrine
raw.author: openra-bench

summary.zh: 一名盟军突击队员（塔尼娅饰）控制着中心，对抗一小股应征入伍的步枪步兵。坦尼娅是一个英雄单位：生命值是普通步枪手的 3 倍，速度快，而且她的随身武器的伤害输出超过了小型步枪步兵包。但她以停火姿态生成——无所作为的政策让她在炮火下站着不动，然后就死了。决定是“积极参与英雄资产”与“观察/停滞”。预期的策略发出攻击移动（或翻转她的立场以防御/攻击任何事物）并获胜；摊位输了。

en:
Commander, this is a hero engagement on a 32x40 arena. You are given Tanya at (12,20) — an elite commando: fast, tough, with a pistol that one-shots riflemen. She starts on hold-fire orders (she will NOT engage even if shot at). The enemy rushes from the east on AttackAnything orders: 4 riflemen in a line at x=16-19, y=20. Score 4 kills, keep Tanya alive, within 2700 ticks.
WIN WHEN: destroy ≥4 enemy units AND keep ≥1 units alive AND before game tick 2700.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 2701 OR your whole force is destroyed).
You have at most 30 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Commander, this is a hero engagement on a 32x40 arena against a denser rush. You are given Tanya at (12,20) — an elite commando: fast, tough, with a pistol that one-shots riflemen. She starts on hold-fire orders (she will NOT engage even if shot at). The enemy rushes from the east on AttackAnything orders in two waves: wave A of 3 riflemen at (16, 19-21) NOW, and a second wave of 3 more riflemen appears at (20, 19-21) about 4 turns (300 ticks) in. Score 6 kills, keep Tanya alive, within 2700 ticks.
WIN WHEN: destroy ≥6 enemy units AND keep ≥1 units alive AND before game tick 2700.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 2701 OR your whole force is destroyed).
You have at most 30 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

She starts on hold-fire orders (she will NOT engage even if shot at). The enemy rushes on AttackAnything orders from one of two corridors depending on seed: a column of 6 riflemen attacks from either the NORTH band (y=17) OR the SOUTH band (y=23), spanning x=16-21. Score 6 kills, keep Tanya alive, within 2700 ticks.
WIN WHEN: destroy ≥6 enemy units AND keep ≥1 units alive AND before game tick 2700.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 2701 OR your whole force is destroyed).
You have at most 30 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.
zh:
指挥官，这是一场 32x40 竞技场上的英雄交战。塔尼娅（Tanya）位于（12,20）——一名精英突击队员：快速、强悍，拥有一把可以一击毙命步枪手的手枪。她开始执行停火命令（即使遭到射击她也不会交战）。敌人按照任意攻击命令从东边冲过来：4 名步枪手在 x=16-19，y=20 处排成一排。在 2700 秒内完成 4 次击杀，让 Tanya 存活。
胜利条件：消灭 ≥4 个敌方单位并保持 ≥1 个单位存活且在游戏时间点 2700 之前。
失败条件：（不是在游戏刻 2701 之前或你的整个部队被摧毁之前）。
您最多有 30 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

胜利条件：消灭 ≥6 个敌方单位并保持 ≥1 个单位存活且在游戏刻 2700 之前。
失败条件：（不是在游戏刻 2701 之前或你的整个部队被摧毁之前）。
您最多有 30 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

title: Target Priority — Kill the High-Threat Units FIRST

raw.realWorldMeaning: Four medium tanks face a mixed enemy cluster at close range: a screen of cheap rifle infantry (rifle infantry chaff) backed by THREE high-threat anti-armour rocket soldiers (rocket soldier). The decision is threat-weighted target prioritization: concentrate ALL FOUR tanks' fire on the rocket soldiers FIRST (each dies in 1-2 decision turns to 4-vs-1 fire, before it can land more than a couple of anti-tank rockets), THEN mop up the chaff. Engaging the chaff first — via attack_move auto-targeting the nearer rifle screen, or by explicitly attacking the cheap infantry — leaves the three rocket soldiers firing through the entire mop-up and they whittle the squad below the survival floor. A brute attack-move play and a kill-chaff-first play both LOSE; the threat-first focus play WINS.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Military target prioritization under fire — when engaging a mixed force, the high-threat asset (anti-armour weapon, AA battery, command vehicle) is neutralised FIRST, even when it is not the nearest target, because it out-damages the cheap escort. Killing the low-threat chaff first lets the priority threat keep firing and attrits the friendly force. Threat-weighted engagement — not nearest-first — preserves the squad.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: SC2 focus-fire target priority, threat-weighted engagement, military target prioritization
raw.author: openra-bench

summary.zh: 四辆中型坦克近距离面对混合敌军集群：一排廉价步枪步兵（步枪步兵箔条），背后有三名高威胁反装甲火箭兵（火箭兵）。这个决定是威胁加权的目标优先顺序：首先将所有四辆坦克的火力集中在火箭兵身上（每辆坦克在1-2的决定中死亡，然后变成4对1的火力，然后才能降落多于几个反坦克火箭），然后扫除糠秕。首先使用箔条——通过attack_move自动瞄准较近的步枪屏幕，或者明确攻击廉价步兵——让三名火箭兵在整个扫荡中射击，并削弱生存地板以下的小队。野蛮的攻击移动玩法和先杀糠的玩法都会失败；威胁优先的焦点游戏获胜。

en:
Commander, this is a combat engagement on a 128x40 arena. You are given a Construction Yard at (4,20) and 4 medium tanks (Return-Fire orders) at (48, 18-21). The enemy is a mixed cluster to the east on Defend orders: a screen of 9 riflemen at x=66 (y=15-23) backed by 3 anti-tank rocket soldiers (Dragon launchers, range 5, anti-armour) at x=69 (y=19-21). Score 12 kills, keep at least 3 tanks alive, hold the Construction Yard, within 2700 ticks.
WIN WHEN: destroy ≥12 enemy units AND keep ≥3 units alive AND before game tick 2700 AND own ≥1 'fact' building(s).
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 2701 OR fewer than 3 of your units remain).
You have at most 30 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Commander, this is a combat engagement on a 128x40 arena against a heavier cluster. You are given a Construction Yard at (4,20) and 4 medium tanks (Return-Fire orders) at (48, 18-21). The enemy holds Defend orders to the east: 12 riflemen in a tight screen at x=66 (y=14-25) backed by 3 anti-tank rocket soldiers (Dragon launchers, range 5, anti-armour) at x=69 (y=19-21). Score 15 kills, keep at least 3 tanks alive, hold the Construction Yard, within 2700 ticks.
WIN WHEN: destroy ≥15 enemy units AND keep ≥3 units alive AND before game tick 2700 AND own ≥1 'fact' building(s).
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 2701 OR fewer than 3 of your units remain).
You have at most 30 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Commander, this is a combat engagement on a 128x40 arena with seed-varied staging. You are given a Construction Yard and 4 medium tanks (Return-Fire orders) at x=48, in either the NORTH corridor (y=10-13) or the SOUTH corridor (y=27-30) depending on seed — read your own position from the map. The enemy holds Defend orders to the east: 12 riflemen in a tight screen at x=66 (y=14-25) backed by 3 anti-tank rocket soldiers (Dragon launchers, range 5, anti-armour) at x=69 (y=19-21). Score 15 kills, keep at least 3 tanks alive, hold the Construction Yard, within 2700 ticks.
WIN WHEN: destroy ≥15 enemy units AND keep ≥3 units alive AND before game tick 2700 AND own ≥1 'fact' building(s).
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 2701 OR fewer than 3 of your units remain).
You have at most 120 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.
zh:
指挥官，这是一场在 128x40 的竞技场上进行的战斗。您在 (4,20) 处有一个施工场地，在 (48, 18-21) 处有 4 个中型坦克（还击命令）。敌人是东边执行防御命令的混合集群：x = 66（y = 15-23）的 9 名步枪兵组成的屏幕，由 x = 69（y = 19-21）的 3 名反坦克火箭兵（龙发射器，射程 5，反装甲）支持。在 2700 秒内完成 12 次击杀，保持至少 3 辆坦克存活，占领建筑场。
胜利条件：摧毁 ≥12 个敌方单位并保持 ≥3 个单位存活且在游戏刻 2700 之前并拥有 ≥1 个“事实”建筑物。
失败条件：（不在游戏刻 2701 之前或您剩余的单位少于 3 个）。
您最多有 30 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

title: Hard-Counter Selection — Tanks vs Rockets vs an Infantry Threat

raw.realWorldMeaning: A fixed cash budget funds EITHER a small armoured fist (3× medium tank medium tanks @ $850) OR a mass anti-tank rocket squad (8× rocket soldier rocket soldiers @ $300) OR a rifle company (up to 25× rifle infantry @ $100). The enemy is PURE rifle infantry (rifle infantry mass entrenched at centre). The correct rock-paper-scissors counter is armour: heavy tanks soak small-arms fire and shred soft targets at range. Rockets are the WRONG counter — anti-tank munitions against soft infantry waste cost-per-effect and the rocket squad's short stand-off + low HP gets out-DPSed by the rifle mass on attrition. Matching the enemy with own rifles is a 1:1 trade with no positional advantage and loses. Stalling never reaches the kill bar. The capability under test is hard-counter SELECTION: scout the threat composition, infer it has no anti-armour, and commit the WHOLE budget to the dominant counter.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Capability counter-selection in defense procurement / fleet composition: buying anti-tank guided missiles is wrong against a soft-target infantry threat (cost-per-effect waste), buying rifle squads matches the threat 1:1 with no advantage, buying armoured vehicles is the dominant choice. The decision under test is reading the threat profile and committing the whole capital budget to the dominant counter rather than hedging across categories.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: SC2 hard-counter, military RPS counter, capability-based defense
raw.author: openra-bench

title: Convergent Attack — Three Squads, One Defended Target

raw.realWorldMeaning: Three armoured columns start on three different bearings (NORTH, WEST-of-objective, SOUTH) and must converge on a single defended enemy construction yard from three different directions. The win requires every tank of all three columns to reach the objective region with the yard destroyed: a single-column tour delivers only a third of the force, a serialized two-column attempt only two thirds — neither reaches the joint-arrival threshold. The advertised capability is synchronous multi-fleet convergence on a shared objective; a stall loses on the clock.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Synchronous multi-robot rendezvous on a contested objective: each team must dispatch on a different ingress vector so that all teams arrive at the goal; dispatching only one or two teams leaves the joint payload threshold (≥n teammates on the goal) unmet and the objective unfulfilled.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: SC2 triple-prong assault timing, military convergent attack / pincer movement, SMAC squad convergence, envelopment doctrine: hit from multiple directions simultaneously
raw.author: openra-bench

summary.en: Three armoured columns start on three different bearings (NORTH, WEST-of-objective, SOUTH) and must converge on a single defended enemy construction yard from three different directions. The win requires every tank of all three columns to reach the objective region with the yard destroyed: a single-column tour delivers only a third of the force, a serialized two-column attempt only two thirds — neither reaches the joint-arrival threshold. The advertised capability is synchronous multi-fleet convergence on a shared objective; a stall loses on the clock.
summary.zh: 三个装甲纵队从三个不同的方位（北、目标西、南）开始，并且必须从三个不同的方向汇聚到一个被防御的敌方建筑场上。胜利需要所有三个纵队的每辆坦克都到达目标区域，并且院子被摧毁：单纵队的巡演只能提供三分之一的兵力，连续的两纵队的尝试只能提供三分之二——两者都没有达到联合到达的门槛。所宣传的能力是多舰队同步聚合于一个共同的目标；一个摊位在时钟上丢失了。

en:
Three tank squads — three mediums each — stage north (70,6), west (66,20), and south (70,34) of the defended enemy yard at (100,20). Three leashed riflemen guard it. Drive all three squads in together; one or two alone can't put nine tanks in the (100,20) disc. Raze the yard, within about 50 turns.
WIN WHEN: get ≥9 units into region (100,20) r=8 AND destroy the enemy fact AND before game tick 4500.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 4501 OR your whole force is destroyed).
You have at most 54 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Same three squads from N, W, and S — but the yard at (100,20) now has four leashed riflemen, one on each face. All nine tanks must arrive in the (100,20) disc and the yard must fall. Send every squad at once, within about 50 turns.
WIN WHEN: get ≥9 units into region (100,20) r=8 AND destroy the enemy fact AND before game tick 4500.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 4501 OR your whole force is destroyed).
You have at most 54 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Three squads of three medium tanks each from N, W, and S, with the exact staging cells shifted per seed. The defended yard at (100,20) still wears four leashed riflemen. Launch synchronously so all nine tanks converge in the (100,20) disc; raze the yard within about 50 turns.
WIN WHEN: get ≥9 units into region (100,20) r=8 AND destroy the enemy fact AND before game tick 4500.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 4501 OR your whole force is destroyed).
You have at most 54 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

胜利条件：让 ≥9 个单位进入区域 (100,20) r=8 并摧毁敌方事实并在游戏刻 4500 之前。

title: Bounding Overwatch — One Squad Covers While the Other Moves

raw.realWorldMeaning: Two armoured squads must cross a centre-of-map FIRE ZONE held by static anti-tank infantry. Charging both squads through together stacks every enemy's fire onto a single dense column and busts the attrition cap. Sending one squad alone leaves the other idle and the lone column still absorbs ALL the cluster's fire. The intended capability is bounding overwatch: one squad stops just OUTSIDE the cluster's range and acts as the COVER team — firing on the cluster to draw its attention from the closer flank — while the BOUNDING team sweeps WIDE through the periphery (outside enemy sight) to a forward position; then the roles alternate so the cover team can also cross safely. The cluster's fire is split per phase rather than stacked on one column, so each squad takes at most one loss.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Multi-agent traversal of a contested corridor where defenders have a fixed effective range envelope and concentrate fire on whichever cluster is closest. Single-team traversal eats the full defensive fire envelope; the joint policy alternates an OVERWATCH role (suppressive fire drawing defender attention from a flank) with a BOUNDING role (sweep through the cleared periphery). The coordination is the role-alternation — leapfrogging cover and move — not just splitting the force.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: US Army FM 3-21.8 bounding overwatch (fire-and-maneuver doctrine), SC2 siege-tank leapfrog advance under enemy fire, SMAC coordinated cross of a danger zone with split defender fire, MicroRTS multi-squad alternating cover-and-move

title: Diversionary Attack — A Diverts South, B Razes the Real Target North

raw.realWorldMeaning: Two squads command a split-attack against an enemy that holds TWO key buildings: a REAL target (construction yard) with light defence and a DECOY (power plant) with heavier defence. The scripted `guard` enemy holds post and lunges only when baited into its aggro radius. Driving each squad onto its nearest visible target is a trap: the closer-stronger squad (tanks) commits onto the decoy's heavy anti-tank garrison (gets shredded AND razes the wrong building — only a `construction yard` in the target region scores), the closer-weaker squad (jeeps) can't crack the real target's garrison fast enough, the clock expires. The winning policy SWAPS the assignment: commit the fast disposable jeeps south-east into the decoy's heavier defence to bait its garrison OFF the construction yard line; commit the tanks north-east through the now-thin construction yard perimeter to raze the construction yard before the surviving light garrison can trade out the column. Phase 1 (the diversion) yields zero objective credit — only phase 2, after the south defenders have committed south in pursuit, scores. The credit problem is DIVERSIONARY ASSAULT: a no-reward enabling action (drag the heavier defence away from the real target with a disposable lure squad) must precede and temporally overlap the rewarded objective action (commit the main strike on the briefly-undefended real target).
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Concurrent multi-robot dispatch with deception: two independent teams must coordinate against a reactive adversary, where one team takes a NO-REWARD enabling role (drawing the adversary's attention to a decoy target on the OPPOSITE flank) while the other team — counter-intuitively assigned to the FARTHER objective — completes the rewarded task. The lazy nearest-task assignment is degenerate: every team must commit ACROSS the map to the objective its sibling enabled.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: SC2 multi-prong / split-attack assault, military diversionary tactics (Sun Tzu loud feint + quiet main thrust), CICERO / Diplomacy deception, advertising: loud feint draws competitor attention while quiet launch hits real market
raw.author: openra-bench

summary.zh: 两个小队指挥对拥有两座关键建筑物的敌人进行分头攻击：一个具有轻度防御的真实目标（建筑场）和一个具有较重防御的诱饵（发电厂）。脚本化的“守卫”敌人只有在被引诱进入其仇恨半径时才会坚守阵地并猛冲。将每个小队驱赶到最近的可见目标是一个陷阱：较接近的较强小队（坦克）会攻击诱饵的重型反坦克驻军（被撕碎并夷为平地，只有目标区域中的“建筑场”得分），较接近较弱的小队（吉普车）无法足够快地破解真正目标的驻军，时钟到期。获胜的策略交换了任务：将快速的一次性吉普车投入东南方进入诱饵的重防御，以引诱其驻军离开施工场地线；在幸存的轻型驻军可以换出纵队之前，将坦克向东北方向穿过现在已经很薄弱的建筑场周边，将建筑场夷为平地。第一阶段（转移）的客观得分为零——只有第二阶段，在南方防守者向南追击之后，得分。信用问题是分散攻击：无奖励的启用行动（用一次性诱饵小队将较重的防御拖离真实目标）必须先于奖励的目标行动（对短暂未防御的真实目标进行主要打击）并暂时重叠。

title: Mutual Support — Advance the Squad as a Tight Ball

raw.realWorldMeaning: A six-tank squad at the west edge must advance east, punch through a belt of anti-tank harasser clusters, converge on an enemy cluster near the centre, destroy the defenders, and finish with at least five of the six tanks alive. Advancing strung-out — a single-file column spread across many cells — feeds each harasser cluster one or two lead tanks at a time; the cluster concentrates its fire and destroys the isolated leaders before the rest of the squad closes up, and the force is defeated in detail. The winning play is to advance as a TIGHT BALL: keep all six tanks inside a small clump so the whole squad enters each cluster's fire envelope together, every tank's cannon concentrates on the cluster, and the defenders are erased in one or two volleys before they can finish any single tank. Mutual support means no element ever advances outside the supporting range of the others.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Multi-agent coherent advance under fire: a defender concentrates its fire on whichever agent is closest and within its weapon envelope. A strung-out formation lets the defender pick off the leading agents one at a time (one-sided focus fire); a coherent clump brings the whole team's firepower to bear at once (reciprocal focus fire) and out-trades the defender. The decision under test is formation cohesion — keep the squad inside mutual-support range throughout the advance, regrouping before each contact rather than racing the fastest units ahead.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: military mutual support, SC2 ball micro, SMAC squad coherence, defeat-in-detail avoidance: keep the force concentrated
raw.author: openra-bench

summary.zh: 西边的六辆坦克小队必须向东推进，击穿反坦克骚扰集群带，会聚到中心附近的敌军集群，摧毁防御者，并最终消灭六辆坦克中的至少五辆。纵队前进——单列纵队分布在许多单元中——每次为每个骚扰集群提供一到两个先导坦克；集群集中火力，在小队的其他成员接近之前摧毁了孤立的领导者，部队被彻底击败。获胜的策略是紧密推进：将所有六辆坦克集中在一个小集群内，这样整个小队就可以一起进入每个集群的火力范围，每个坦克的火炮都集中在集群上，防御者在他们能够消灭任何一个坦克之前，通过一两次齐射就被消灭。相互支持意味着任何元素都不会超出其他元素的支持范围。

en:
Six medium tanks stage at the west edge. A harasser cluster of three anti-tank rocket soldiers hides south of the lane around (40,23), and four more sit at the objective around (60,20). Advance as a tight ball so every cluster eats the squad's concentrated fire at once — a strung-out column gets picked off lead-first. Five tanks at (60,20), five kills, five alive, within about 50 turns.
WIN WHEN: in this exact order: get ≥5 units into region (40,20) r=5 → THEN → get ≥5 units into region (60,20) r=6 AND destroy ≥5 enemy units AND keep ≥5 units alive AND before game tick 4500.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 4501 OR fewer than 3 of your units remain).
You have at most 75 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Six tanks at the west face two bracketing harasser clusters (three rockets each, north and south of the lane around x=35..44) plus a five-rocket objective at (60,20). title: Relay Strike — Heavy Tanks Soften, Infantry Mop Up

raw.realWorldMeaning: Two-wave relay assault: the first wave (heavy tanks) commits to destroy the enemy armour line; the second wave (light infantry) follows up to clear the remaining enemy infantry. Sending the light second wave in first exposes the soft infantry to the un-suppressed enemy tank line and the wave is shredded before any kills materialise; sending both waves together exposes the light wave to the same tank fire envelope before the heavy wave can suppress them. Only the relay ordering (A engages → softens → THEN B advances) preserves the force AND finishes inside the deadline.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Two-team relay clearing operation: the suppression team (heavily armoured) commits first to neutralise the heavy threats; the mop-up team (lightly armoured, fast, optimised for the secondary target class) advances only after the heavies are down. Concurrent commitment over-exposes the mop-up team to the heavies they are not equipped for; the suppression-then-clear handoff is the doctrine.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: SC2 attack-wave timing, SMAC relay strike doctrine, military overlapping fires, fire-and-maneuver: bound-and-bound
raw.author: openra-bench

title: Vision Relay Chain — Space Scouts to Keep the Far Objective Observed

raw.realWorldMeaning: To keep a distant objective continuously observed, scouts must be spaced in a CHAIN — one per leg of the corridor, each within vision range of the next — so coverage propagates from the base out to the far objective. Sending a single scout all the way forward leaves the corridor uncovered behind it; bunching the scouts together gives reach at one spot but no depth. Only the distributed relay chain holds the whole corridor and the far objective at once.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Multi-robot sensor-network coverage / communications relay: a swarm tasked with maintaining situational awareness of a remote site cannot send one robot out (it loses the relay back to the operator) nor keep the swarm clustered (it cannot reach). The robots must space themselves into a relay chain so each link bridges to the next and the network spans base to objective — the classic line-of-sight relay / mesh-coverage problem.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: military relay chain, sensor-network coverage, communications relay, SC2 scout-line map control
raw.author: openra-bench

summary.en: To keep a distant objective continuously observed, scouts must be spaced in a CHAIN — one per leg of the corridor, each within vision range of the next — so coverage propagates from the base out to the far objective. Sending a single scout all the way forward leaves the corridor uncovered behind it; bunching the scouts together gives reach at one spot but no depth. Only the distributed relay chain holds the whole corridor and the far objective at once.
summary.zh: 为了持续观察远处的目标，侦察兵必须排列在一条链条中——走廊的每条腿上都有一个，每个人都在下一条腿的视野范围内——这样覆盖范围就会从基地传播到远处的目标。派出一名侦察兵一直向前走，后面的走廊就不会被覆盖；将侦察兵聚集在一起只能到达一个地点，但没有深度。只有分布式中继链才能同时掌控整个走廊和远处的目标。

en:
Four jeep scouts and a yard at the west. A hidden enemy cluster sits at the far objective near (108,20). Space the jeeps out — one at relay R1 (45,20), one at R2 (75,20), one all the way onto the objective — so the chain keeps the far cluster observed. Hold all three regions at once, discover at least two enemies, keep the yard, within about 27 turns.
WIN WHEN: get ≥1 units into region (45,20) r=6 AND get ≥1 units into region (75,20) r=6 AND get ≥1 units into region (108,20) r=6 AND spot ≥2 enemy units AND before game tick 2400 AND own ≥1 'fact' building(s).
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 2401 OR NOT (own ≥1 'fact' building(s))).
You have at most 30 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Same four jeeps and yard at the west, but the chain now needs four relay regions held simultaneously: R1 (45,20), R3 (60,20), R2 (75,20), and the far objective near (108,20). With exactly four jeeps every scout holds one leg. Discover three enemies, keep the yard, within about 21 turns.
WIN WHEN: get ≥1 units into region (45,20) r=6 AND get ≥1 units into region (60,20) r=6 AND get ≥1 units into region (75,20) r=6 AND get ≥1 units into region (108,20) r=6 AND spot ≥3 enemy units AND before game tick 1900 AND own ≥1 'fact' building(s).
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 1901 OR NOT (own ≥1 'fact' building(s))).
You have at most 24 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Eight jeeps and a yard sit at the west, but the corridor latitude flips north or south by seed. Either way, hold all four relay regions on your corridor at once — R1, R3, R2, and the far objective — discover three enemies, keep the yard, within about 21 turns. A memorised corridor cell fails on the flipped seed.
WIN WHEN: (get ≥1 units into region (45,13) r=6 AND get ≥1 units into region (60,13) r=6 AND get ≥1 units into region (75,13) r=6 AND get ≥1 units into region (108,13) r=6 AND spot ≥3 enemy units AND before game tick 1900 AND own ≥1 'fact' building(s) OR get ≥1 units into region (45,27) r=6 AND get ≥1 units into region (60,27) r=6 AND get ≥1 units into region (75,27) r=6 AND get ≥1 units into region (108,27) r=6 AND spot ≥3 enemy units AND before game tick 1900 AND own ≥1 'fact' building(s)).

四名吉普车侦察兵和西边的一个院子。一个隐藏的敌人集群位于 (108,20) 附近的远处目标处。将吉普车间隔开——一辆在中继站 R1 (45,20)，一辆在 R2 (75,20)，一辆一直到达目标——这样链条就能保持远处的集群被观察到。在大约 27 个回合内，同时占领所有三个区域，发现至少两个敌人，守住院子。
胜利条件：将 ≥1 个单位放入区域 (45,20) r=6 并且将 ≥1 个单位放入区域 (75,20) r=6 并且将 ≥1 个单位放入区域 (108,20) r=6 并且发现 ≥2 个敌方单位并且在游戏刻 2400 之前并且拥有 ≥1 个“事实”建筑物。
失败条件：（不在游戏前勾选 2401 或不（拥有 ≥1 个“事实”建筑物））。
您最多有 30 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

失败条件：（不在游戏刻 1901 或否之前（拥有 ≥1 个“事实”建筑物））。

title: Squad Handoff — Squad A Delivers, Squad B Takes Over (Wave-2 then:)

raw.realWorldMeaning: Sequenced multi-team operations: team A delivers the first objective, team B takes over for the next, and so on — the order of arrival matters, and a single team cannot serve both legs because each leg requires a SPECIFIC kind of unit. Relay race (baton handoff), construction site handoff (steelworker phase finishes, electrician phase begins), and supply-chain ordered handoff are the everyday analogues.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Multi-robot fleet with role specialisation and sequenced subtasks: the survey drone must reach landmark A before the delivery truck is dispatched to landmark B (the delivery is meaningless without the survey). One fleet cannot do both legs because the drone and the truck are physically different vehicles for different jobs.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: Watch-And-Help concurrent multi-agent handoff, SMAC squad sequencing, military passage of lines doctrine, relay race / construction handoff
raw.author: openra-bench

summary.en: Sequenced multi-team operations: team A delivers the first objective, team B takes over for the next, and so on — the order of arrival matters, and a single team cannot serve both legs because each leg requires a SPECIFIC kind of unit. Relay race (baton handoff), construction site handoff (steelworker phase finishes, electrician phase begins), and supply-chain ordered handoff are the everyday analogues.
summary.zh: 顺序多团队作战：A 队实现第一个目标，B 队接管下一个目标，依此类推 - 到达顺序很重要，并且单个团队无法服务于两条腿，因为每条腿都需要特定类型的单位。接力赛（接力棒交接）、施工现场交接（钢铁工人阶段结束、电工阶段开始）和供应链有序交接是日常的类似情况。

en:
Squad A is three jeeps in the NW; Squad B is three medium tanks in the SW. First land three jeeps in the disc around P1 (50,10), THEN three tanks in the disc around P2 (90,30). The order is enforced. Launch both squads at once and let Squad B hold short of P2 until A's clause latches. Within about 50 turns.
WIN WHEN: in this exact order: get ≥3 'jeep' units into region (50,10) r=8 → THEN → get ≥3 '2tnk' units into region (90,30) r=8 AND before game tick 4500.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 4501 OR your whole force is destroyed).
You have at most 52 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Three jeeps NW, three tanks SW. Three sequenced clauses: jeeps at P1 (50,10), then tanks at P2 (90,30), then jeeps at P3 (60,20). Order is enforced. Launch both squads in parallel; once Squad B lands at P2, redeploy the jeeps from P1 to P3. Within about 50 turns.
WIN WHEN: in this exact order: get ≥3 'jeep' units into region (50,10) r=8 → THEN → get ≥3 '2tnk' units into region (90,30) r=8 → THEN → get ≥3 'jeep' units into region (60,20) r=8 AND before game tick 4500.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 4501 OR your whole force is destroyed).

Order is enforced; clauses alternate vehicle type so a single-squad tour can't cover them. Interleaved parallel dispatch only, within about 50 turns.
WIN WHEN: in this exact order: get ≥3 'jeep' units into region (50,10) r=8 → THEN → get ≥3 '2tnk' units into region (90,30) r=8 → THEN → get ≥3 'jeep' units into region (60,20) r=8 → THEN → get ≥3 '2tnk' units into region (100,15) r=8 AND before game tick 4500.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 4501 OR your whole force is destroyed).
You have at most 52 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.
zh:
A小队在西北方向有三辆吉普车； B小队是SW中的三辆中型坦克。首先将三辆吉普车降落在 P1 (50,10) 周围的圆盘中，然后将三辆坦克降落在 P2 (90,30) 周围的圆盘中。该命令已执行。同时启动两个小队，让 B 小队保持在 P2 附近，直到 A 的条款锁定。大约50转之内。
胜利条件：按照这个顺序：将 ≥3 个“吉普”单位放入区域 (50,10) r=8 → 然后 → 将 ≥3 个“2tnk”单位放入区域 (90,30) r=8 并且在游戏刻 4500 之前。
失败条件：（不是在游戏刻 4501 之前或你的整个部队被摧毁之前）。
您最多有 52 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

胜利条件：按照这个确切的顺序：将≥3个“吉普”单位放入区域（50,10）r=8→然后→将≥3个“2tnk”单位放入区域（90,30）r=8→然后→将≥3个“吉普”单位放入区域（60,20）r=8并且在游戏刻4500之前。
失败条件：（不是在游戏刻 4501 之前或你的整个部队被摧毁之前）。
您最多有 52 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

您最多有 52 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

title: Ordered Rendezvous — Deliver Squads to Waypoints In Sequence

raw.realWorldMeaning: Parallel multi-team delivery under an ordering constraint: waypoint A must be reached before waypoint B before waypoint C, each requiring two or more units present, all within one tight overall window. Skipping or out-of-order delivery does not count. Single-column tours blow the deadline; only concurrent dispatch with leg-by-leg ordering succeeds.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Sequenced multi-depot fleet dispatch with a precedence constraint: team A must arrive at depot 1 before team B may be credited for arriving at depot 2 (e.g. handoff / supply chain), and the overall window does not permit a single team to do all legs in series.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: Watch-And-Help concurrent multi-agent with sequenced sub-tasks, SMAC asymmetric squad sequencing, PERT/CPM precedence-constrained dispatch, supply-chain ordered handoff: depot A before depot B
raw.author: yiyu-tian

summary.en: Parallel multi-team delivery under an ordering constraint: waypoint A must be reached before waypoint B before waypoint C, each requiring two or more units present, all within one tight overall window. Skipping or out-of-order delivery does not count. Single-column tours blow the deadline; only concurrent dispatch with leg-by-leg ordering succeeds.
summary.zh: 排序约束下的并行多团队交付：必须先于航路点 B 到达航路点 C，然后再到达航路点 A，每个航路点都需要两个或更多单位在场，所有这些都在一个紧密的整体窗口内。跳过或无序交付不计算在内。单柱游览打破了最后期限；只有逐条排序的并发调度才能成功。

en:
Two waypoints in order: W1 in the NE at (110,8), then W2 in the SE at (110,32), each requiring two units. A single column touring both legs blows the clock; launch parallel columns and let Squad B wait short of W2 until W1 latches. Within about 24 turns.
WIN WHEN: reach these waypoints IN ORDER (no skipping, no idling): region (110,8) r=3 → then → region (110,32) r=3 AND before game tick 2200.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 2201 OR your whole force is destroyed).
You have at most 40 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Three waypoints in order: NE at (115,6), SW detour at (20,36), then SE at (115,34). Enemy rifles contest the eastern lanes. A single column can't absorb the detour leg — split the force, sequence the arrivals. At most two losses, within about 33 turns.
WIN WHEN: reach these waypoints IN ORDER (no skipping, no idling): region (115,6) r=3 → then → region (20,36) r=3 → then → region (115,34) r=3 AND before game tick 3000 AND lose ≤2 of your own units.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 3001 OR your whole force is destroyed OR NOT (lose ≤2 of your own units)).
You have at most 48 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Four sequenced waypoints — NE (115,6), SW (20,36), SE (115,34), and a mid-east handoff at (60,20) — with enemy rifles and rocket soldiers in the way. Even three squads can't tour the chain as a single column; ordered parallel dispatch only. At most one loss, within about 36 turns.
WIN WHEN: reach these waypoints IN ORDER (no skipping, no idling): region (115,6) r=3 → then → region (20,36) r=3 → then → region (115,34) r=3 → then → region (60,20) r=3 AND before game tick 3200 AND lose ≤1 of your own units.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 3201 OR your whole force is destroyed OR NOT (lose ≤1 of your own units)).
You have at most 52 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.
zh:
两个航路点按顺序排列：W1 位于东北 (110,8) 处，然后 W2 位于东南 (110,32) 处，每个需要两个单位。一根柱子巡行双腿会敲响时钟；发射平行纵队，让 B 小队在 W2 之前等待，直到 W1 锁定。大约24圈之内。
胜利条件：按顺序到达这些航路点（不跳过，不空转）：区域 (110,8) r=3 → 然后 → 区域 (110,32) r=3 并且在游戏刻 2200 之前。
失败条件：（不是在游戏刻 2201 之前或你的整个部队被摧毁之前）。

title: Staggered Windows — Two Docks, Two Deadlines, One Fleet

raw.realWorldMeaning: Warehouse fulfilment with non-aligned per-order SLAs and one packing line per dock: every dock must be staffed during its own shipping window. A single packer touring one dock then the other (the single-column tour) cannot honour both SLAs — the first dock empties while the packer relocates. The advertised capability is parallel multi-fleet dispatch with hold-on-station, not route-planning.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Multi-robot dispatch where each robot team has a job-specific deadline that does not align with the others': teams must launch staggered (the long-haul team first) so that every team is on its own objective during a bounded common arrival window. Serialising one team behind the other blows the global SLA.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: Watch-And-Help concurrent multi-agent, SMAC asymmetric squad timing, MARLÖ multi-objective deadlines, multi-robot dispatch with non-aligned SLAs
raw.author: openra-bench

summary.en: Warehouse fulfilment with non-aligned per-order SLAs and one packing line per dock: every dock must be staffed during its own shipping window. A single packer touring one dock then the other (the single-column tour) cannot honour both SLAs — the first dock empties while the packer relocates. The advertised capability is parallel multi-fleet dispatch with hold-on-station, not route-planning.
summary.zh: 仓库履行采用不统一的每订单 SLA 和每个码头一条包装线：每个码头必须在其自己的运输窗口配备工作人员。单个包装工先巡视一个码头，然后再巡视另一个码头（单列巡视），无法同时遵守这两个 SLA——当包装工搬迁时，第一个码头已空。所宣传的能力是并行多车队调度与驻地，而不是路线规划。

en:
Two docks across the map: an enemy barracks in the NE at (115,6) and an enemy refinery in the SW at (20,34). Park at least three of your units at EACH dock at the same instant — a single column touring A then B leaves A empty when it arrives at B. Split the force and dispatch both squads in parallel, within about 30 turns.
WIN WHEN: get ≥3 units into region (115,6) r=8 AND get ≥3 units into region (20,34) r=8 AND before game tick 2700.
YOU LOSE IF: (your whole force is destroyed OR not before game tick 2701).
You have at most 32 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Two docks across the map: an enemy barracks in the NE at (115,6) and an enemy refinery in the SW at (20,34). Park at least three of your units at EACH dock at the same instant within about 24 turns. The NE leg is much longer than the SW, so the NE squad must launch first (the stagger) with the SW squad following promptly. A single column touring A then B leaves A empty when it arrives at B.
WIN WHEN: get ≥3 units into region (115,6) r=8 AND get ≥3 units into region (20,34) r=8 AND before game tick 2200.
YOU LOSE IF: (your whole force is destroyed OR not before game tick 2201).
You have at most 26 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Three docks, no coordinates given — find them by their building type: an enemy barracks in the NE, a refinery in the SW, a power plant in the SE. Park three units at EACH at the same instant. Three different directions means no single column can cover them; commit to genuine three-way parallel dispatch within about 30 turns.
WIN WHEN: get ≥3 units into the enemy Barracks (barr) in the NORTH-EAST AND get ≥3 units into the enemy Ore Refinery (proc) in the SOUTH-WEST (bottom-left) AND get ≥3 units into the enemy Power Plant (powr) in the SOUTH-EAST AND before game tick 2700.
YOU LOSE IF: (your whole force is destroyed OR not before game tick 2701).
You have at most 32 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.
zh:
地图上有两个码头：东北部 (115,6) 处有一个敌方军营，西南方向 (20,34) 处有一个敌方炼油厂。同时在每个码头至少停放 3 个部队 - 一支纵队巡视 A，然后 B 在到达 B 时将 A 留空。在大约 30 个回合内，分散兵力并并行派遣两个小队。
胜利条件：将 ≥3 个单位放入区域 (115,6) r=8 并且将 ≥3 个单位放入区域 (20,34) r=8 并且在游戏刻 2700 之前。
失败条件：（你的整个部队都被摧毁了，或者在游戏刻 2701 之前没有被摧毁）。
您最多有 32 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

地图上有两个码头：东北部 (115,6) 处有一个敌方军营，西南方向 (20,34) 处有一个敌方炼油厂。在大约 24 个回合内，在每个码头上同时停放至少 3 个单位。 NE 支线比 SW 支线长得多，因此 NE 支队必须首先发射（交错），SW 支队紧随其后。单个纵队巡视 A，然后 B 在到达 B 时将 A 留空。
胜利条件：将 ≥3 个单位放入区域 (115,6) r=8 并且将 ≥3 个单位放入区域 (20,34) r=8 并且在游戏刻 2200 之前。
失败条件：（你的整个部队都被摧毁了，或者在游戏刻 2201 之前没有被摧毁）。
您最多有 26 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

胜利条件：使≥3个单位进入东北部的敌方军营（barr），并让≥3个单位进入西南（左下）的敌方矿石精炼厂（proc），并在游戏刻2700之前，使≥3个单位进入东南部的敌方发电厂（powr）。
失败条件：（你的整个部队都被摧毁了，或者在游戏刻 2701 之前没有被摧毁）。
您最多有 32 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

title: Pure Navigation — Commit a Route and Reach the Goal Zone Before the Clock (No Enemy)

raw.realWorldMeaning: Pure spatial navigation inside a confined custom region with no adversary: read the map, commit a route through the bounded playable area, and drive the force to the designated zone BEFORE a tight, reachable deadline. There is no combat — discrimination comes only from perceiving the target and committing decisively. Idling, dithering, or wandering toward the nearest unexplored cell never reaches the zone in time and LOSES on the clock.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Confined-space autonomous navigation under a deadline (warehouse aisle, indoor map): reach a goal cell within a bounded region from a map read alone, fast enough that hesitation fails the mission.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: ARC spatial reasoning, confined-space autonomous navigation
raw.author: autonomous-loop

summary.en: Pure spatial navigation inside a confined custom region with no adversary: read the map, commit a route through the bounded playable area, and drive the force to the designated zone BEFORE a tight, reachable deadline. There is no combat — discrimination comes only from perceiving the target and committing decisively. Idling, dithering, or wandering toward the nearest unexplored cell never reaches the zone in time and LOSES on the clock.
summary.zh: 在没有对手的有限自定义区域内进行纯粹的空间导航：阅读地图，制定一条穿过有限可玩区域的路线，并在紧迫的、可到达的最后期限之前将部队驱至指定区域。没有战斗——歧视仅来自于感知目标并果断地采取行动。闲置、犹豫或徘徊到最近的未探索单元永远不会及时到达该区域，并且会在时钟上丢失。

en:
No enemy on this map. Move any one of your units into the goal zone near (55,16) at the far east of the playable area, before about turn 10. Idling or wandering loses.
WIN WHEN: get a unit into region (55,16) r=5 AND before game tick 900.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 901 OR your whole force is destroyed).
You have at most 14 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Same idea, longer reach: the goal zone sits at (72,16) and EVERY unit — not just the fast scout — must arrive. Plan the route and march the whole squad straight east, within about 17 turns.
WIN WHEN: get EVERY unit into region (72,16) r=5 AND before game tick 1500.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 1501 OR your whole force is destroyed).
You have at most 20 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

The goal zone sits at the far east-central edge of the playable area, but you aren't given coordinates — read it off the minimap. Your spawn latitude flips by seed, so a memorised route fails. March the whole squad due east; every unit must arrive within about 18 turns.
WIN WHEN: get EVERY unit into the goal zone at the FAR EAST-CENTRAL edge of the playable area (right side of the map, vertically centred — march your whole squad straight east from the spawn) AND before game tick 1600.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 1601 OR your whole force is destroyed).
You have at most 22 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.
zh:
这张地图上没有敌人。在大约第 10 回合之前，将您的任何一个单位移至可玩区域远东 (55,16) 附近的目标区域。空转或徘徊失败。
胜利条件：将一个单位放入区域 (55,16) r=5 并且在游戏刻 900 之前。
失败条件：（不是在游戏刻 901 之前或你的整个部队被摧毁之前）。
您最多有 14 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

同样的想法，更远的距离：球门区位于 (72,16)，每个单位——不仅仅是快速侦察兵——都必须到达。规划好路线，让整个小队一直向东行进，大约需要 17 个转弯。
胜利条件：将每个单位放入区域 (72,16) r=5 并且在游戏刻 1500 之前。
失败条件：（不在游戏刻 1501 之前或你的整个部队被摧毁之前）。

title: Bridge Chokepoint — defend every crossing before they reach you

raw.realWorldMeaning: Geographic chokepoint defense. A barrier (water) channels every attacker through a small number of crossings (bridges). The defender must (a) flip the engagement stance so units fire, AND (b) distribute forces across every crossing — concentrating on one bridge leaves the others wide open and their assets fall.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Perimeter defense around a facility with a moat and discrete gates. Guards posted on standby must be told to engage AND stationed at EACH gate — an undefended gate is a free corridor for the intruder to reach the nearest asset.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: ERQA spatial commit (read terrain → assign defenders to chokepoints), MicroRTS chokepoint defense, military doctrine: defense at obstacle-channelized terrain
raw.author: openra-bench

summary.en: Geographic chokepoint defense. A barrier (water) channels every attacker through a small number of crossings (bridges). summary.zh: 地理阻塞点防御。屏障（水）引导每个攻击者通过少量的交叉口（桥梁）。防守方必须（a）翻转交战姿态，以便单位开火，并且（b）在每个交叉口分配兵力——集中在一座桥梁上，其他桥梁敞开，他们的资产就会掉落。

en:
A water band cuts the map east-to-west with a single bridge at the centre (x=32). Six rifle infantry attack from the north. Your six defenders (rifle infantry) sit south of the bridge on hold-fire orders — they will NOT shoot, even if shot at, until ordered. Keep your Construction Yard alive and kill at least four attackers within about 30 turns.
WIN WHEN: destroy ≥4 enemy units AND own a 'fact' AND before game tick 2700.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 2701 OR NOT (own a 'fact')).
You have at most 35 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Three bridges (x=12, x=32, x=52) cross the water. One ore refinery sits directly behind EACH bridge — if a bridge is uncontested, the attackers there destroy its refinery. Six rifle infantry attack through EACH bridge. Your twelve defenders are clustered south of the centre bridge on hold-fire orders. Keep all three refineries and the Construction Yard alive, kill at least eight attackers, within about 40 turns.
WIN WHEN: destroy ≥8 enemy units AND own a 'fact' AND before game tick 3150 AND own ≥3 'proc' building(s).
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 3151 OR NOT (own a 'fact') OR NOT (own ≥3 'proc' building(s))).
You have at most 40 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 3601 OR NOT (own a 'fact') OR NOT (own ≥3 'proc' building(s))).
You have at most 45 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

title: Counter-Battery — Kill the Artillery FIRST

raw.realWorldMeaning: A frontline of enemy rifle infantry screens two or three long-range artillery pieces posted in the rear. The artillery out-ranges the base pillboxes and shells the construction yard from a standoff the static defences cannot answer. The mobile tank force must perform a counter-battery strike: drive past the infantry screen and destroy the artillery FIRST, before it razes the construction yard. Trading fire with the screening infantry while the artillery keeps firing loses the base — the highest-impact threat must be engaged first, not the nearest one.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Military counter-battery doctrine and threat prioritisation: when a hostile asset is degrading your objective from beyond your defences' reach, the correct response is a targeted strike that neutralises that asset first, even though a nearer, louder threat is competing for attention. Spending the response on the screening force while the real threat keeps operating is the canonical prioritisation failure — the same shape as a SC2 siege-tank counter, where a mobile force must close on and kill the out-ranging siege line rather than trade with its escort.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: military counter-battery doctrine, threat prioritization, SC2 siege-tank counter
raw.author: openra-bench

summary.en: A frontline of enemy rifle infantry screens two or three long-range artillery pieces posted in the rear. The artillery out-ranges the base pillboxes and shells the construction yard from a standoff the static defences cannot answer. The mobile tank force must perform a counter-battery strike: drive past the infantry screen and destroy the artillery FIRST, before it razes the construction yard. Trading fire with the screening infantry while the artillery keeps firing loses the base — the highest-impact threat must be engaged first, not the nearest one.
summary.zh: 前线的敌方步枪步兵掩护后方的两到三门远程火炮。火炮的射程超出了基地碉堡，并从静态防御无法应对的对峙中炮击施工场地。机动坦克部队必须进行反炮兵打击：驶过步兵掩护并首先摧毁火炮，然后再将建筑场夷为平地。在大炮持续射击的情况下与掩护步兵交火会失去基地——必须首先对付影响最大的威胁，而不是最近的威胁。

en:
Your construction yard at (20,21) is ringed by two pillboxes; four medium tanks sit just west. Fifteen enemy riflemen screen two long-range artillery in the rear — the artillery outranges your pillboxes and is already shelling the yard. Drive the tanks past the screen, kill BOTH guns first, then mop up the rifles. Twelve kills, yard intact, within about 30 turns.
WIN WHEN: destroy ≥12 enemy units AND own ≥1 'fact' building(s) AND before game tick 2700.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 2701 OR NOT (own ≥1 'fact' building(s)) OR your whole force is destroyed).
You have at most 30 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Three pillboxes ring the yard; six tanks stage just west. The enemy line packs twenty-one rifles with three artillery pieces behind them, and the heavier battery razes the yard fast. Punch through to all three guns first, then clean the screen. Fourteen kills, yard intact, within about 30 turns.
WIN WHEN: destroy ≥14 enemy units AND own ≥1 'fact' building(s) AND before game tick 2700.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 2701 OR NOT (own ≥1 'fact' building(s)) OR your whole force is destroyed).
You have at most 30 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Your yard and twelve tanks stage in the NORTH (y=14) or SOUTH (y=28) band by seed; the enemy mirrors at the same latitude with twenty-one rifles screening three long-range guns. Same doctrine — silence the guns first, then sweep the screen. Fourteen kills, yard intact, within about 30 turns.
WIN WHEN: destroy ≥14 enemy units AND own ≥1 'fact' building(s) AND before game tick 2700.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 2701 OR NOT (own ≥1 'fact' building(s)) OR your whole force is destroyed).
You have at most 30 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.
zh:
你位于（20,21）的建筑场地被两个碉堡包围；四辆中型坦克位于西边。十五名敌方步枪手在后方掩护两门远程火炮——这些火炮的射程超出了你的碉堡，并且已经在炮击院子了。驾驶坦克经过屏幕，先杀死两门枪，然后清理步枪。大约 30 回合内，完成 12 次击杀，码数完好。
胜利条件：摧毁 ≥12 个敌方单位并拥有 ≥1 个“事实”建筑物且在游戏刻 2700 之前。
失败条件：（不是在游戏刻 2701 之前，或者不（拥有 ≥1 个“事实”建筑物），或者你的整个部队被摧毁）。
您最多有 30 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

三个碉堡环绕着院子；六辆坦克舞台就在西边。敌方阵线有二十一支步枪，后面还有三门火炮，较重的炮台很快就把院子夷为平地。首先击穿所有三把枪，然后清洁屏幕。大约 30 回合内，完成 14 次击杀，码数完好。

title: Engineer Repair Under Fire — Triage the Damaged Proc While Engaging

raw.realWorldMeaning: Multiple of your structures are under sustained attrition from a concentrated grenadier-led rusher band, with the refinery (ore refinery) — the most-critical, income-bearing building — exposed at the front of the base. You must keep the ore refinery alive by engaging autorepair (`repair`) the moment damage starts AND commit the pre-placed defenders (hold-fire on spawn) to kill the attackers. Stalling lets the ore refinery die; engaging without repair lets cumulative grenade damage drop the ore refinery before the band is cleared; toggling repair without offensive output never clears the attackers and busts the kill bar / clock. The intended triage is: prioritise the most-damaged AND most-critical building (the ore refinery) for repair, while the defenders do the killing.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Disaster-recovery / SRE triage: a sustained incident damages multiple services and the operator must (a) identify the most-critical-and-most-damaged subsystem (the income-bearing refinery here, the production database in SRE), (b) engage the repair organ on it WHILE (c) the on-call team contains the attacker. Stalling loses the critical subsystem; pure-engage / pure-repair single-axis plays both bust the SLA.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: disaster recovery, SC2 SCV repair, repair-order triage
raw.author: openra-bench

title: Evacuate the Doomed Base — Retreat East to the Safe Zone

raw.realWorldMeaning: The primary base is being overrun by a heavy assault that structurally cannot be repelled with the units on hand — the construction yard and ore refinery WILL fall regardless of what the agent does. The correct play is not to fight the doomed-defence (sunk cost) but to EVACUATE the remaining mobile force EAST to a pre-designated safe zone before attrition reduces the column below the survival floor. Win = ≥3 of the 5 starting tanks inside the safe-zone radius, ≥3 still alive, before the deadline. Stalling loses (the assault wipes the immobile tanks at the base); holding loses (the heavy + rocket composition out-trades the medium tank column); only the prompt EVAC-east order wins.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Business-Continuity-Planning (BCP) evacuation and NFPA / FEMA emergency-management EVAC doctrine — when shelter-in-place is no longer survivable, the policy must abandon the compromised site and route to the pre-designated muster point. Same pattern in cloud-incident response (drain a region under irrecoverable outage to a healthy peer), in wildfire and chemical-spill EVAC, and in SC2 GG-walk macro micro (preserve the army when the base cannot be saved).
raw.benchmarkAnchor: BCP evacuation (business continuity planning), emergency management EVAC (NFPA / FEMA muster-point doctrine), SC2 retreat / GG-walk: preserve army when base is doomed, cloud incident region-drain to healthy peer
raw.author: openra-bench

Stalling loses (the assault wipes the immobile tanks at the base); holding loses (the heavy + rocket composition out-trades the medium tank column); only the prompt EVAC-east order wins.
summary.zh: 主要基地正在遭受猛烈攻击，在结构上无法用现有单位击退——无论特工做什么，建筑场和矿石精炼厂都会陷落。正确的策略不是对抗注定失败的防御（沉没成本），而是在消耗减少生存层以下的纵队之前将剩余的机动部队从东疏散到预先指定的安全区域。获胜 = 安全区半径内的 5 辆起始坦克中≥3 辆，且在截止时间前≥3 辆仍然活着。拖延失败（攻击消灭了基地里不动的坦克）；持有失败（重型+火箭组合超过中型坦克列）；只有提示 EVAC-east 命令获胜。

title: Defense in Depth — Two Bands Beat One Thick Wall

raw.realWorldMeaning: A heavy enemy wave drives straight at your construction yard. The same finite pillbox budget massed into ONE thick wall has no depth: when the wave punches a hole, the survivors sail through the breach and raze the base. The SAME pillboxes split into a FRONT line (which absorbs and thins the first impact) plus a REAR line at greater depth (which shreds the survivors that break through) contains the breach instead of suffering it. Same resources, different topology, qualitatively different survivability. The win predicate makes the topology decision load-bearing: total pillbox count alone is not enough — the pillboxes must be split across two non-overlapping depth bands, the construction yard must survive, and the wave must actually be destroyed.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Layered security architecture (defense-in-depth): a single perimeter firewall, however thick, eventually gets breached; the same defensive capacity deployed as an outer layer plus an inner layer absorbs the breach — a single component failure is contained, not catastrophic. The same logic as a medieval keep behind an outer wall (the attacker must take BOTH), or redundant systems architecture where one failure does not bring down the system.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: military defense-in-depth, security layered defense, MicroRTS defense
raw.author: openra-bench

title: Defense in Depth — Two Layers, Not One Thick Wall

raw.realWorldMeaning: Defense-in-depth doctrine: against a massed concentrated rush, a front line plus a second line at greater depth shreds the attacker after the first layer falls, where a single fortified line — even one with the same brick count — eventually collapses under sustained pressure and razes the base behind it. Picking concentration vs distribution is the reasoning load: the same four pillboxes massed in one cluster lose, the same four pillboxes spread thin in one long line lose, and only a 2+2 layered topology survives.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Multi-layer security architecture (defense-in-depth): a single perimeter firewall, however thick, eventually gets breached; the same defensive capacity deployed as outer + inner layers (each covering the same arc) absorbs the breach. Same total resources, different topology, qualitatively different survivability. Also: medieval keep + outer-wall design (attackers must take BOTH); redundant systems architecture (one component failure ≠ system failure).
raw.benchmarkAnchor: military defense-in-depth doctrine, security multi-layer architecture (defense-in-depth), medieval keep + outer wall design, redundant systems architecture
raw.author: openra-bench

summary.en: Defense-in-depth doctrine: against a massed concentrated rush, a front line plus a second line at greater depth shreds the attacker after the first layer falls, where a single fortified line — even one with the same brick count — eventually collapses under sustained pressure and razes the base behind it. Picking concentration vs distribution is the reasoning load: the same four pillboxes massed in one cluster lose, the same four pillboxes spread thin in one long line lose, and only a 2+2 layered topology survives.
summary.zh: 纵深防御学说：针对大规模集中冲锋，第一层攻陷后，一条前线加上第二条更深入的防线将攻击者撕碎，其中一条防御线——即使是砖块数量相同的——最终在持续压力下崩溃，并将其后面的基地夷为平地。选择集中度与分布度是推理负载：相同的四个碉堡集中在一簇中失败，相同的四个碉堡分散在一长线上失败，并且只有 2+2 分层拓扑幸存。

title: Distributed Defense — Split Across Concurrent Lanes

raw.realWorldMeaning: Enemy waves attack the centrally-placed base concurrently from multiple cardinal directions. Distributing defenders evenly across each active lane holds every approach; concentrating on one lane leaves the other lanes uncontested — those waves stride untouched to the construction yard and raze it. This is the canonical multi-front / graph min-cut allocation problem: defensive capacity must be matched to the cardinality of concurrent threats, not to the loudest single threat.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Distributed-systems load balancing under N concurrent request streams: each stream needs at least one worker, or its queue builds without bound and the SLA breaks regardless of how well the other streams are served. Likewise air-defence sector coverage: pooling all batteries in one sector leaves the others open. Same total capacity, different topology, qualitatively different system survivability.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: distributed-systems load balancing, graph min-cut, military multi-front
raw.author: openra-bench

summary.en: Enemy waves attack the centrally-placed base concurrently from multiple cardinal directions. summary.zh: 敌军从多个主要方向同时攻击位于中心的基地。将防守者均匀地分布在每个有效车道上可以控制每一种进攻；集中在一条车道上，而其他车道则不受竞争——那些波浪毫发无伤地大步冲向建筑场地并将其夷为平地。这是典型的多前沿/图最小切割分配问题：防御能力必须与并发威胁的基数相匹配，而不是与最大的单一威胁相匹配。

title: Fortify the Threat Axis — Pre-Position Defence on the Intel Lane

raw.realWorldMeaning: Spatial commitment of a finite defence budget to the CORRECT direction given declared intel. title: Scout the Axis, Then Fortify — Intel-Driven Adaptive Defense

raw.realWorldMeaning: Adaptive defense under uncertainty: the threat axis is NOT known a priori; the agent must drive its scouts to discover the enemy's forward outpost (where the build-up actually is), then commit pillboxes on THAT lane, then engage. Pre-committing to a single direction without scouting is the classical Maginot-Line failure mode — defenses on the wrong axis are dead weight while the unguarded lane is overrun. The capability under test is the intel-action loop: observation FIRST, commitment SECOND.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Intel-driven facility hardening / military reactive defense: a perimeter operator does not know which gate will be breached; they must dispatch reconnaissance, confirm the threat axis from sensor returns, and then deploy barriers / responders on the confirmed lane. Skipping the reconnaissance step and pre-staging on a guessed lane is correct half the time and catastrophically wrong the other half. The robust doctrine is scout-then-fortify, not commit-on-faith.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: PlanBench replanning, military reactive defense, intel-driven defense
raw.author: openra-bench

summary.en: Adaptive defense under uncertainty: the threat axis is NOT known a priori; the agent must drive its scouts to discover the enemy's forward outpost (where the build-up actually is), then commit pillboxes on THAT lane, then engage. The capability under test is the intel-action loop: observation FIRST, commitment SECOND.
summary.zh: 不确定性下的自适应防御：威胁轴未知；特工必须驾驶侦察兵发现敌人的前沿前哨（实际集结的地方），然后在该车道上设置碉堡，然后交战。在没有侦察的情况下预先致力于单一方向是典型的马其诺防线失败模式——错误轴线上的防御是自重，而无人防守的车道则被冲破。接受测试的能力是情报行动循环：观察第一，承诺第二。

title: Central Reserve — Stage Mobile Force at Centre, Move Out to Intercept

raw.realWorldMeaning: A rush is incoming, but the flank it will arrive from is uncertain at decision time. A small mobile armoured reserve is pre-staged at the centre of the engagement zone — equidistant from both candidate flanks. The reserve MUST move OUT of the centre toward the localised threat lane(s) to intercept the rush before it reaches the construction yard. Pre-committing to one flank wins only when the rush arrives on that flank and LOSES otherwise (the reserve cannot pivot back in time); holding passively at the centre lets the auto-engagement kill some attackers but satisfies no forward-zone objective. The canonical answer is centralisation + forward commitment — military "general reserve" / chess centralization doctrine.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Quick-reaction force / on-call incident responder: the responder is stationed at a hub equidistant from candidate incident sites, not committed to any one site in advance. When an alert localises the incident, the responder DEPLOYS FORWARD to that site — staying at the hub or committing in advance to the wrong site both fail the response SLA.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: military reserve doctrine (central reserve responds to any flank), chess-piece centralization principle, rapid-response force doctrine, MicroRTS reactive defense from centre
raw.author: openra-bench

title: Reactive Defense — Reinforce the Breached Lane

raw.realWorldMeaning: A multi-lane defence with a mobile armoured reserve held uncommitted at the centre. At first both lanes face only a light probe, but mid-episode one lane is BREACHED by a heavier wave. The light garrison there cannot hold the breach alone; the agent must react — read which lane was breached — and shift the mobile reserve FORWARD into that lane to reinforce it before the line collapses. Holding the reserve at the centre, or committing it to the quiet lane, lets the breach overrun the line. The pack tests reactive reserve commitment: identify the developing breach and commit the reserve to the sector that is actually being hit.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Incident surge response: an on-call response team is staged centrally, equidistant from candidate sites. When one site escalates into a breach, the surge capacity must be committed to THAT site — promptly and in force. Holding the reserve back or dispatching it to a quiet site both fail the response: the skill is reading where the main effort has localised and committing the reserve there.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: military reserve commitment, reinforce the breach doctrine, incident surge response
raw.author: openra-bench

summary.en: A multi-lane defence with a mobile armoured reserve held uncommitted at the centre. At first both lanes face only a light probe, but mid-episode one lane is BREACHED by a heavier wave. Holding the reserve at the centre, or committing it to the quiet lane, lets the breach overrun the line. The pack tests reactive reserve commitment: identify the developing breach and commit the reserve to the sector that is actually being hit.
summary.zh: 多车道防御，机动装甲预备队在中心不设防。起初，两条车道都只面临着轻微的探测器，但在情节中期，一条车道被更重的波浪冲破了。那里的轻装部队无法单独守住突破口；特工必须做出反应——读取哪条车道被突破——并将移动预备队向前转移到该车道，以在防线崩溃之前进行加固。将预备队控制在中心，或者将其放在安静的车道上，让突破口越过防线。该包测试反应储备承诺：识别正在发生的违规行为并将储备承诺给实际受到打击的部门。

title: Strategic Withdrawal — Retreat from the Forward Base and Rebuild at Depth

raw.realWorldMeaning: The forward base is being overrun by a heavy attack that cannot be repulsed inside the tick / cash budget; the right move is to ACCEPT THE LOSS of the forward position, fall back to a deeper safe zone (pre-staged with an MCV and a power plant), DEPLOY the MCV to spawn a new Construction Yard there, and BUILD a refinery so production stands up at depth. Trying to hold the forward base bleeds the defenders and the deadline expires with neither base alive. Stalling, hold-forward, or deploy-only-no-rebuild all lose: only the recognise-and-withdraw policy reconstitutes a live construction yard + ore refinery post-retreat.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Business-continuity failover and military strategic withdrawal: the primary production site is being lost and heroic defence is infeasible; standing up the cold-standby site (DR site, backup datacentre, fall-back command post) BEFORE the primary fully falls is the goal, not preserving the primary. The policy must read the situation as "lost cause, withdraw" and redirect resources to the standby instead of doubling down.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: strategic withdrawal / CICERO retreat doctrine, PlanBench replanning under exogenous loss, business continuity / disaster recovery failover, military trade-space-for-time fall-back
raw.author: openra-bench

title: Ambush Trigger Discipline — Lift Stance to Engage the Inbound Rush

raw.realWorldMeaning: A defended-overwatch / ambush trigger drill: four medium tanks are pre-staged at a choke between the inbound enemy column and the construction yard. Their standing orders are HoldFire (stance:0) — they will not fire on their own. The mission is to call `set_stance` to lift the engagement authority so all four tanks auto-engage the rush at cannon range and wipe it before it reaches the base. Never flipping the stance leaves the position functionally undefended (the rush walks through unopposed and razes the base); the controllable verb that turns the pre-staged position into an active defence is the stance flip.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: A weapon-system safety interlock: a turret / drone-swarm perimeter is pre-staged and aimed at the avenue of approach, but the trigger authority is held by the operator. The operator MUST issue the engagement-authority command for the system to fire on the inbound target; without that command the perimeter is functionally a passive observation post and the target reaches the protected asset. The skill is the operator's decision to LIFT the engagement-authority lock at all — not the precise moment within the engagement window.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: military rules-of-engagement (ROE) ambush doctrine, SC2 stance micro — hold-then-attack siege-tank salvo, ambush doctrine — engagement authority lifted on trigger
raw.author: openra-bench

title: Surprise Flank — Intel Said North, Enemy Came South: Detect and Redeploy

raw.realWorldMeaning: The mission brief states the enemy will attack from the NORTH and the terrain reinforces it: a rocky band on the north edge forms a natural chokepoint, with two pillboxes pre-built to cover it. The four pre-placed defenders are distributed around the construction yard — not yet committed to either lane. MID-EPISODE a rusher band actually arrives from the SOUTH (the open flank) via a scheduled spawn. The decision is whether the agent trusts the announced direction + terrain cue and watches its construction yard get razed, or detects the actual attack axis from the spawn event, leaves the wrong-axis pillboxes silent, and commits the defenders SOUTH to intercept the real rush before it reaches the construction yard.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Misdirection-aware defence / military adversarial robustness on a directional axis: a fortified flank that the enemy has bypassed must be ABANDONED in favour of the actual contact axis, even though doing so contradicts the announced plan and "wastes" the pre-built fortification. The classical failure mode this trains against is "fighting the plan, not the enemy": the operator sticks to the announced threat axis even after the ground-truth signal contradicts it. Robust security operations require that the response policy treat announced threat intelligence as a PRIOR, not a guarantee, and commit to the observed axis when the two diverge.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: adversarial robustness / surprise-axis reaction, opponent-modeling: detect deception, military reactive defense / flank discipline, CICERO deception handling
raw.author: openra-bench

MID-EPISODE a rusher band actually arrives from the SOUTH (the open flank) via a scheduled spawn. The decision is whether the agent trusts the announced direction + terrain cue and watches its construction yard get razed, or detects the actual attack axis from the spawn event, leaves the wrong-axis pillboxes silent, and commits the defenders SOUTH to intercept the real rush before it reaches the construction yard.
summary.zh: 任务简报指出，敌人将从北部发起进攻，而地形也强化了这一点：北部边缘的一条岩石带形成了一个天然的咽喉要道，并预先建造了两个碉堡来覆盖它。四名预先安排好的防守队员分布在施工场地周围——尚未分配到任何一条车道上。剧情中期，一支冲锋队实际上从南部（空旷的侧翼）按照预定的重生点抵达。决策是智能体是否信任所宣布的方向+地形提示并观察其施工场地被夷为平地，或者从重生事件中检测实际的攻击轴，让错误轴的碉堡保持沉默，并让防御者向南拦截真正的冲锋，然后再到达施工场地。

title: Defense Topology — Match Towers to Threat Geometry (Line or Cluster)

raw.realWorldMeaning: Defensive structure placement is geometry-sensitive: a wide-front attack across many rows demands a LINE that covers each row; a concentrated thrust through one chokepoint demands a CLUSTER of overlapping fire at the choke. Both topologies waste budget on the wrong geometry — a cluster against a spread attack leaves the flanks open; a line against a funnel under-defends the choke. The capability is reading the attacker's forcing geometry from the map and the threat composition, then committing the defense topology that matches.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Firewall / WAF rule placement. When traffic enters across many paths (broad ingress, microservices), the right architecture is a rule per path — a layered spread. When all traffic MUST traverse a single ingress (one API gateway, one bridge), the right architecture is dense layered inspection AT that point. A defender who deploys the wrong topology for the wrong threat surface either overspends on one path and leaves others open, or under-protects the actual ingress.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: graph theory min-cut (concentrate defenses at chokepoints), military bunker placement doctrine, firewall topology: dense at chokepoints, perimeter doctrine (cover the full approach width), Lanchester defense concentration
raw.author: openra-bench

summary.zh: 防御结构的布局对几何形状敏感：跨多行的宽前攻击需要一条覆盖每一行的线；通过一个咽喉要道的集中推力需要在咽喉要道上进行一簇重叠火力。这两种拓扑都在错误的几何结构上浪费了预算——针对扩散攻击的集群使侧翼处于开放状态；与漏斗相连的线对扼流圈的防御不足。该功能是从地图和威胁构成中读取攻击者的强制几何结构，然后提交匹配的防御拓扑。
