title: Defense Doctrine — Walls vs Towers per Tier

raw.realWorldMeaning: Defensive doctrine selection: the same budget buys different postures. An open frontal arc needs ACTIVE covering fires (pillbox pillboxes). A numerically overwhelming horde on one lane needs PASSIVE channelisation (a brik wall barrier) plus a single pillbox at the choke to shred the queue. A mixed two-lane attack forces a TRADEOFF: choke one lane, cover the other. A memorised "always-towers" or "always-walls" play fails the tier where its posture is wrong.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Defensive doctrine: an open arc demands covering fires; a single overwhelming axis demands channelisation (obstacle belt + fires at the choke); a mixed threat demands force allocation across postures. The same budget produces wildly different outcomes depending on which doctrine matches the geometry — a general who always builds towers loses the horde lane and one who always builds walls loses the open arc.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: security architecture, passive vs active mitigation, military fortification
raw.author: openra-bench

summary.en: Defensive doctrine selection: the same budget buys different postures. An open frontal arc needs ACTIVE covering fires (pillbox pillboxes). A numerically overwhelming horde on one lane needs PASSIVE channelisation (a brik wall barrier) plus a single pillbox at the choke to shred the queue. A mixed two-lane attack forces a TRADEOFF: choke one lane, cover the other. A memorised "always-towers" or "always-walls" play fails the tier where its posture is wrong.
summary.zh: 防御学说选择：相同的预算买不同的姿势。开放的额弧需要主动火力掩护（药盒药盒）。一条车道上人数众多的人群需要被动通道化（砖墙屏障）以及在阻塞处的单个碉堡来粉碎队列。混合两路攻击需要权衡：堵塞一条路，掩护另一条路。记住的“永远是塔”或“永远是墙”的玩法因姿势错误而失败。

title: Defend While Building — Concurrent Defence + Construction Under Active Attack

raw.realWorldMeaning: While the enemy is already attacking your base, you must build new pillboxes AND command your pre-placed (HoldFire) tank defenders to attack the rush — IN PARALLEL, every turn. The tanks will NOT engage on their own; only an explicit attack_unit / attack_move order makes them fight. Pausing the pillbox queue to micro the tanks loses the production race (the pillbox bar is never met before the deadline). Pausing the tank defence to focus on building loses the construction yard (the idle HoldFire tanks let the rush walk through and raze the construction yard). Only a play that streams both — queue pillbox AND command tanks every turn from t=0 — wins inside the budget. The win predicate makes this load-bearing by requiring BOTH the pillbox count bar AND the construction yard-alive bar AND a kill floor, all before a tight deadline.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: SRE simultaneous incident-response + capacity-add: the on-call must contain the live incident (defence) WHILE provisioning additional capacity (construction) to absorb the increased load; serialising the two — pause provisioning to fight the fire, then provision after — busts the MTTR / capacity-SLA window. Same pattern in military business-continuity (combat engineers emplace fortifications under direct fire while line units engage), ops triage during incident (multiple work streams must advance in parallel), and disaster-recovery failover (route traffic to the spare WHILE rebuilding the primary).
raw.benchmarkAnchor: SRE simultaneous incident-response, business continuity, ops triage during incident
raw.author: openra-bench

summary.zh: 当敌人已经攻击你的基地时，你必须建造新的碉堡并命令你预先放置的（HoldFire）坦克防御者攻击冲锋——每回合并行。坦克不会自行交战；只有明确的attack_unit/attack_move命令才会让他们战斗。暂停碉堡队列以微型坦克会输掉生产竞赛（碉堡栏在截止日期之前从未达到）。暂停坦克防御以专注于建筑会失去施工场地（闲置的 HoldFire 坦克会让冲锋穿过并夷平施工场地）。只有从 t=0 开始每回合都同时传输队列药丸和命令坦克的游戏才能在预算范围内获胜。获胜谓词通过要求碉堡计数栏、建筑场活动栏和杀戮层来实现这一承载，所有这些都在紧迫的期限之前完成。

title: Fog Ambush — Hold the Hidden Flank, Let the Enemy Walk Past

raw.realWorldMeaning: Defenders are pre-staged in concealment OFF the direct enemy axis, forming an L-ambush crossfire at the lane. A static fixing element at the choke draws the enemy push down the lane; the concealed flanking elements remain hidden until the band commits, then strike from BOTH flanks. Breaking the ambush — charging the flankers forward to meet the push in the open, or pulling them back onto the construction yard — abandons the crossfire geometry: the charging force strings out and is out-attritioned head-on, and the stacked force is crowded against the base and ground down. The canonical answer is to HOLD the ambush positions and let the engine auto-engage on sight as the band passes. SC2 hidden-defense / military ambush doctrine.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Concealed intrusion-detection sensors / honeypot networks / silent-alarm doctrine: instrumented assets remain off the intruder's primary path and trigger when the intruder commits past them. Moving the sensors out of their concealed positions — forward to confront the intruder, or back onto the asset being protected — defeats the asymmetry of concealment.

title: Hold the Line — Survive an Opening Rush While Sustaining Throughput

raw.realWorldMeaning: Opening rush-defense while sustaining baseline economy growth: a concentrated enemy charge arrives in the first ~30 turns and a pre-placed base + a fixed budget must both blunt the spike AND keep fielding capability. Cannot pause throughput (the win demands an active force) AND cannot ignore the threat (the win demands the rushers handled before the deadline) — both must be sustained simultaneously inside a tight window. Stalling, all-defense (only static turrets, no force), all-economy (no static defense), and brute-army (no static defense) all fail; the intended balanced spend — one pillbox covering the lane mouth plus a handful of defenders trained from the pre-placed barracks — wins.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: On-call defending production capacity under a live attack without dropping baseline SLA: a single concentrated incident hits a pre-deployed site (factory floor / web tier), and the operator must both contain the spike (add a hardened defence at the choke) AND keep the line running (deploy active workers / pods) before the incident clock expires. Pausing throughput to fight, or fighting without hardening, both bust the SLA.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: MicroRTS rush-defense, SC2LE defend-the-cheese tempo, TextStarCraft II opening defense, incident response: production infra under DDoS while sustaining throughput
raw.author: openra-bench

summary.en: Opening rush-defense while sustaining baseline economy growth: a concentrated enemy charge arrives in the first ~30 turns and a pre-placed base + a fixed budget must both blunt the spike AND keep fielding capability. Cannot pause throughput (the win demands an active force) AND cannot ignore the threat (the win demands the rushers handled before the deadline) — both must be sustained simultaneously inside a tight window. Stalling, all-defense (only static turrets, no force), all-economy (no static defense), and brute-army (no static defense) all fail; the intended balanced spend — one pillbox covering the lane mouth plus a handful of defenders trained from the pre-placed barracks — wins.
summary.zh: 开放紧急防御，同时维持基线经济增长：敌人的集中冲锋在前 30 个回合内到达，预先布置的基地 + 固定预算必须既能抑制峰值，又能保持部署能力。不能暂停吞吐量（胜利需要积极的力量），也不能忽视威胁（胜利要求冲锋者在截止日期前处理）——两者都必须在狭窄的窗口内同时维持。失速、全防御（只有静态炮塔，无武力）、全经济（无静态防御）、野蛮军队（无静态防御）均失败；预期的平衡支出——一个覆盖巷口的碉堡加上一些从预先安置的营房训练的防守者——获胜。

title: Burn-Rate Management — Spend at the Right Pace (Startup Runway)

raw.realWorldMeaning: A sustained cash-rate decision: the agent has a productive income engine (two harvesters on two near patches feeding a refinery — steady ~190 cr/turn), a starting balance of $1500, a war factory + barracks for converting cash into military force, 3 pre-placed medium tanks ready to engage, and a pre-placed enemy garrison to defeat. Winning REQUIRES landing cash in a target BAND [MIN, MAX] at the latch tick AND racking up K kills AND keeping the construction yard intact. Stalling or pure-hoarding pushes cash ABOVE the upper bound (the bank overflows, no progress on the combat bar). Burning every credit on units and buildings drops cash BELOW the lower bound (no reserve, no slack against the next shock). Only a SUSTAINED burn at the income-replenishment rate — converting cash to a small but sufficient combat force while using the existing strike force to clear the garrison — hits the band on the kill-bar turn.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Operating-rate management in a startup's treasury: burn cash on capability development at the rate that buys ongoing runway, not zero (no capability progress — the deadline arrives with no product) and not all-at-once (the reserve hits zero and the next shock — a key hire, an unexpected legal cost — collapses the company). The discipline being measured is the operations-finance LOOP at sustained pace, not a one-time allocation. The cash band is the operating-reserve discipline; the kill bar is the capability-delivery discipline; the two must be satisfied SIMULTANEOUSLY at the deadline.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: startup runway management, corporate burn rate, financial discipline, SC2 mineral-bank overflow (spend down at sustained rate), operating-rate / cash-conversion-rate discipline
raw.author: openra-bench

summary.zh: 持续的现金利率决策：特工有一个生产性收入引擎（两个附近的地块上有两台收割机为炼油厂提供饲料——稳定~190 cr/转），起始余额为 1500 美元，一个战争工厂+用于将现金转化为军事力量的兵营，3 辆预先放置的中型坦克准备交战，以及预先放置的敌方驻军以供击败。获胜需要在闩锁滴答声处将现金投入目标范围[最小，最大]，并完成 K 次击杀并保持施工场地完好无损。停滞或纯粹囤积将现金推至上限之上（银行溢出，战斗条上没有进展）。燃烧单位和建筑物上的所有信用会使现金降至下限以下（没有储备，没有应对下一次冲击的余裕）。只有以收入补充率持续烧钱——将现金转化为一支小规模但足够的战斗部队，同时利用现有的打击力量清除驻军——才能在杀戮酒吧转弯时击中乐队。

en:

title: Capex vs Opex Under Rush Pressure — Buy 4 Tanks NOW or Build a Second Factory?

raw.realWorldMeaning: A fixed cash budget funds EITHER an immediate force (buy 4× medium tanks RIGHT NOW from the pre-placed war factory) OR a long-run capacity upgrade (build a SECOND war factory to double per-turn tank production). A rusher band is incoming at the lane mouth from turn 0 and charges the agent's construction yard. The intended play reads the threat timing and commits the budget to immediate units; spending it on capacity instead leaves no force for the rush, and the construction yard is razed before the new factory fields a single tank. The pack frames the classic CAPEX-vs-OPEX decision: invest for tomorrow vs operate for today.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Operational capacity allocation under a live incident: the budget funds either an immediate dispatch of available robots (OPEX — use existing fleet capacity right now to handle the incident) or procurement of a second loading dock that will double dispatch throughput over the next quarter (CAPEX — long-run capacity). An in-progress incident makes the CAPEX play wrong: spending on the second loading dock now leaves the site undefended, and the incident escalates before the new capacity comes online.

title: Economy — Cash Reserve Management (Spend Without Going Broke)

raw.realWorldMeaning:
A treasury-management decision under a deadline. The agent has a productive operation (two harvesters on two near patches feeding a refinery — steady income), starting cash 1500, and a hard win requirement to grow operations (build MORE buildings) WHILE also finishing the episode with a positive operating reserve in the bank (cash ≥ 300). The classic anti-patterns: 1) STALL — preserve every credit, build nothing. The reserve stays
   safe but operations never grow → the "build more buildings" bar
   is never met → LOSS.
2) OVER-SPEND — spend everything (and then some, by chaining a
   1400cr refinery and any other expensive build) on construction
   and dip the reserve to zero. Income eventually refills but the
   window between buildings-met and reserve-refilled may not close
   before the deadline → LOSS.
3) PURE-HOLD — harvest and sit on the cash forever, never building.
   Same as STALL on the building-growth axis → LOSS.
The intended capability is the SC2 cash-overflow / corporate treasury discipline: spend ENOUGH to keep growing (buildings) while keeping ENOUGH liquid (cash) to weather the next shock — never let the operating reserve hit zero, never sit on idle capital. With a pre-placed 2× harvester income engine the model gets ~190 cr/turn of inflow, so any modest spend (1-2 power plant at 300cr each) is recovered in a handful of turns and the reserve closes the episode well above 300.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Operating-reserve management in an autonomous fleet's treasury: revenue from collectors flows into a single pool that must fund both ongoing capacity expansion (added depot / processing / defence nodes) AND a minimum operating reserve (covering the next contingency — a damaged collector, a sudden parts order). A pure-hoarding policy fails the growth mandate; a blow-the-reserve policy succumbs to the next shock. The discipline being measured is the operations-finance loop: spend at the income-replenishment rate, not above and not below.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: SC2 cash management (spend while not overflowing), financial runway management (operate while keeping reserve), treasury management: cash conversion cycle, operational reserve / working capital
raw.author: catalog-f8

summary.zh:
在最后期限内作出的财务管理决策。该代理商拥有高效运营（附近两个地块上的两台收割机为炼油厂提供原料 - 稳定收入），起始现金为 1500，并且需要艰难获胜才能扩大业务（建造更多建筑物），同时在银行中拥有正运营储备（现金≥ 300）。经典的反模式：1）拖延——保留每一个信用，不建造任何东西。保留地保留
安全，但业务永远不会增长→“建造更多建筑物”栏
从未满足→损失。
2) 过度支出——花掉所有东西（然后是一些，通过链接
1400cr 炼油厂和任何其他昂贵的建筑）在建
并将储备金降至零。收入最终会得到补充，但
满足建筑物和重新填充储备的建筑物之间的窗口可能无法关闭
在截止日期之前 → 损失。
3) 纯粹持有——收获并永远坐拥现金，从不建设。
与建筑物增长轴上的失速→损失相同。
预期的能力是 SC2 现金溢出/公司财务纪律：花费足够的资金来保持增长（建筑），同时保持足够的流动性（现金）以抵御下一次冲击 - 永远不要让运营准备金为零，永远不要闲置资本。通过预先放置的 2× 收割机收入引擎，该模型获得约 190 cr/回合的流入，因此任何适度的支出（1-2 个发电厂，每个 300cr）都会在少数回合内恢复，并且储备金远高于 300。

title: Contested Central Ore Patch — Common-Pool Resource vs Enemy Raider

raw.realWorldMeaning: Common-pool resource contention with an active rival. A shared ore patch sits in the middle of the map; the enemy fields its own harvesters AND a worker-priority raider bot that drives specifically at your harvesters. Pure extraction (mine only, don't defend) lets the raider pick off your harvs at the contested patch; pure defense (engage the raider, but stop mining) abandons the revenue stream; stalling commits to neither and the economy clock bites. The intended committed-balance play sends the defenders forward to intercept the raider AT the patch AND lets the harvs keep mining (the engine auto-routes pre-placed harvs as long as a refinery exists) — extracting THROUGH the contestation.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Multi-agent extraction from a shared resource zone with an actively-hostile rival fleet. The harvesters keep visiting the contested deposit; the defender fleet must intercept the rival's worker-priority raiders BEFORE they reach the collectors, without leaving the patch unmanned. Abandoning either function — extraction or interception — loses the day to a one-sided commit.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: SC2 contested mining / split-base play, game theory common-pool resource (Hardin tragedy of commons), competitive market entry / TAM contention, fishing common-resource dynamics
raw.author: openra-bench

title: Econ Contested Expansion — Second Refinery on the Contested Patch

raw.realWorldMeaning: Mid-game expansion under genuine geographic contention. The agent owns a working mini-base in one corner of the map and a pair of starter tanks. A richer ore patch sits midway across the map, framed by terrain (water walls) that funnel both sides into a single approach corridor. Enemy patrol infantry already loiter on the patch. The capability under test is to read the tactical position (single approach lane, contested by light infantry that will murder an unarmed harvester), commit the 1400-credit refinery, place it ON the patch (so the engine's free auto-harvester spawns on-site and mines the rich patch via the closest-by-path refinery), and escort with the starter tanks so the patrol doesn't deny the expansion. Stalling, planting the 2nd refinery at home, and committing the refinery without escorting all LOSE.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Commit a forward processor to a contested deposit, with convoy security. An autonomous extraction operation is mining a small home deposit at sub-quota throughput; a richer deposit sits across a contested corridor, patrolled by hostile platforms. The forward processor commission ships with a co-deployed extractor on-site, but the extractor is unarmed and the patrol will destroy it within seconds unless the operator dispatches the available defensive platforms ahead of the commission. Stalling at the home throughput rate never clears the daily revenue target; commissioning the processor at home doubles processors but doesn't add a new deposit; commissioning the processor on the contested deposit without convoy security loses the extractor on first contact.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: SC2 contested expansion (take a 2nd resource under harass), facility-siting under adversarial contention, convoy security: forward asset commission + escort, RTS second-refinery idiom (free-worker on-build, at the new proc)
raw.author: openra-bench

summary.zh: 真正的地理争夺下的中期扩张。该特工在地图的一个角落拥有一个可用的迷你基地和一对入门坦克。地图中间有一块更丰富的矿石区，周围是地形（水墙），两侧都形成一条通道。敌方巡逻步兵已经在这片土地上徘徊。正在测试的功能是读取战术位置（单一进场车道，由轻步兵争夺，这将杀死一个手无寸铁的收割机），投入1400积分的精炼厂，将其放置在补丁上（这样引擎的免费自动收割机就地生成并通过最近的路径精炼厂开采富饶的补丁），并用起始坦克护航，这样巡逻队就不会拒绝扩张。拖延，在国内种植第二个炼油厂，并在不护送所有LOSE的情况下承诺炼油厂。

title: Reasoning — Deny the Enemy Expansion (Raid the Contested Refinery)

raw.realWorldMeaning: The enemy has just taken a SECOND base — a refinery (ore refinery) and a harvester at a contested ore patch in the middle of the map — and it is still only lightly defended. The enemy's MAIN base is far to the east, heavily fortified. Turtling at home lets the enemy economy snowball uncontested; throwing the army at the fortified main just gets it shredded. The winning play is the economic raid: drive the four-tank strike force out to the mid-map expansion, raze the refinery before the deadline to deny the enemy its economic upside, and bring ≥2 tanks home with your construction yard intact. The decision under test is recognising that a soft, freshly-placed enemy expansion is the highest-value target on the board — punish it now, do not turtle and do not over-commit into the fortified main.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Adversarial resource interdiction: an agent must identify that the opponent's newest, least-defended supply node is the decisive target and dispatch a strike to neutralise it within a deadline — rather than passively defending its own assets while the opponent's resource base compounds, or wastefully assaulting the opponent's hardened core.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: SC2 expansion denial, economic warfare, resource interdiction
raw.author: openra-bench

summary.zh: 敌人刚刚占领了第二个基地——地图中间一块有争议的矿区的一座炼油厂（矿石精炼厂）和一台收割机——而且它的防守仍然很薄弱。敌人的主要基地位于远东，戒备森严。国内的龟缩让敌人的经济毫无争议地滚雪球；将军队扔向坚固的主线只会将其撕碎。获胜的玩法是经济突袭：将四辆坦克突击部队赶到地图中部扩展区，在截止日期前夷平炼油厂，剥夺敌人的经济优势，并在完好无损的情况下将 ≥2 辆坦克带回家。正在测试的决定是认识到软弱的、新放置的敌人扩张是棋盘上价值最高的目标——现在就惩罚它，不要龟缩，也不要过度投入到强化的主线中。

en:
Commander, this is an expansion-denial raid. You hold your Construction Yard (fact) and four medium tanks (2tnk) at the west edge. The enemy just dropped a forward Ore Refinery (proc) and a harvester (harv, unarmed ore truck) at mid-map (60,20), guarded by a single rifle infantryman (e1). Their main base sits far east at (108,20), bristling with pillboxes and rocket infantry — too hard to crack in budget. Within about 60 turns, raze the forward refinery, keep at least two of your tanks alive, and keep your Construction Yard standing.
WIN WHEN: destroy the enemy proc at the base near (60,20) AND keep ≥2 units alive AND own ≥1 'fact' building(s) AND before game tick 5400.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 5401 OR NOT (own ≥1 'fact' building(s)) OR fewer than 2 of your units remain).
You have at most 72 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Commander, this is an expansion-denial raid against a heavier garrison. You hold your Construction Yard (fact) and four medium tanks (2tnk) at the west edge. The enemy's forward Ore Refinery (proc) and harvester (harv) sit at (60,20), now guarded by two rifle infantry (e1) and three anti-tank rocket infantry (e3). The enemy main base far east at (108,20) is fortified. Within about 50 turns, raze the forward refinery, keep at least two of your tanks alive, and keep your Construction Yard standing.
WIN WHEN: destroy the enemy proc at the base near (60,20) AND keep ≥2 units alive AND own ≥1 'fact' building(s) AND before game tick 4500.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 4501 OR NOT (own ≥1 'fact' building(s)) OR fewer than 2 of your units remain).
You have at most 60 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

title: Econ — Add the 2nd Harvester Before Break-Even

raw.realWorldMeaning: Capacity-expansion timing under a hard deadline. A revenue operation is running below the throughput it needs to clear a stated target by a stated date; the supervisor holds exactly enough budget for ONE more collector. A collector costs cash up front and has a warmup before it returns revenue, so its payback period only fits inside the planning horizon if the capex is committed EARLY. The decision is the timing: recognise that current capacity misses the bar, and add the second collector before the break-even tick — not "expand eventually". Stalling, running the single collector, buying the collector too late, or spending the reserve on a non-revenue line all miss the target.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Throughput scaling in an autonomous collection fleet: a target output must be met by a hard deadline; one extra collector can be afforded; the collector has acquisition cost plus a spin-up delay before it is productive. Add it early and its payback period fits the horizon and the target clears; add it late and the extra throughput does not run long enough — the deadline passes short. Break-even timing of a capacity capex is the test.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: SC2 worker-count optimization, capacity-expansion timing, OR break-even analysis
raw.author: wave-11

title: Economy — Far Large Patch vs Near Small Patch (Travel-vs-Throughput)

raw.realWorldMeaning: Travel-vs-throughput patch selection under a hard economy deadline. The agent owns ONE harvester, a refinery and a Construction Yard, and faces TWO ore patches: a NEAR patch a short hop from the refinery, and a FAR patch much farther away. Under a tight deadline, round-trip latency dominates pile size: the short-round-trip patch lets the harvester complete many delivery cycles and bank the bar comfortably; the far patch burns the whole episode in transit and banks barely one cycle. The capability under test is the OR travel-vs-throughput / SC2 expansion-timing insight — under a tight deadline, route to the short-round-trip source.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Pickup-station selection under a delivery deadline: a single autonomous hauler, a depot, and two supply nodes — a near node and a distant node. With an SLA deadline on cumulative delivered volume, the optimal policy routes to the NEAR node because cycle latency (travel time per round trip), not node capacity, bounds throughput inside the window; the distant node's larger stockpile only pays off on a longer horizon.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: OR travel-vs-throughput, SC2 expansion timing, logistics routing
raw.author: wave11-routing

summary.en: Travel-vs-throughput patch selection under a hard economy deadline. The agent owns ONE harvester, a refinery and a Construction Yard, and faces TWO ore patches: a NEAR patch a short hop from the refinery, and a FAR patch much farther away. Under a tight deadline, round-trip latency dominates pile size: the short-round-trip patch lets the harvester complete many delivery cycles and bank the bar comfortably; the far patch burns the whole episode in transit and banks barely one cycle. The capability under test is the OR travel-vs-throughput / SC2 expansion-timing insight — under a tight deadline, route to the short-round-trip source.
summary.zh: 在经济困难的最后期限下，旅行与吞吐量的补丁选择。该代理商拥有一台收割机、一家精炼厂和一个建筑场，并面临两个矿区：一个距离精炼厂不远的近矿区，以及一个距离精炼厂更远的远矿区。在紧迫的期限内，往返延迟决定了堆大小：短往返补丁使收割机能够完成许多交付周期并舒适地堆放棒材；远处的补丁在运输过程中烧毁了整个情节，并且银行几乎没有一个周期。正在测试的功能是 OR 行程与吞吐量/SC2 扩展时序洞察 - 在紧迫的期限内，路由到短往返源。

title: Econ Harvester Defense — Keep the Harv Alive Under Raid Waves

raw.realWorldMeaning: A live extraction operation under recurring asset-targeted harass. The agent owns a refinery, a single harvester running an auto-harvest loop on a nearby ore patch, and a small escort parked at the depot on hold-fire. The harvester's income is the sole revenue stream, and a recurring raider drives at the harvester specifically (not the base, not the escort). The decision is to FLIP the escort from passive to active — set its stance to defend / attack-anything, or order it onto the harvester's lane to intercept — so the raider dies on the escort's fire envelope before reaching the harvester. The map geometry funnels every raider through a single corridor mouth, so the right place to plant the escort is unambiguous if the agent reads the map. Stalling, leaving the escort on hold-fire, or spreading defense everywhere instead of on the corridor mouth all let the harvester die.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Mining-fleet protection under recurring asset-targeted attack — an autonomous extraction site with an extractor robot, a processing depot, and a static defense detail. If the defense detail is in safe-mode (hold fire) the recurring attacker destroys the extractor on the first cycle; the operator must flip the detail to engage and reposition it onto the single access route the attacker must use.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: SC2 harvester harass defense (Lambo, Reaper drops on workers), convoy / extractor protection under recurring harass, RTS stance management — flip escort from passive to active, SOC active-vs-passive monitoring posture, chokepoint defense — plant the line on the one route
raw.author: openra-bench

summary.zh: 在经常性的针对资产的骚扰下进行现场提取作业。该特工拥有一家炼油厂、一台在附近矿地上运行自动收割循环的收割机，以及停在仓库处等待开火的小型护卫队。收割机的收入是唯一的收入来源，并且经常性袭击者专门驾驶收割机（不是基地，不是护卫队）。决定是将护航舰从被动转变为主动——设置其立场来防御/攻击任何东西，或者命令它进入收割机的车道进行拦截——这样袭击者在到达收割机之前就死在护航舰的火力范围内。地图几何形状将每个袭击者集中在一个走廊口，因此如果特工阅读地图，放置护卫队的正确位置是明确的。拖延时间、让护卫队保持火力、或者将防御分散到各处而不是走廊口，这些都会让收割机死亡。

en:
Commander, this is a harvester-defense drill. You hold a Construction Yard (fact), Power Plant (powr) and Ore Refinery (proc) in the north-west corner, one harvester (harv, an unarmed ore-collector truck) auto-cycling to an off-axis ore patch at (30,28), and two medium tanks (2tnk) parked at the refinery on HOLD-FIRE stance. A vertical water wall at x=46..54 splits the map; the only crossing is a 4-cell corridor at y=18..21. At tick 600 an enemy heavy tank spawns east of the wall and drives for your harvester through that corridor. Within about 35 turns, finish with cash at least $1200 and keep your harvester and refinery alive.
WIN WHEN: in this exact order: not before game tick 1700 → THEN → hold ≥1200 credits AND have ≥1 'harv' AND own a 'proc' AND before game tick 3000.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 3001 OR NOT (have ≥1 'harv') OR NOT (own a 'proc')).
You have at most 35 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Commander, you own a Construction Yard, Power Plant, and Ore Refinery (NW corner), one harvester on auto-harvest to the off-axis ore patch at (30,28), and two medium tanks parked at the refinery on HOLD-FIRE stance. A vertical water wall at x=46..54 splits the map; the only crossing is a 4-cell corridor at y=18..21. TWO raider waves arrive: one at tick 600 and a second at tick 1500. Both spawn at (75,20) in the eastern lobe and must cross the single corridor (y=18..21) to reach your harvester. Win when cash >= 2200 AND your harvester is alive AND your refinery is intact, before tick 3900. Stalling, leaving the escort on hold-fire, and chasing the first raider PAST the corridor far enough to miss the second wave all LOSE. The intended play is to flip the escort active (stance Defend or AttackAnything) and HOLD the corridor mouth so BOTH waves die on approach.
WIN WHEN: in this exact order: not before game tick 2700 → THEN → hold ≥2200 credits AND have ≥1 'harv' AND own a 'proc' AND before game tick 3900.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 3901 OR NOT (have ≥1 'harv') OR NOT (own a 'proc')).
You have at most 45 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Commander, this is a harvester-defense drill with seed-rotated base latitude against three raid waves. You hold a Construction Yard (fact), Power Plant (powr) and Ore Refinery (proc) at either the NORTH (y=8) or SOUTH (y=32) latitude, one harvester (harv, an unarmed ore-collector truck) auto-cycling to an off-axis ore patch on the matched latitude (mine at (30,12) NORTH or (30,28) SOUTH), and three medium tanks (2tnk) parked at the refinery on HOLD-FIRE stance. A vertical water wall at x=46..54 leaves a single 4-cell corridor at y=18..21. Enemy heavy tanks arrive at ticks 600, 1500 and 2400 from the east and detour to your harvester's latitude after crossing. Within about 50 turns, finish with cash at least $2800 and keep your harvester and refinery alive.
WIN WHEN: in this exact order: not before game tick 3500 → THEN → hold ≥2800 credits AND have ≥1 'harv' AND own a 'proc' AND before game tick 4300.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 4301 OR NOT (have ≥1 'harv') OR NOT (own a 'proc')).
You have at most 50 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

胜利条件：按照这个确切的顺序：不在游戏刻 1700 之前 → 然后 → 持有 ≥1200 个积分并且拥有 ≥1 个“harv”并且拥有一个“proc”并且在游戏刻 3000 之前。
失败条件：（不在游戏刻 3001 之前或不（有 ≥1 'harv'）或不（拥有 'proc'））。
您最多有 35 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

指挥官，您拥有一个建筑场、发电厂和矿石精炼厂（西北角），一台自动收割到 (30,28) 处离轴矿区的收割机，以及两辆中型坦克停在精炼厂，处于保持射击状态。 x=46..54 处的垂直水墙将地图分开；唯一的交叉点是 y=18..21 处的 4 单元走廊。两波袭击波到达：一波在刻度 600 处，另一波在刻度 1500 处。两者都在东叶的 (75,20) 处生成，并且必须穿过单一走廊 (y=18..21) 才能到达您的收割机。当现金 >= 2200 并且你的收割机还活着并且你的精炼厂完好无损时，在 3900 点之前获胜。 失速，让护卫队保持火力，并追赶第一批袭击者经过走廊足够远以错过第二波，全部失败。预期的玩法是翻转护航活动（立场防御或攻击任何东西）并按住走廊口，以便两波在接近时死亡。
胜利条件：按照这个确切的顺序：不在游戏刻 2700 之前 → 然后 → 持有 ≥2200 个积分并且拥有 ≥1 个“harv”并且拥有一个“proc”并且在游戏刻 3900 之前。
失败条件：（不在游戏刻 3901 之前或不（拥有 ≥1 'harv'）或不（拥有 'proc'））。
您最多有 45 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

胜利条件：按照这个确切的顺序：不在游戏刻 3500 之前 → 然后 → 持有 ≥2800 个积分并且拥有 ≥1 个“harv”并且拥有一个“proc”并且在游戏刻 4300 之前。
失败条件：（不在游戏前勾选 4301 或不（有 ≥1 'harv'）或不（拥有 'proc'））。

title: Economy — Harvester Pathing Optimization (Split-Routing M/M/c)

raw.realWorldMeaning: Split-routing under heterogeneous round-trip cost. The agent owns TWO harvesters and faces TWO ore patches: A — a NEAR small patch (rich per-cell but quickly exhausted by two collectors stacking on it) — and B — a FAR larger patch (slow per-cycle but doesn't saturate). The optimal policy sends ONE harvester to A and ONE to B (the "split route"), so the ore refinery receives a steady alternating delivery stream from two short and one long round-trip cycle. The LAZY/BRUTE alternatives both fail: piling BOTH harvs on A pumps early cash but never enters B's region (the routing constraint in the win predicate goes unmet); piling BOTH on B earns barely any income within the deadline (long round-trip dominates). Stalling earns zero. The capability under test is the OR vehicle-routing / SC2 worker-distribution insight: distribute collectors across heterogeneous sources to balance round-trip throughput, not to monocrop the best-looking node.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Fleet vehicle-routing across a multi-server queueing system (M/M/c): two pickup stations at different distances from a depot, each modelled as a server with its own service rate; the optimal fleet allocation puts exactly one vehicle per server so the depot queue alternates arrivals from heterogeneous cycle times rather than stacking all vehicles on the lowest-latency server (which saturates the server and starves throughput) or the highest-throughput server (which dominates the cycle and starves the depot in early windows).
raw.benchmarkAnchor: SC2 worker distribution, OR vehicle routing, M/M/c queueing
raw.author: wave7-fleet

summary.zh: 异构往返成本下的拆分路由。该特工拥有两台收割机并面临两个矿石块：A - 一个近小的块（每个单元丰富，但很快被堆叠在其上的两个收集器耗尽） - 和 B - 一个更大的块（每个周期缓慢但不饱和）。最优策略将一台收割机发送到 A，将一台收割机发送到 B（“分流路线”），因此矿石精炼厂从两个短往返周期和一个长往返周期中接收稳定的交替输送流。 LAZY/BRUTE 替代方案都失败了：在 A 上堆积两个 harv 会提早产生现金，但永远不会进入 B 的区域（获胜谓词中的路由约束未得到满足）；将两者都放在 B 上在截止日期内几乎没有任何收入（长途往返占主导地位）。拖延收入为零。正在测试的功能是 OR 车辆路由/SC2 工作人员分布洞察力：跨异构源分布收集器以平衡往返吞吐量，而不是单一裁剪最好看的节点。

title: Multi-Patch Allocation — Pick Which Ore Patches To Commit To

raw.realWorldMeaning: Resource allocation across multiple candidate sites under a hard capital budget. The agent has a Construction Yard and a Power Plant in the west and looks out at four ore patches scattered around the map, each with an idle Ore Truck waiting beside it: one small near patch (depletes fast), two medium patches at the medium-distance ring, and one rich patch at the far east edge. Starting cash funds ONE refinery up front; the second requires deposits from the first. The decision is whether to commit to at least two refineries (the multi-patch allocation insight), and which patches to commit them to — stalling earns nothing and loses, a single-refinery opening fails the proc-count clause, and the intended efficient play is to commit to two medium-distance patches so parallel harvest cycles deposit ample cash inside the deadline.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: A mining survey reports four candidate extraction sites with different size and travel-cost profiles, and the day's CAPEX budget covers no more than two processing depots up front. The autonomous operations planner must (a) commit to building more than one processing depot — running only one stalls the quota — and (b) site them next to patches whose harvester cycle-times stay short enough to deposit the quota before the shift deadline. The capability under test is the multi-site-investment decision under a small CAPEX cap, not a single-site optimisation.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: OR resource-allocation, SC2 macro 2-base vs 3-base, lmgame-Bench resource-streaming

title: Overflow To Silos — Build Storage Or Income Spoils At The Cap

raw.realWorldMeaning: Capacity planning under high producer throughput. The agent owns a minimum revenue kit (fact + proc + powr + many harvs on a dense ore patch column) whose harvesters deposit ore at a sustained rate exceeding the refinery's 2000-ore storage cap. Once the cap saturates, every new deposit is LOST — the back-pressure footgun. The decision is to recognise the throughput-vs-buffer gap and BUILD SILOS (cost 150, +3000 cap each) so the working capital is absorbed and the economy_value bar lands INSIDE the within_ticks budget. A run with no silo cannot reach the bar in time (overflow-bound accrual is too slow against the tight deadline); intended capacity-planning runs (build 1-3 silos) WIN.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Distributed-systems back-pressure / FIFO perishable inventory cap. A producer pipeline (sensor capture, log shipping, the data plane) generates events at a sustained rate; the consumer's buffer (the queue, the warehouse, the refinery store) has a fixed cap; when the buffer fills, new events are silently dropped on deposit. The operator must size the buffer (add silos / scale the queue / add warehouse storage) to match producer throughput, or the income channel runs at the buffer's drain rate forever. This pack tests the capacity-planning reflex — measure throughput, measure cap, size the buffer above throughput.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: capacity planning, distributed-systems backpressure, FIFO inventory
raw.author: wave8-econ-overflow-seed

title: Protect the Harvester Route — Intercept Raiders on the Supply Line

raw.realWorldMeaning: Defend a long-distance supply line by intercepting the threat ON the route, not at the depot. A single harvester commutes far between refinery and ore patch; a worker-priority raider drives at it from the far end. Defenders pre-placed at the base have no line of sight to the mid-route kill zone — they must be moved out along the harvester's commute axis to intercept the raider before it reaches the harvester. Stalling or holding defenders at base lets the raider kill the harvester on the road; the income bar is unmet; the run loses.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Convoy / supply-line protection on the road. The protective detail rides WITH the convoy along the route, not at the warehouse: a threat that enters the route's mid-span and the escorts that stayed at the depot are out of contact and out of position. The supply line is only safe if patrolled along its full length.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: SC2 harass defense, military convoy protection, supply-line doctrine
raw.author: openra-bench

summary.en: Defend a long-distance supply line by intercepting the threat ON the route, not at the depot. summary.zh: 通过在路线上而不是在仓库拦截威胁来保卫长距离补给线。一台收割机在炼油厂和矿区之间往返很远；一个工人优先的袭击者从远端驶向它。预先部署在基地的防御者无法看到中路杀伤区——他们必须沿着收割机的通勤轴线移动，以便在袭击者到达收割机之前拦截它们。在基地拖延或滞留防守者可以让袭击者杀死路上的收割机；未达到收入标准；跑输了。

title: Quantity vs Quality — Pick the Right Composition for the Budget

raw.realWorldMeaning: A fixed cash budget funds either a SWARM of cheap rifle infantry (8× e1 @ $100) OR a small ELITE armoured fist (3-5× 2tnk @ $850). Either composition fits the same budget — the decision is which is right for the threat the agent must clear. The kill bar AND the attrition cap jointly bind: a stall never reaches the bar; a mixed mini-spend (1 tank + a handful of rifles) underdelivers on firepower and bleeds units past the loss cap; one of the two pure compositions cleanly wins per tier. Hard flips the right answer per seed — the agent's spawn corner determines which garrison is local, and the local garrison's composition determines whether mass cheap or few elite is the right counter (anti-vehicle garrison ⇒ mass cheap wins, anti-infantry garrison ⇒ elite armour wins).
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Fleet provisioning under a fixed CAPEX: same budget buys either a swarm of cheap general-purpose drones or a handful of expensive high-capability robots. The mission profile (debris field vs high-value point target; mass surveillance vs precision strike) decides which composition is right — and a half-and-half procurement satisfies neither requirement.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: SC2 mass-vs-elite army composition, industrial mass-production vs craftsmanship, military doctrine: quantity has a quality of its own, OR unit-composition optimization under budget
raw.author: openra-bench

Either composition fits the same budget — the decision is which is right for the threat the agent must clear. The kill bar AND the attrition cap jointly bind: a stall never reaches the bar; a mixed mini-spend (1 tank + a handful of rifles) underdelivers on firepower and bleeds units past the loss cap; one of the two pure compositions cleanly wins per tier. Hard flips the right answer per seed — the agent's spawn corner determines which garrison is local, and the local garrison's composition determines whether mass cheap or few elite is the right counter (anti-vehicle garrison ⇒ mass cheap wins, anti-infantry garrison ⇒ elite armour wins).
summary.zh: 固定现金预算可以资助一群廉价步枪步兵（8×e1 @ 100 美元）或一个小型精英装甲拳头（3-5× 2tnk @ 850 美元）。两种组合都符合相同的预算——决定哪种组合适合特工必须清除的威胁。杀伤条和消耗上限共同绑定：失速永远不会到达杀伤条；混合的迷你支出（1辆坦克+几支步枪）火力不足，导致单位流血超过损失上限；两种纯粹的组合中的一种干净利落地赢得了每一级。硬翻转每个种子的正确答案——特工的重生角决定了哪个驻军是本地的，而本地驻军的组成决定了是大规模廉价还是少数精英是正确的反击（反车辆驻军⇒大规模廉价获胜，反步兵驻军⇒精英装甲获胜）。

title: Recover From Zero Cash — Rebuild Revenue From a Minimum-Viable Kit

raw.realWorldMeaning: Turtle-recovery / bankruptcy turnaround from a minimum-viable kit and zero working capital. The agent inherits ONE refinery, ONE harvester, and ONE ore patch — but no cash, no spare workers, no army. The decision is the RECOVERY PROFILE — commit to harvest FIRST (the only income channel), accumulate cash, and then reinvest in the NEXT productive asset (a war factory and a second harvester) so the income channel actually scales past a non-trivial revenue bar before the deadline. Stalling (no income), spending the accumulated cash on the wrong asset (a second refinery, army units), or trying to build an army from zero all miss the bar.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Post-crisis operations restart: an autonomous operator has lost most of its infrastructure and is reduced to one processing unit, one collector, and one known source — with no operating capital. It must commit to running the collector to refill the cash reserve, then deploy the saved capital to acquire a second collector before the recovery deadline. Spending on defensive / expansion hedges before the income channel has refilled the reserve misses the bar.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: SC2 turtle-back-to-economy / recovery from setback, business bankruptcy turnaround planning, military recovery from defeat (rebuild force structure), startup pivot after runway crisis

title: Replace Dead Harvester — Replan Economy After Exogenous Loss

raw.realWorldMeaning: Reactive replan after an exogenous worker death. A productive operation suddenly loses a value-generating unit to an outside event; cash reserves are tuned for EXACTLY one replacement; the deadline is real. The agent must notice the loss, commit the reserve to rebuilding the dead worker (not to army units), and redirect production back to the same revenue loop — fast enough that the deadline still bites.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Pipeline / fleet operation where one autonomous collector is destroyed mid-mission by an external hazard. The remaining collectors stay in the loop; the supervisor has just enough budget for a single replacement; redirecting the new unit back to the same revenue source AND re-tasking the survivors (whose loop was interrupted by the loss event) is the test. Spending the reserve on defenders, or stalling, misses the throughput bar.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: PlanBench replanning under exogenous loss, ScienceWorld error recovery, SC2 replace-killed-workers reflex, disaster recovery: worker replacement
raw.author: openra-bench

summary.en: Reactive replan after an exogenous worker death. A productive operation suddenly loses a value-generating unit to an outside event; cash reserves are tuned for EXACTLY one replacement; the deadline is real. The agent must notice the loss, commit the reserve to rebuilding the dead worker (not to army units), and redirect production back to the same revenue loop — fast enough that the deadline still bites.
summary.zh: 外源工人死亡后的反应性重新计划。生产性运营突然因外部事件而失去了价值产生单位；现金储备已调整为恰好一种替代品；截止日期是真实的。代理人必须注意到损失，将储备金用于重建死去的工人（而不是军队），并将生产重新引导回相同的收入循环——速度足够快，以至于最后期限仍然紧迫。

title: Resource Trade With Self — Sell A Redundant Building To Fund The Win

raw.realWorldMeaning: The agent owns a working economy plus a redundant tech building (a second war factory) that the current win clause does not need. Starting cash is too low to afford the cash bar by the deadline on harvest income alone. Selling the redundant building returns cash/2 — enough, combined with one round of harvested income, to fund a second refinery whose doubled income compounds past the cash bar inside the clock. Stalling never earns enough income; hoarding the redundant building leaves capital trapped in tangible form and the cash bar misses; selling without re-investing the freed cash also misses. The pack tests the divestiture verb: recognise the redundant asset, sell it, redeploy the cash.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Asset rotation / portfolio divestiture for an autonomous operations stack. The fleet holds a piece of legacy equipment whose capability is not exercised by the current operating profile; the same capital, freed by selling that equipment and redeployed into a productive new asset, compounds throughput inside the planning horizon. The intended move is the trade — sell what isn't earning, fund what will.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: SC2 sell-and-rebuild, divestiture, asset rotation, capital recycling, FIFO perishable inventory cap
raw.author: track-D-econ

title: Econ Second-Base Race — Plant the 2nd Proc at the Contested Spot

raw.realWorldMeaning: Tempo expansion to a SPECIFIC second-base location under a hard deadline. The agent owns a Construction Yard, a Power Plant, an idle Ore Truck, and a small near-base ore patch in the NORTH- WEST corner of a medium arena. A rich CONTESTED ore patch sits far to the south-east — the only zone where a 2nd refinery produces enough income to clear the cash bar inside the clock. The capability under test is the TEMPO + SPATIAL decision to drop the 2nd `ore refinery` inside the contested target disk (radius 6 around the patch) on turn 1, rather than placing it at home (the comfortable adjacency-to-construction yard play) or anywhere on the map that is not the target spot. A home-placed `ore refinery` still runs an economy off the near-base patch — but the cash bar is not the only gate: the `building_in_region` clause requires the ore refinery to be at the target zone, so a home play loses on the spatial predicate even with the bar cleared.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Forward-deploy a processing module at a SPECIFIC contested extraction site under a hard deadline. The home depot has a small local deposit (sustaining income but well below quota); the only way to hit the throughput SLA is to commit the second module to the far site, accepting that you cannot recover it if you mis-spend. The decision is geographic commitment to a specific cell, not a directional gradient — placing the module "somewhere forward" but missing the cell fails the placement audit.

title: Silo vs Spend — Storage-Cap Working-Capital Allocation

raw.realWorldMeaning: Capital-allocation under a perishable storage cap. The agent runs a revenue kit (fact + proc + powr + harv on an ore patch) whose income flows into a CAPPED storage pool (the refinery store): once full, new harvested ore is lost on deposit. The decision every turn is what to do with the working capital that's accumulating: either SPEND it on productive combat assets (build infantry, kill the enemy garrison), SPEND it on fixed defensive assets (build a pbox line), OR BUILD A SILO so the storage cap grows and ore keeps banking. All three paths legitimately resolve the cap pressure; the only failure mode is HOARDING — observing without building or killing, which leaves capacity to spoil and never satisfies the "use the capital" mandate (the any_of clause).
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Working-capital management for a robotic operations stack with a FIFO inventory cap: a collector pipeline deposits perishable goods into a fixed-capacity warehouse, and a continuous spend channel converts warehouse stock into bank capital. The operator must EITHER deploy the bank capital on productive assets (extra collectors, defenders), build fixed infrastructure (fortified pickets), OR expand the warehouse (build storage so each new collection still has somewhere to go). Letting capital sit idle while the warehouse fills loses goods at the cap — the perishable-inventory / cash-conversion-cycle discipline.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: SC2 silo management, working-capital allocation, inventory cap, financial cap management, FIFO perishable inventory cap
raw.author: wave7-econ-silo-seed

summary.en: Capital-allocation under a perishable storage cap. The agent runs a revenue kit (fact + proc + powr + harv on an ore patch) whose income flows into a CAPPED storage pool (the refinery store): once full, new harvested ore is lost on deposit. The decision every turn is what to do with the working capital that's accumulating: either SPEND it on productive combat assets (build infantry, kill the enemy garrison), SPEND it on fixed defensive assets (build a pbox line), OR BUILD A SILO so the storage cap grows and ore keeps banking. All three paths legitimately resolve the cap pressure; the only failure mode is HOARDING — observing without building or killing, which leaves capacity to spoil and never satisfies the "use the capital" mandate (the any_of clause).
summary.zh: 易腐烂存储上限下的资本配置。代理运行一个收入工具包（矿石块上的事实+过程+功率+哈夫），其收入流入CAPPED存储池（精炼厂商店）：一旦满了，新收获的矿石就会在存款中丢失。每一个回合的决定都是如何处理积累的营运资金：要么将其用于生产性战斗资产（建造步兵，杀死敌方驻军），要么将其用于固定防御资产（建立pbox线），要么建造一个筒仓，以便存储上限增加，矿石保持银行。所有三个路径都可以合法地解决上限压力；唯一的失败模式是囤积——观察而不建设或杀戮，这使得能力被破坏并且永远无法满足“使用资本”的要求（any_of子句）。

title: Econ Startup From Scratch — Greenfield First Base From Zero

raw.realWorldMeaning: Greenfield first-base economy ramp from zero infrastructure: the agent begins with one mobile asset (the MCV) and a cash budget but NO buildings, NO harvesters, and NO income. The opening decision is the entire test — deploy the MCV (irreversibly converting it to a Construction Yard), then stand up the first power plant (prerequisite) and the first ore refinery (which auto-spawns a free harvester), and finally commit to harvesting so the income pipeline actually closes the revenue gap before the clock. A model that stalls, that spends the budget on infantry / military buildings, or that deploys and then idles, all miss the revenue bar and the clock runs out as a real loss.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Cold-start a revenue pipeline: an autonomous operator arrives at a greenfield site with capital and a single mobile depot. It must anchor the depot, energise it, stand up the first processing facility, dispatch the first collector to a known resource node, and have throughput clear a revenue bar before a hard deadline. Sub-tasks that look productive (training a security team, surveying for additional sites) but don't close the production-to-revenue loop all miss the bar.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: SC2LE CollectMineralsAndGas (canonical first-base ramp), MineRL Diamond initial-resources, greenfield revenue ramp from zero, startup MVP-to-revenue pivot
raw.author: groupF-econ-seed

title: Econ — Hit a Cash Target by a Hard Deadline

raw.realWorldMeaning: Budget-by-date target: the operation must reach a stated cash bar by a stated deadline, the way a startup must hit a quarterly revenue target / a fundraising milestone / a quarterly closeout. Pre-placed harvester+refinery+barracks are the running pipeline; the agent must reason about whether the current capacity will clear the bar on time, and if not, reinvest into harvesting capacity (build extra harvesters) — not into army units that drain the cash account without growing income. Idling, over-spending on the wrong line item, or under-investing in capacity all miss the bar.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Throughput-by-deadline planning in an autonomous pipeline: hit a revenue/output target by a hard date by deciding when to scale up collectors (capacity capex) vs hold (stay lean) vs spend on unrelated capacity (army units / non-revenue line items). Capex timing is the decision — over-spend on the wrong line and the deadline passes with the books short.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: SC2 econ-by-tick target, budget-by-date / quarterly revenue target, fundraising milestone planning, OR throughput optimization with deadline
raw.author: wave-5

summary.en: Budget-by-date target: the operation must reach a stated cash bar by a stated deadline, the way a startup must hit a quarterly revenue target / a fundraising milestone / a quarterly closeout. Pre-placed harvester+refinery+barracks are the running pipeline; the agent must reason about whether the current capacity will clear the bar on time, and if not, reinvest into harvesting capacity (build extra harvesters) — not into army units that drain the cash account without growing income. Idling, over-spending on the wrong line item, or under-investing in capacity all miss the bar.
summary.zh: 按日期制定预算目标：运营必须在规定的截止日期前达到规定的现金标准，就像初创公司必须达到季度收入目标/筹款里程碑/季度收尾一样。预置收割机+炼油厂+营房为运行管道；代理人必须思考当前的能力是否能够按时达到标准，如果不能，则重新投资于收割能力（建造额外的收割机），而不是投资于耗尽现金账户而不增加收入的军队。闲置、在错误的订单项上过度支出或容量投资不足都会导致失败。

title: Capital Allocation — Tech Building or Economic Expansion?

raw.realWorldMeaning: One indivisible budget funds EITHER a tech building (a war factory — a capability investment that generates no income) OR an economic expansion (a second ore harvester that roughly doubles gathering throughput). The regime is fixed: there is no near-term combat demand the tech tier must satisfy, so the budget compounds best as capacity. The win is an economy target by a deadline — expanding clears it; sinking the budget into the non-revenue tech building leaves the economy short. The pack frames the classic tech-vs-expand decision: do not buy capability the regime does not yet demand when the same budget, spent on capacity, compounds.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Capital budgeting for an autonomous operation: the same budget buys EITHER a new capability module that the current mission profile does not call for OR an extra collector that compounds throughput over the planning horizon. With no demand the new capability serves inside the horizon, the capacity expansion dominates on payback — invest in throughput, not in idle capability.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: SC2 tech-vs-expand, PlanBench resource-allocation, capex allocation, capital budgeting
raw.author: openra-bench

title: Force Buildup — Allocate a Fixed Budget to a Power+Force Mix

raw.realWorldMeaning: Resource allocation under a hard budget and a deadline. The budget buys exactly one coherent build: a structural investment (a second power plant) PLUS a force of capable units (anti-vehicle infantry, not the cheapest filler). Spamming the cheapest unit clears no structural bar and no quality bar; over-spending on the wrong item misses the deadline. The decision is the spend mix and its order, not the mechanics of any single build.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Autonomous fleet provisioning under an energy/money budget: the same pool must fund both a capacity upgrade (a charging/relay node) AND a set of capable mission agents — not a swarm of the cheapest drones — before a mission deadline; an unfocused spend yields neither in time.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: SC2 build-order under fixed budget, PlanBench cost-bounded multi-goal allocation, fixed-budget force buildup
raw.author: autonomous-loop

summary.en: Resource allocation under a hard budget and a deadline. The budget buys exactly one coherent build: a structural investment (a second power plant) PLUS a force of capable units (anti-vehicle infantry, not the cheapest filler). Spamming the cheapest unit clears no structural bar and no quality bar; over-spending on the wrong item misses the deadline. The decision is the spend mix and its order, not the mechanics of any single build.
summary.zh: 根据硬预算和期限分配资源。预算恰好购买了一个连贯的建设：结构性投资（第二座发电厂）加上一支有能力的部队（反车辆步兵，而不是最便宜的填充物）。向最便宜的单位发送垃圾邮件不会清除任何结构栏和质量栏；在错误的项目上过度支出会错过最后期限。决定的是支出组合及其顺序，而不是任何单个构建的机制。

en:
Commander, this is a fixed-budget force buildup. You hold a Construction Yard (fact), one Power Plant (powr) and an Allied Barracks (tent), with $2400 cash. Within about 30 turns, own at least two Power Plants and field at least four anti-vehicle rocket soldiers (e3).
WIN WHEN: own ≥2 'powr' building(s) AND have ≥4 'e3' AND before game tick 2700.
YOU LOSE IF: not before game tick 2703.
You have at most 30 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Commander, this is a tighter fixed-budget force buildup. You hold a Construction Yard (fact), one Power Plant (powr) and an Allied Barracks (tent), with $1900 cash. Within about 28 turns, own at least two Power Plants, field at least five anti-vehicle rocket soldiers (e3), and keep at least five units alive.
WIN WHEN: own ≥2 'powr' building(s) AND have ≥5 'e3' AND keep ≥5 units alive AND before game tick 2520.
YOU LOSE IF: not before game tick 2523.
You have at most 28 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Commander, this is the leanest fixed-budget force buildup under a short clock with zero-attrition. You hold a Construction Yard (fact), one Power Plant (powr) and an Allied Barracks (tent), with $2150 cash. Within about 24 turns, own at least two Power Plants and field at least six anti-vehicle rocket soldiers (e3) without losing a single unit.
WIN WHEN: own ≥2 'powr' building(s) AND have ≥6 'e3' AND lose ≤0 of your own units AND before game tick 2160.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 2163 OR NOT (lose ≤0 of your own units)).
You have at most 24 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.
zh:

胜利条件：拥有 ≥2 个“power”建筑物并且拥有 ≥4 个“e3”并且在游戏刻 2700 之前。
失败条件：不在游戏刻 2703 之前。
您最多有 30 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

指挥官，这是一次更严格的固定预算部队建设。您拥有一个建筑场（事实）、一个发电厂（power）和一个盟军军营（帐篷），还有 1900 美元现金。在大约 28 回合内，拥有至少两个发电厂，部署至少 5 名反车辆火箭兵 (e3)，并保持至少 5 个单位存活。
胜利条件：拥有 ≥2 个“power”建筑物并且拥有 ≥5 个“e3”并且保持 ≥5 个单位存活并且在游戏刻 2520 之前。
失败条件：不在比赛刻度 2523 之前。
您最多有 28 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

胜利条件：拥有≥2个'power'建筑物并且拥有≥6个'e3'并且失去≤0个你自己的单位并且在游戏刻2160之前。
失败条件：（不在游戏前勾选 2163 OR NOT（失去 ≤0 个自己的单位））。

title: Harvest Economy — Capital Reinvestment (Wide vs Deep vs Geographic)

raw.realWorldMeaning: Early-revenue capital reinvestment under a deadline. A productive operation has just enough starting capital for ONE coherent capacity expansion: deepen the team at the near patch (extra harvester), widen processing (extra refinery), or expand geographically (send a new harvester to a far patch). Hedging (splitting the indivisible budget across two reinvestments) funds neither path completely and yields baseline throughput — the deadline bites. The test is committing the whole budget to ONE reinvestment path early, not dithering.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Capacity-expansion budgeting in an autonomous pipeline operation: add a collector (deep), add a processing/staging node (wide), or deploy a collector to an unexploited zone (geographic). The same indivisible budget buys exactly one; a hedged spend yields neither and the mission deadline is missed.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: SC2LE CollectMineralsAndGas, PlanBench cost-optimal under reinvestment, lmgame-Bench resource-streaming, capital reinvestment: wide vs deep vs geographic
raw.author: catalog-c13

summary.en: Early-revenue capital reinvestment under a deadline. A productive operation has just enough starting capital for ONE coherent capacity expansion: deepen the team at the near patch (extra harvester), widen processing (extra refinery), or expand geographically (send a new harvester to a far patch). Hedging (splitting the indivisible budget across two reinvestments) funds neither path completely and yields baseline throughput — the deadline bites. The test is committing the whole budget to ONE reinvestment path early, not dithering.
summary.zh: 在最后期限内进行早期收入资本再投资。生产性运营只有足够的启动资金来进行一次连贯的产能扩张：深化近处的团队（额外的收割机），扩大加工范围（额外的精炼厂），或扩大地域（将一台新的收割机发送到远处）。对冲（将不可分割的预算分成两次再投资）既不完全资助两条路径，又产生基线吞吐量——最后期限紧迫。测试是尽早将整个预算投入到一条再投资路径，而不是犹豫不决。

en:

You hold a Construction Yard (fact), a Power Plant (powr), an Ore Refinery (proc), a War Factory (weap) and ONE harvester (harv, an unarmed ore-collector truck) working an ore patch at (22,18). Two further patches sit far north at (40,8) and far south at (40,28). Your reserve is $1100. Within about 80 turns, reach economy value 12000 and keep at least one unit and your Refinery alive.
WIN WHEN: reach economy value ≥12000 (cash+ore) AND keep ≥1 units alive AND own a 'proc' AND before game tick 7200.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 7200 OR your whole force is destroyed OR NOT (own a 'proc')).
You have at most 80 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

title: Harvest Economy — Time-Boxed Greenfield Revenue Ramp

raw.realWorldMeaning: Time-boxed greenfield revenue ramp from a bootstrapped pipeline: a pre-placed harvester + refinery + ore patch is the starter operation, and the model must commit to running it (and at higher tiers, expanding it: build extra harvesters and feed multiple patches) so the cumulative economy value clears a target before a hard tick deadline. Idling, spending the budget on non-harvesters, or running a single harvester at the higher tiers all miss the bar.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Autonomous warehouse / mining pipeline that must hit a throughput target by deadline: route collectors to known sources, return loads to the depot, and scale the collector fleet when one collector can't meet the rate. The decision is committing to the harvest loop and scaling collectors — not building unrelated capability.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: SC2LE CollectMineralsAndGas, MineRL Diamond resource collection, lmgame-Bench resource-streaming, greenfield revenue-ramp under deadline
raw.author: autonomous-loop

summary.en: Time-boxed greenfield revenue ramp from a bootstrapped pipeline: a pre-placed harvester + refinery + ore patch is the starter operation, and the model must commit to running it (and at higher tiers, expanding it: build extra harvesters and feed multiple patches) so the cumulative economy value clears a target before a hard tick deadline. Idling, spending the budget on non-harvesters, or running a single harvester at the higher tiers all miss the bar.
summary.zh: 通过自举管道实现按时间限制的绿地收入增长：预先放置的收割机+精炼厂+矿石块是起始操作，模型必须致力于运行它（并且在更高级别，扩展它：建造额外的收割机并为多个块提供饲料），以便累积经济价值在严格的截止日期之前清除目标。闲置、将预算花在非收割机上或在较高级别运行单个收割机都无法达到标准。

en:
Commander, this is a fixed-deadline revenue ramp. You start with an Ore Refinery ('proc'), a Construction Yard ('fact'), a War Factory ('weap'), and ONE Harvester ('harv'). Two ore patches sit east of your base. Your reserve is $1100. Reach economy value 6500 within about 30 turns.
WIN WHEN: reach economy value ≥6500 (cash+ore) AND before game tick 2700.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 2701 OR your whole force is destroyed).
You have at most 30 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Commander, this is a tighter time-boxed revenue ramp. You start with a Construction Yard ('fact'), Power Plant ('powr'), Ore Refinery ('proc'), War Factory ('weap'), and ONE Harvester ('harv'). Two ore patches sit east of your base. Your reserve is $1100. Reach economy value 8000 within about 34 turns.
WIN WHEN: reach economy value ≥8000 (cash+ore) AND before game tick 3000.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 3001 OR your whole force is destroyed).
You have at most 35 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Commander, this is the leanest time-boxed revenue ramp under a tight clock. You start with a Construction Yard, Power Plant, Ore Refinery, War Factory, and ONE Harvester. Three ore patches sit in your spawn's local cluster (your spawn is NW or SW by seed, each with its own three-patch layout). Your reserve is $2200. Reach economy value 12000 within about 40 turns. Locate your patches relative to your base.
WIN WHEN: reach economy value ≥12000 (cash+ore) AND before game tick 3600.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 3601 OR your whole force is destroyed).
You have at most 42 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.
zh:

胜利条件：达到经济价值≥6500（现金+矿石）并且在游戏刻线之前达到2700。
失败条件：（不是在游戏刻 2701 之前或你的整个部队被摧毁之前）。
您最多有 30 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

胜利条件：达到经济价值≥8000（现金+矿石）并且在游戏刻线之前达到3000。
失败条件：（不在游戏刻 3001 之前或你的整个部队被摧毁之前）。
您最多有 35 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

胜利条件：达到经济价值≥12000（现金+矿石）并且在游戏刻线之前达到3600。
失败条件：（不是在游戏刻 3601 之前或你的整个部队被摧毁之前）。
你最多有 42 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

title: Capital Allocation — Commit One Indivisible Budget to a Single Path

raw.realWorldMeaning: A capital-allocation decision under a single indivisible budget that is razor-tight: the cash buys EXACTLY ONE coherent path — a WIDE economy (a second refinery plus supporting power: added depot/throughput capacity) OR a DEEP one (keep the single refinery and convert the whole budget into a larger forward force: collection/utilisation). The budget cannot fund both, and any credit diverted to the other path starves the required one so it never completes in time. The test is committing to and finishing the one correct allocation; a split (hedged) budget builds neither and loses.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Fleet capital allocation under a hard, indivisible budget: the same funds buy EITHER added depot/processing capacity OR added collector/worker agents — the classic throughput-versus-collection trade in an autonomous foraging fleet, where a hedged (split) budget yields neither and the mission deadline is missed.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: SC2 capital allocation, PlanBench indivisible budget commit, fleet capital allocation depth-vs-breadth
raw.author: autonomous-loop

summary.en: A capital-allocation decision under a single indivisible budget that is razor-tight: the cash buys EXACTLY ONE coherent path — a WIDE economy (a second refinery plus supporting power: added depot/throughput capacity) OR a DEEP one (keep the single refinery and convert the whole budget into a larger forward force: collection/utilisation). The budget cannot fund both, and any credit diverted to the other path starves the required one so it never completes in time. The test is committing to and finishing the one correct allocation; a split (hedged) budget builds neither and loses.
summary.zh: 单一不可分割的预算下的资本配置决策是非常紧张的：现金购买的正是一条连贯的路径——广泛的经济（第二个炼油厂加上支持能力：增加仓库/吞吐量）或深度经济（保留单一炼油厂并将整个预算转化为更大的前进力量：收集/利用）。预算无法为两者提供资金，任何转移到另一条路径的信贷都会导致所需的信贷紧缺，因此永远无法及时完成。测试致力于并完成一项正确的分配；分割（对冲）预算既不会带来好处，反而会造成损失。

en:
Commander, this is a one-shot capital allocation. You hold a Construction Yard (fact), an Ore Refinery (proc), one Power Plant (powr) and an Allied Barracks (tent), with $1700 cash. Within about 24 turns, own at least two Ore Refineries and at least two Power Plants.
WIN WHEN: own ≥2 'proc' building(s) AND own ≥2 'powr' building(s) AND before game tick 1893.
YOU LOSE IF: not before game tick 1893.
You have at most 24 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Commander, this is a capital-allocation drill with a small utilising force. You hold a Construction Yard (fact), an Ore Refinery (proc), a Power Plant (powr) and an Allied Barracks (tent), with $2000 cash. Within about 26 turns, own at least two Ore Refineries, at least two Power Plants, and field at least three units.
WIN WHEN: own ≥2 'proc' building(s) AND own ≥2 'powr' building(s) AND keep ≥3 units alive AND before game tick 2073.
YOU LOSE IF: not before game tick 2073.
You have at most 26 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Commander, this is a deep capital-allocation drill — convert the budget into a forward force. You hold a Construction Yard (fact), a single Ore Refinery (proc), a Power Plant (powr) and an Allied Barracks (tent), with $2200 cash. Within about 32 turns, field at least 22 units and keep your Refinery standing. Newly produced units must be moved clear of the barracks exit cells or production stalls.
WIN WHEN: keep ≥22 units alive AND own ≥1 'proc' building(s) AND before game tick 2613.
YOU LOSE IF: not before game tick 2613.
You have at most 32 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.
zh:
指挥官，这是一次性的资金配置。您拥有一个建筑场（事实）、一个矿石精炼厂（proc）、一个发电厂（powr）和一个盟军兵营（帐篷），还有 1700 美元现金。在大约24回合内，拥有至少两个矿石精炼厂和至少两个发电厂。
胜利条件：拥有 ≥2 个“proc”建筑物并且拥有 ≥2 个“power”建筑物并且在游戏时间 1893 之前。
失败条件：不是在 1893 年比赛之前。
您最多有 24 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

胜利条件：拥有 ≥2 个“proc”建筑物并拥有 ≥2 个“power”建筑物并保持 ≥3 个单位存活并且在游戏时间 2073 之前。
失败条件：不在游戏刻 2073 之前。
您最多有 26 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

title: Spend Well Against the Clock — Convert a Fixed Budget to Breadth Before Time Runs Out

raw.realWorldMeaning: Time-bounded capital deployment under a BREADTH constraint. A fixed cash budget must be converted into MULTIPLE distinct building types AND a fielded force before a hard tick deadline. Cash left idle at the deadline is wasted; sinking the whole budget into a single structure or a swarm of one unit type misses the breadth bar; the decision is the spend mix (multiple building categories + units) AND the spend tempo (start early enough to fit serial build times inside the clock).
raw.roboticsAnalogue: A field operation with a finite, non-replenishing energy/cash budget that must both establish a multi-category support footprint (production + power + barracks-class facility) AND fielded mission units before a deadline — scheduling expenditure breadth so neither axis (infrastructure cardinality nor deployed force size) starves before the clock runs out.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: SC2 build-order under a fixed budget, PlanBench cost-bounded multi-goal allocation, fixed-budget multi-category provisioning
raw.author: autonomous-loop

summary.en: Time-bounded capital deployment under a BREADTH constraint. A fixed cash budget must be converted into MULTIPLE distinct building types AND a fielded force before a hard tick deadline. Cash left idle at the deadline is wasted; sinking the whole budget into a single structure or a swarm of one unit type misses the breadth bar; the decision is the spend mix (multiple building categories + units) AND the spend tempo (start early enough to fit serial build times inside the clock).
summary.zh: 广度约束下的有时间限制的资本配置。固定的现金预算必须在严格的截止日期之前转换为多种不同的建筑类型和驻扎部队。在截止日期闲置的现金被浪费；将整个预算集中到一个单一的结构或一组单一类型的单元中会错过宽度条；决定是支出组合（多个建筑类别+单元）和支出节奏（尽早开始以适应时钟内的串行构建时间）。

en:
Commander, this is a fixed-budget time-boxed buildup. You start with a Construction Yard, one Power Plant, and an Allied Barracks, plus $4000 cash. Within about 56 turns, you must grow your standing base to at least 4 buildings (any additional production or storage building — a 2nd power plant, a silo, an Ore Refinery, etc. — adds to the count) AND have at least 4 units in the field. Idle cash is wasted; spending it all on units leaves only 3 buildings; spending it all on buildings leaves 0 units. The clock bites — sit on the budget and you LOSE.
WIN WHEN: keep ≥4 units alive AND own ≥4 buildings total AND before game tick 5000.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 5001 OR NOT (own a 'fact')).
You have at most 60 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Commander, this is a tighter fixed-budget buildup. You hold the same Construction Yard (fact), Power Plant (powr) and Allied Barracks (tent), with $2400 cash. Within about 70 turns, grow your base to at least four standing buildings and field at least five trained units, keeping the Construction Yard intact.
WIN WHEN: keep ≥5 units alive AND own ≥4 buildings total AND before game tick 5500.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 5501 OR NOT (own a 'fact')).

title: Expansion AGGRO — Rush to 3 Bases (Growth Supremacy, No Defence)

raw.realWorldMeaning: AGGRO triple-expansion: three indivisible base-builders are committed simultaneously to three DISTINCT geographies, with no surviving home base and no army held in reserve. The decision is whether to embrace the greedy growth play (race the clock; bet that no one punishes the open flank in time) or hedge by keeping one MCV back as defence (and forfeit the third region). The enemy in this scenario is intentionally too weak to punish a fully-greedy commit inside the budget — the discrimination is whether the model RECOGNISES that and commits, instead of defaulting to a "safe" partial expansion that fails the bar.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Autonomous fleet land-grab: three indivisible deployable platforms must each anchor at a distinct claim site before a deadline; the fleet has no escort and no fallback, and the only safe play is speed — any platform held back as a "rover reserve" leaves a claim uncontested and forfeits the multi-site network. Same idea in aggressive market-entry (claim three regional markets ahead of competitors) and in blitzscale (deploy capacity faster than rivals can react, accept the unit-economics hit).
raw.benchmarkAnchor: SC2 greedy 3-base macro / fastest expansion timing, startup blitzscale: skip margin for growth, aggressive market-share land-grab, growth-vs-defence tradeoff
raw.author: openra-bench

title: Expansion BALANCED — 2 Bases, Defend BOTH (Growth + Retention)

raw.realWorldMeaning: BALANCED 2-base expansion: the agent must EXPAND to a second geographic site AND retain the original — the classic growth-with-quality decision. A greedy expander who opens both sites but defends neither loses the original to attrition; a turtle who fortifies the original site but never expands fails the multi-site bar. Only a play that splits investment between new-market entry AND retention infrastructure passes both halves of the brief. The discrimination is whether the model RECOGNISES that the standard balanced macro (expand AND defend) is the bar, not the AGGRO blitzscale (expand only) nor the TURTLE single-site fortress (defend only).
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Autonomous fleet establishing a second forward operating base while keeping a defensive ring around the original: the spare base-builder unit drives to the briefed expansion zone AND the fleet allocates a defensive turret + a small infantry escort at BOTH the new AND the existing base. Skipping either side of the investment loses one site to attrition / a probing intruder before the multi-site network goes live.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: SC2 standard 2-base macro / safe-expand timing, sustainable growth: expand AND defend, product expansion-with-quality: new market + retention, balanced macro: growth+defense
raw.author: openra-bench

summary.en: BALANCED 2-base expansion: the agent must EXPAND to a second geographic site AND retain the original — the classic growth-with-quality decision. A greedy expander who opens both sites but defends neither loses the original to attrition; a turtle who fortifies the original site but never expands fails the multi-site bar. Only a play that splits investment between new-market entry AND retention infrastructure passes both halves of the brief. The discrimination is whether the model RECOGNISES that the standard balanced macro (expand AND defend) is the bar, not the AGGRO blitzscale (expand only) nor the TURTLE single-site fortress (defend only).
summary.zh: 平衡的双基地扩张：代理商必须扩张到第二个地理位置并保留原来的基地——这是经典的质量增长决策。一个贪婪的扩张者打开两个站点但都不保卫任何一个站点，那么原始站点就会因消耗而丢失；一只乌龟在原来的地点加固，但从不扩张，多地点酒吧就失败了。只有在新市场进入和保留基础设施之间分配投资的策略才能通过简报的两部分。区别在于模型是否认识到标准平衡宏（扩展和防御）是障碍，而不是 AGGRO 闪电规模（仅扩展）或 TURTLE 单站点堡垒（仅防御）。

title: Expansion TURTLE — Fortify 1 Base (Defence Supremacy, No Expansion)

raw.realWorldMeaning: TURTLE 1-base fortification: the agent has no second MCV and no `deploy` tool — expansion is structurally off the menu. The only path to win is to take the single pre-placed base and harden it so densely (≥6 pillboxes + ≥2 gun turrets + a minimum army of 3) that an incoming hunt-bot assault is absorbed at the wall, with the home construction yard still standing at the deadline. The discrimination is whether the model embraces the deep-defence play (accepts the 1-base cap and invests the whole economy in static defence + minimum army) instead of defaulting to a "balanced" play that leaves the base under-fortified, or a "pure army" play that gets ground down without towers to anchor on, or an "over-tech" play that builds research while the construction yard is being razed.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Single-site hardening under known incoming threat: a fixed asset (factory, data centre, military outpost) has a known incoming attack inside a fixed window, no option to relocate, and no reinforcement; the only path is to invest the entire budget in passive hardening (walls, turrets, hardened bunkers) plus a minimum on-site response force, accepting that the asset will be irrelevant outside its own perimeter. Same idea in capital allocation (own one market deeply), cybersecurity (concentrate WAF + IDS + bastion at the one public-facing endpoint instead of spreading thin), and military fortress doctrine (concentrate force at one impregnable site).
raw.benchmarkAnchor: SC2 fortress macro / 1-base mass-defense timing, risk-averse business: own one market deeply, military fortress doctrine: concentrate force at impregnable site, defensive-vs-expansion tradeoff in capital allocation
raw.author: openra-bench

summary.zh: TURTLE 1 基地防御工事：特工没有第二个 MCV，也没有“部署”工具——扩展在结构上是不存在的。获胜的唯一途径是占领单个预先放置的基地，并对其进行密集加固（≥6个碉堡+≥2个炮塔+最少3个军队），以便将来袭的狩猎机器人攻击吸收到墙上，而家庭建筑场仍然站在最后期限前。区别在于该模型是否采用纵深防御玩法（接受 1 个基地上限，并将整个经济投资于静态防御 + 最低军队），而不是默认为基地防御不足的“平衡”玩法，或者在没有塔楼锚定的情况下被摧毁的“纯军队”玩法，或者在建筑场被夷为平地时进行研究的“过度技术”玩法。

WIN WHEN: own ≥3 'pbox' building(s) AND own ≥1 'gun' building(s) AND own ≥1 'fact' building(s) AND keep ≥3 units alive AND before game tick 5400.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 5401 OR NOT (own ≥1 'fact' building(s)) OR your whole force is destroyed).

YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 5401 OR NOT (own ≥1 'fact' building(s)) OR your whole force is destroyed).
You have at most 62 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

title: F11 Defense → Counter — Offensive Enemy From t=0

raw.realWorldMeaning: Phase-transition allocation under continuous pressure: the operation opens with a defensive imperative (survive the immediate threat) and pivots to an offensive imperative (build counter-force, strike enemy production). Mis-allocating early budget to offense collapses the defense phase; mis- allocating to defense burns the budget needed for counter. Only a play that interleaves both phases — defending while accumulating counter-force — wins inside the deadline.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Reactive then proactive mission planning: a security drone fleet under attack must first contain the threat (defensive posture), then re-establish full operations (build / scout / strike). The pivot timing is load-bearing — pivot too early and the defense fails; pivot too late and the deadline busts.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: defense-then-counter operational pivot, phase-transition allocation under pressure, reactive then proactive mission planning
raw.author: openra-bench

summary.en: Phase-transition allocation under continuous pressure: the operation opens with a defensive imperative (survive the immediate threat) and pivots to an offensive imperative (build counter-force, strike enemy production). Mis-allocating early budget to offense collapses the defense phase; mis- allocating to defense burns the budget needed for counter. Only a play that interleaves both phases — defending while accumulating counter-force — wins inside the deadline.
summary.zh: 持续压力下的相变分配：行动以防御命令（在眼前的威胁中生存）开始，然后转向进攻命令（建立反击力量，打击敌方生产）。错误地将早期预算分配给进攻会导致防守阶段崩溃；错误地分配给国防会消耗反击所需的预算。只有将两个阶段交织在一起的战术——一边防守一边积累反击——才能在最后期限内获胜。

en:
Commander, this is a defense-then-counter operation. Your western base at (12,20) holds a Construction Yard, a Power Plant, an Ore Refinery, a Barracks, a War Factory, one Harvester, and two pre-placed medium tanks. Cash on hand: $5500. Three enemy medium tanks at midfield are already closing on a hunt order. The enemy base sits at (82,20), 70 cells east, with a Construction Yard and Barracks. Win bar: SURVIVE the opening rush with your Construction Yard intact AND at least one Harvester alive, BUILD a Service Depot AND field at least four medium tanks, AND raze at least one enemy production building — all within about 100 turns.
WIN WHEN: in this exact order: not before game tick 800 AND own ≥1 'fact' building(s) → THEN → have ≥1 'harv' → THEN → have ≥4 '2tnk' → THEN → destroy ≥1 enemy buildings AND before game tick 8900 AND own ≥1 'fact' building(s).
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 8901 OR NOT (own ≥1 'fact' building(s)) OR your whole force is destroyed).
You have at most 100 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 9301 OR NOT (own ≥1 'fact' building(s)) OR your whole force is destroyed).
You have at most 105 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.
