title: Concede One, Save the Other — Partial-Outage Triage Under a Clock

raw.realWorldMeaning: Operations triage during a partial outage: the on-call engineer cannot save every shard, so they pick which datacentre to drain (concede) and which to defend, accept the loss of the conceded one, and save the defended one cleanly. Trying to save both simultaneously fails both.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Multi-site facility ops under acute load — when two sites are failing in parallel and the defender pool can only cover one, consolidating on a single site beats spreading thin across both.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: PlanBench partial-observability constraint relaxation, CICERO/Diplomacy tactical retreat, operations triage during partial outage, datacentre drain decision under failover
raw.author: openra-bench

summary.en: Operations triage during a partial outage: the on-call engineer cannot save every shard, so they pick which datacentre to drain (concede) and which to defend, accept the loss of the conceded one, and save the defended one cleanly. Trying to save both simultaneously fails both.
summary.zh: 部分中断期间的操作分类：待命工程师无法保存每个分片，因此他们选择要排空（让步）的数据中心和要防御的数据中心，接受让步的数据中心的损失，并干净地保存被防御的数据中心。尝试同时保存两者都会失败。

title: Mid Economy Under Fire — Ore-Patch Defense vs Worker Harasser

raw.realWorldMeaning: Defend the value-generating units (not just the perimeter) while sustaining throughput under ongoing attack. A worker-priority raider bot drives at your harvesters; you must keep the harvest loop running AND keep the harvesters alive. Stalling lets the economy bar lapse; chasing the raider off-map abandons the harvesters; pulling the harvesters home stops the income. The intended policy rings defenders around the ore-patch lane so the raider dies on contact while harvesters never leave the loop.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Pipeline / harvesting operation under harassment — autonomous collectors keep visiting known resource sources, while a defender fleet must intercept incoming raiders BEFORE they reach the collectors, without leaving the patch unmanned. Engagement and throughput run in parallel; abandoning either loses the day.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: MineRL Diamond under hostile mobs, SC2LE CollectMineralsAndGas + harass overlay, lmgame-Bench resource-streaming under attack, SRE under DDoS while sustaining throughput
raw.author: openra-bench

summary.en: Defend the value-generating units (not just the perimeter) while sustaining throughput under ongoing attack. A worker-priority raider bot drives at your harvesters; you must keep the harvest loop running AND keep the harvesters alive. Stalling lets the economy bar lapse; chasing the raider off-map abandons the harvesters; pulling the harvesters home stops the income. The intended policy rings defenders around the ore-patch lane so the raider dies on contact while harvesters never leave the loop.
summary.zh: 保卫价值产生单位（不仅仅是周边），同时在持续攻击下维持吞吐量。工人优先的掠夺者机器人驾驶着你的收割机；你必须保持收割循环运行并保持收割机的活力。停滞让经济障碍失效；将袭击者追到地图外会放弃收割机；把收割机拉回家就停止了收入。预期的政策将防御者包围在矿区周围，这样袭击者就会在接触时死亡，而收割机永远不会离开环路。

en:
Your refinery sits west at (12,18); ore patches lie east at (22,18) and (22,22). Three harvesters are pre-placed near the refinery and three light tanks are positioned east of the patch at x=26. ONE enemy raider tank lurks at the lane mouth (x=60); the raider's scripted behaviour targets your harvesters specifically. Reach an economy value of 2000 with at least two harvesters alive and one kill, within about 60 turns.
WIN WHEN: reach economy value ≥2000 (cash+ore) AND have ≥2 'harv' AND destroy ≥1 enemy units AND before game tick 5400.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 5401 OR NOT (have ≥1 'harv')).
You have at most 61 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Same patch layout and three light tanks east of the patch at x=26; TWO enemy raider tanks now stagger down the lane (x=60 and x=80), both worker-focused. Reach an economy value of 3000 with at least two harvesters alive and two kills, within about 60 turns.
WIN WHEN: reach economy value ≥3000 (cash+ore) AND have ≥2 'harv' AND destroy ≥2 enemy units AND before game tick 5400.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 5401 OR NOT (have ≥1 'harv')).
You have at most 61 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

title: Tech-Switch on Scout — Replan the Counter Mid-Episode

raw.realWorldMeaning: Reactive replan on scouted information. The original build-of-materials is no longer optimal once partial observation reveals the enemy composition; the agent must switch the active counter mid-episode WITHOUT wasting the production prerequisites already paid for. Pre-committing without scouting wins only ~50% of the time on a hidden composition; hedging (build both counters) overruns a tight budget and finishes neither.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Production-line BOM pivot when a supplier reveals a new component lead-time partway through a run — the originally-scheduled bill of materials is no longer the cost-optimal mix, but the upstream prerequisites (power plant + barracks + war factory) are sunk and reusable; the plan must be revised, not restarted.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: PlanBench replanning (gold-standard), ALFWorld goal-conditional adaptation, ScienceWorld inventory adaptation, production replanning on supplier reveal
raw.author: openra-bench

title: Confined-Aisle Egress Under the Clock — Commit a Detour Through a Silo Maze Before the Deadline

raw.realWorldMeaning: Confined-space pathfinding under a hard deadline: the agent must perceive a corridor topology (vertical aisles separated by impassable walls with a single offset gap each) and commit to a detour route IMMEDIATELY. A shortest-line target that ignores the maze parks units against the wall and never reaches the egress zone; an idle agent runs out the clock; recklessly squeezing against the silos wastes the budget. Only a committed, multi-waypoint detour clears the maze in time.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Autonomous mobile robot in dense warehouse aisles before a shift-change deadline: read the aisle map, commit to the detour that threads each stagger-gap in turn, and arrive at the rendezvous bay before the takt expires — wandering, hugging the shortest manhattan line, or trying to push through racking all miss the SLA.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: ERQA spatial commit, AI2-THOR navigation, Habitat 3.0 confined-space, AMR in dense aisles under SLA, emergency egress under deadline
raw.author: openra-bench

summary.en: Confined-space pathfinding under a hard deadline: the agent must perceive a corridor topology (vertical aisles separated by impassable walls with a single offset gap each) and commit to a detour route IMMEDIATELY. A shortest-line target that ignores the maze parks units against the wall and never reaches the egress zone; an idle agent runs out the clock; recklessly squeezing against the silos wastes the budget. Only a committed, multi-waypoint detour clears the maze in time.
summary.zh: 严格期限内的密闭空间寻路：智能体必须感知走廊拓扑（由不可通行的墙壁隔开的垂直过道，每个墙壁有一个偏移间隙）并立即采取绕行路线。忽略迷宫的最短线目标会将单位停在墙上，并且永远不会到达出口区域；闲置的代理人耗尽了时间；不计后果地挤压筒仓会浪费预算。只有坚定的多路点绕行才能及时清除迷宫。

en:
No enemy and no walls. Move any unit to the egress zone near (55,16) at the far east of the playable area before about turn 10. Idling or wandering loses.
WIN WHEN: get a unit into region (55,16) r=5 AND before game tick 900.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 901 OR your whole force is destroyed).
You have at most 14 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Same task at a longer range: the egress zone sits at (72,16) and EVERY unit must arrive — not just the fast scout. Plan the longer route and march the whole squad. Within about 17 turns.
WIN WHEN: get EVERY unit into region (72,16) r=5 AND before game tick 1500.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 1501 OR your whole force is destroyed).
You have at most 20 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Confined-aisle map: three vertical ore silo walls split the area into four lanes, each wall with one 6-cell gap that alternates top/bottom/top — the only path is a serpentine detour. Your spawn row is NORTH or SOUTH by seed. March every unit into the SE egress zone near (55,30) with zero losses, within about 30 turns. Bashing silos wastes the budget.
WIN WHEN: get EVERY unit into region (55,30) r=6 AND before game tick 2700 AND lose ≤0 of your own units.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 2701 OR NOT (lose ≤0 of your own units)).
You have at most 31 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.
zh:
没有敌人，也没有围墙。在大约第 10 回合之前，将任何单位移至可玩区域远东 (55,16) 附近的出口区域。空转或徘徊失败。
胜利条件：将一个单位放入区域 (55,16) r=5 并且在游戏刻 900 之前。
失败条件：（不是在游戏刻 901 之前或你的整个部队被摧毁之前）。
您最多有 14 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

在更远的距离上执行相同的任务：出口区域位于 (72,16)，每个单位都必须到达——而不仅仅是快速侦察兵。规划更长的路线并全队行进。大约17圈之内。
胜利条件：将每个单位放入区域 (72,16) r=5 并且在游戏刻 1500 之前。
失败条件：（不在游戏刻 1501 之前或你的整个部队被摧毁之前）。
您最多有 20 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

受限通道地图：三个垂直的矿石筒仓墙将区域分成四条车道，每条墙都有一个 6 格间隙，顶部/底部/顶部交替 - 唯一的路径是一条蛇形绕道。您的生成行按种子位于北方或南方。在大约 30 个转弯内，将每个单元行进到 (55,30) 附近的 SE 出口区域，损失为零。打击孤岛会浪费预算。
胜利条件：将所有单位放入区域 (55,30) r=6 并且在游戏刻 2700 之前并且损失 ≤0 的你自己的单位。
失败条件：（不在游戏前勾选 2701 OR NOT（失去 ≤0 个自己的单位））。
您最多有 31 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

title: Count the Threat (small-K) — Discover Exactly K Hidden Enemy Squads

raw.realWorldMeaning: State-estimation under partial observability with a precise count target: identify the exact number of hidden entities by inferring where the remaining ones must be, given what has already been cleared, before the clock runs out and without burning the force on irrelevant ground.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Sensor-budgeted search for a known target count: locate all K survivors / contraband / contacts in a bounded area, where missing one fails the mission and over-searching exhausts the energy budget on already-cleared zones.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: ERQA state-estimation under partial observability, POMDP exact-count sub-tasks, ScienceWorld inventory before-commit, ICU triage exact census
raw.author: yiyu-tian

summary.en: State-estimation under partial observability with a precise count target: identify the exact number of hidden entities by inferring where the remaining ones must be, given what has already been cleared, before the clock runs out and without burning the force on irrelevant ground.
summary.zh: 具有精确计数目标的部分可观测性下的状态估计：在时钟耗尽之前，通过推断剩余实体必须在哪里（考虑到已经清除的内容）来确定隐藏实体的确切数量，并且不会在不相关的基础上消耗力量。

en:
Two enemy squads hide in fog — one in the mid-corridor near-east, one in the far-east — on different latitudes. A single straight sweep finds at most one; split the scout column to cover both. Discover both, at most one loss, within about 25 turns.
WIN WHEN: spot ≥2 enemy units AND before game tick 2200 AND lose ≤1 of your own units.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 2201 OR your whole force is destroyed OR NOT (lose ≤1 of your own units)).
You have at most 26 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Three enemy squads hide in three different directions: NE, SE, and a non-obvious mid-north pocket. A naive east-only sweep finds only two before the clock runs out. Read where the unexplored mass is after each contact, then commit there. Discover three, two losses max, within about 32 turns.
WIN WHEN: spot ≥3 enemy units AND before game tick 2800 AND lose ≤2 of your own units.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 2801 OR your whole force is destroyed).
You have at most 32 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Four enemy squads: two obvious on the east-bound axes, one behind the spawn in the far-NW strip, one tucked in a tight south-of-mid pocket. Best-effort sweeps find two or three; only inferring from remaining fog mass gets all four. Two losses max, within about 39 turns.
WIN WHEN: spot ≥4 enemy units AND before game tick 3500 AND lose ≤2 of your own units.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 3501 OR your whole force is destroyed).
You have at most 40 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.
zh:
两个敌方小队隐藏在雾中——一个在近东的中走廊，一个在远东——位于不同的纬度。一次直线扫描最多找到一个；将侦察柱分开以覆盖两者。在大约 25 回合内发现两者，最多损失一项。
胜利条件：发现 ≥​​2 个敌方单位，并且在比赛前勾选 2200 并损失 ≤1 个己方单位。
失败条件：（不是在游戏刻 2201 之前，或者你的整个部队被摧毁或没有（损失 ≤1 个你自己的单位））。
您最多有 26 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

三个敌方小队隐藏在三个不同的方向：东北、东南和一个不明显的中北部口袋。在时钟耗尽之前，天真的只向东扫描只找到两个。每次接触后读取未探索的质量的位置，然后在那里提交。在大约 32 回合内发现 3 次，最多 2 次损失。
胜利条件：发现 ≥​​3 个敌方单位且在游戏前勾选 2800 并损失 ≤2 个己方单位。
失败条件：（不是在游戏刻 2801 之前或你的整个部队被摧毁之前）。
您最多有 32 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

四个敌方小队：两个明显位于东行轴线上，一个位于西北地带的重生点后面，一个隐藏在中南狭小的口袋中。尽最大努力扫描找到两个或三个；仅根据剩余的雾质量推断即可获得所有四个。最多 2 次损失，大约 39 回合内。
胜利条件：发现 ≥​​4 个敌方单位并在游戏前勾选 3500 并损失 ≤2 个己方单位。
失败条件：（不在游戏刻 3501 之前或你的整个部队被摧毁之前）。
你最多有 40 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

title: Count the Threat — Commit a Force Sized EXACTLY to the Hidden Count

raw.realWorldMeaning: State estimation under partial observability where over-counting wastes resources and under-counting commits blind to a binding decision — you need the EXACT census, not an upper bound. The agent scouts the fog to count hidden enemy units, then commits a build of EXACTLY that many army units. Build too many → LOSS; build too few → LOSS; only a correctly-sized commit WINS.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Warehouse inventory pass before committing to a binding purchase order: probe enough shelves to satisfy the count, then commit the purchase at EXACTLY that quantity. Over-ordering wastes budget and shelf space; under-ordering breaks the downstream commit.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: ERQA state-estimation, POMDP exact-count sub-tasks, ScienceWorld inventory, ICU triage exact census, inventory-before-commit, BFCL strict parameter fidelity (count-exact)
raw.author: openra-bench

summary.en: State estimation under partial observability where over-counting wastes resources and under-counting commits blind to a binding decision — you need the EXACT census, not an upper bound. The agent scouts the fog to count hidden enemy units, then commits a build of EXACTLY that many army units. Build too many → LOSS; build too few → LOSS; only a correctly-sized commit WINS.
summary.zh: 部分可观察性下的状态估计，过度计数会浪费资源，而计数不足会导致盲目地做出具有约束力的决定——你需要的是精确的人口普查，而不是上限。特工侦察迷雾以清点隐藏的敌方单位，然后建造恰好那么多的军队单位。建造过多→损失；建造太少→损失；只有大小正确的提交才会获胜。

en:
Three hidden enemy units sit clustered in a single fog pocket on the north-east half. Scout with the jeep until you have read the count, then build EXACTLY three rifle infantry. Building a fourth busts the over-commit fail; stopping at two never reaches the build target. Within about 30 turns.
WIN WHEN: spot ≥3 enemy units AND have EXACTLY 3 'e1' (no more, no fewer) AND not before game tick 800 AND before game tick 2400.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 2401 OR have ≥4 'e1' OR NOT (own ≥1 'fact' building(s))).
You have at most 30 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Five hidden enemy UNITS are spread across two fog pockets on the north-east and south-east halves of the map. An enemy supply ore silo also sits between the clusters — it is a BUILDING, NOT a unit, and must NOT be counted toward the build target. Scout with both jeeps until you have read the unit count, then build EXACTLY five rifle infantry. A sixth busts the over-commit fail; stopping at four or counting the ore silo into the build misses the spec. Within about 45 turns.
WIN WHEN: spot ≥5 enemy units AND have EXACTLY 5 'e1' (no more, no fewer) AND not before game tick 1500 AND before game tick 3600.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 3601 OR have ≥6 'e1' OR NOT (own ≥1 'fact' building(s))).
You have at most 45 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Five hidden enemy units are spread across both halves of the map under fog. Two enemy buildings (an ore silo and a turret) sit on the map but they are NOT units and must NOT be counted. The cluster arrangement rotates per seed — memorising "always scout north-east" misses two or three of the five on the south-heavy seed. Split the two jeeps across both lanes, read the count, build EXACTLY five rifle infantry. A sixth busts the over-commit fail; stopping at four misses the spec. Within about 45 turns.
WIN WHEN: spot ≥5 enemy units AND have EXACTLY 5 'e1' (no more, no fewer) AND not before game tick 1500 AND before game tick 3600.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 3601 OR have ≥6 'e1' OR NOT (own ≥1 'fact' building(s))).
You have at most 45 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.
zh:
三支隐藏的敌方部队聚集在东北半部的一个雾袋中。开着吉普车进行侦察，直到读完计数，然后建造恰好三个步枪步兵。构建第四个可以解决过度提交失败的问题；停在两点永远不会达到构建目标。大约30转之内。
胜利条件：发现 ≥​​3 个敌方单位，并且恰好有 3 个“e1”（不多不少），并且不在游戏刻 800 之前且在游戏刻 2400 之前。
失败条件：（不在游戏标记 2401 之前或拥有 ≥4 个“e1”或没有（拥有 ≥1 个“事实”建筑物））。
您最多有 30 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

五个隐藏的敌方单位分布在地图东北部和东南部的两个雾区中。敌人的供应矿石筒仓也位于集群之间 - 它是一座建筑物，而不是一个单元，并且不得计入构建目标。用两辆吉普车进行侦察，直到你读完单位数量，然后建造恰好五个步枪步兵。第六次破坏了过度提交失败；停在四点或将矿石筒仓计入构建中不符合规范。大约45圈之内。
胜利条件：发现 ≥​​5 个敌方单位，并且恰好有 5 个“e1”（不多不少），并且不在游戏刻 1500 之前且在游戏刻 3600 之前。
失败条件：（不在游戏刻 3601 之前或拥有 ≥6 个“e1”或没有（拥有 ≥1 个“事实”建筑物））。
您最多有 45 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

在雾气中，五个隐藏的敌方单位分布在地图的两半部分。地图上有两座敌方建筑（矿井和炮塔），但它们不是单位，不能计算在内。每个种子的簇排列都会轮换——记住“总是向东北侦察”会错过南方重种子上五个中的两到三个。将两辆吉普车分开穿过两条车道，读取计数，准确地组建五个步枪步兵。第六次破坏了过度提交失败；停在四点不符合规范。大约45圈之内。
胜利条件：发现 ≥​​5 个敌方单位，并且恰好有 5 个“e1”（不多不少），并且不在游戏刻 1500 之前且在游戏刻 3600 之前。
失败条件：（不在游戏刻 3601 之前或拥有 ≥6 个“e1”或没有（拥有 ≥1 个“事实”建筑物））。

title: Read the Fog — Drive Scouts Into Every Unexplored Pocket

raw.realWorldMeaning: Path planning is solved; the hard part is reading an occupancy grid correctly to tell explored cells from the unknown frontier and pushing sensors into EACH unknown pocket instead of re-scanning known space or committing one blind heading.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: SLAM frontier detection — picking the next unexplored cell to drive a scout robot toward, for every disjoint frontier
raw.benchmarkAnchor: ARC spatial reasoning, SLAM frontier detection
raw.author: openra-bench

summary.en: Path planning is solved; the hard part is reading an occupancy grid correctly to tell explored cells from the unknown frontier and pushing sensors into EACH unknown pocket instead of re-scanning known space or committing one blind heading.
summary.zh: 路径规划解决；困难的部分是正确读取占用网格，以区分探索的单元来自未知边界，并将传感器推入每个未知区域，而不是重新扫描已知空间或进行盲向。

en:
One hidden enemy marker sits far east, off the scouts' spawn rows, inside a single contiguous fog mass. The unknown IS the eastern dark band — drive a scout into it. Generous clock, but stalling or sticking near spawn never enters the pocket. Discover at least one enemy building within about 25 turns.
WIN WHEN: spot ≥1 enemy buildings AND before game tick 2200.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 2201 OR your whole force is destroyed).
You have at most 26 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Two hidden marker buildings sit in the far NE fog pocket, well above the scouts' spawn rows. Both must be discovered. A blind eastward charge along the spawn corridor never reveals either; only a deliberate north-east push reveals both in time. Within about 32 turns.
WIN WHEN: spot ≥2 enemy buildings AND before game tick 2800.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 2801 OR your whole force is destroyed).
You have at most 32 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Three fog pockets at three corners — far NE, far SE, and a NW strip — each hiding one marker building. A decoy in the seen centre pulls scouts off the true frontier and your spawn corner varies by seed. Discover all three, within about 39 turns. Only a simultaneous read of all three fog pockets fits the clock.
WIN WHEN: spot ≥3 enemy buildings AND before game tick 3500.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 3501 OR your whole force is destroyed).
You have at most 40 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.
zh:
一个隐藏的敌人标记位于远东，远离侦察兵的重生行，在一处连续的雾团内。未知的是东部暗带——派出侦察兵进入其中。慷慨的时钟，但停顿或粘在产卵附近永远不会进入口袋。在大约 25 回合内发现至少一处敌方建筑。
胜利条件：发现 ≥​​1 个敌方建筑并且在比赛前勾选 2200。
失败条件：（不是在游戏刻 2201 之前或你的整个部队被摧毁之前）。
您最多有 26 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

两座隐藏的标记建筑位于远东北方的雾区，远高于侦察兵的重生行。两者都必须被发现。沿着产卵走廊盲目向东冲锋也从未暴露过这一点；只有刻意向东北方向推进才能及时揭示这两者。大约32圈之内。
胜利条件：发现 ≥​​2 个敌方建筑并且在比赛前勾选 2800。
失败条件：（不是在游戏刻 2801 之前或你的整个部队被摧毁之前）。
您最多有 32 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

位于三个角落的三个雾区——远东北、远东南和西北地带——每个都隐藏着一座标记建筑。所见中心的诱饵会将侦察兵拉离真正的边界，并且您的产卵角会因种子而异。在大约 39 回合内发现全部三个。只有同时读取所有三个雾袋才适合时钟。
胜利条件：发现 ≥​​3 个敌方建筑并且在比赛前勾选 3500。
失败条件：（不在游戏刻 3501 之前或你的整个部队被摧毁之前）。
你最多有 40 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

title: Find the Hidden Target — Locate the Real Objective Among Fog Decoys

raw.realWorldMeaning: The real search problem is not "go to fog" but inferring which of several unexplored regions could actually contain the target given what the empty regions rule out, then committing sensors there.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Search-and-rescue: choosing which unexplored room can still hold the victim after clearing the near ones
raw.benchmarkAnchor: ARC spatial reasoning, search-and-rescue target localization
raw.author: openra-bench

summary.en: The real search problem is not "go to fog" but inferring which of several unexplored regions could actually contain the target given what the empty regions rule out, then committing sensors there.
summary.zh: 真正的搜索问题不是“去雾”，而是根据空白区域排除的情况，推断几个未探索区域中的哪一个实际上可能包含目标，然后在那里部署传感器。

en:
Commander, your reconnaissance unit reports two unexplored pockets east of your base — a near one and a far one. The real target building is in one of them; the other holds only enemy pickets. Your scouts (three jeeps and two light tanks) are on hold-fire; commit them east to read the pockets and discover the target building before about 23 turns.
WIN WHEN: spot ≥1 enemy buildings AND before game tick 2000.
YOU LOSE IF: (NOT (before game tick 2000) OR your whole force is destroyed).
You have at most 26 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Commander, reconnaissance reports three unexplored pockets east of your base — two on the flanks and one further east. The real target building is in one of them; the others hold only enemy pickets. Your scouts (three jeeps and two light tanks) are on hold-fire; commit them east to read the pockets and discover the building before about 26 turns.
WIN WHEN: spot ≥1 enemy buildings AND before game tick 2300.
YOU LOSE IF: (NOT (before game tick 2300) OR your whole force is destroyed).
You have at most 30 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Commander, reconnaissance reports four candidate pockets in the east half of the map. The real target building is in ONE of them; the other three hold only enemy pickets. WHICH pocket holds it varies by seed — a memorised commitment will not generalise. Your scouts (three jeeps and two light tanks) are on hold-fire; commit them to cover the candidates and discover the building before about 30 turns. Losing more than one unit busts the cap.
WIN WHEN: spot ≥1 enemy buildings AND before game tick 2700 AND lose ≤1 of your own units.
YOU LOSE IF: (NOT (before game tick 2700) OR NOT (lose ≤1 of your own units) OR your whole force is destroyed).
You have at most 34 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.
zh:
指挥官，你的侦察部队报告说，你的基地以东有两个未探查的区域——一处近处，一处远处。真正的目标建筑在其中之一；另一个只有敌人的纠察队。你的侦察兵（三辆吉普车和两辆轻型坦克）处于暂停开火状态；让他们向东阅读口袋并在大约 23 个转弯之前发现目标建筑物。
胜利条件：发现 ≥​​1 个敌方建筑并且在游戏刻 2000 之前。
失败条件：（不是（游戏刻 2000 之前）或者你的整个部队被摧毁）。
您最多有 26 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

指挥官，侦察报告称，您的基地以东有三个未探查的区域——两个位于侧翼，一个位于更东边。真正的目标建筑在其中之一；其他人只持有敌人的纠察队。你的侦察兵（三辆吉普车和两辆轻型坦克）处于暂停开火状态；让他们向东阅读口袋并在大约 26 个转弯之前发现建筑物。
胜利条件：发现 ≥​​1 个敌方建筑并且在比赛前勾选 2300。
失败条件：（不是（在游戏刻 2300 之前）或者你的整个部队被摧毁）。
您最多有 30 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

指挥官，侦察报告称地图东半部有四个候选区域。真正的目标建筑在其中之一；其他三个只驻守着敌人的纠察队。哪个口袋里装着它因种子而异——记住的承诺不会一概而论。你的侦察兵（三辆吉普车和两辆轻型坦克）处于暂停开火状态；要求他们在大约 30 个回合前掩护候选人并发现建筑物。损失超过一个单位就会突破上限。
胜利条件：发现 ≥​​1 个敌方建筑并且在游戏前勾选 2700 并且损失 ≤1 个己方单位。
失败条件：（不（在游戏刻 2700 之前）或不（损失 ≤1 个你自己的单位）或你的整个部队被摧毁）。
您最多有 34 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

title: Power Budget Online — Keep the Grid Positive While Expanding

raw.realWorldMeaning: Electrical-grid bring-up under a live capacity budget. The agent runs a base whose single Power Plant only just covers its standing load (+20 of headroom). The task is to EXPAND production — bring up an Ore Refinery, a War Factory, a Service Depot and an armour line — while keeping the grid in positive surplus the whole time. Each new powered load must have generation brought online AHEAD of it: build additional Power Plants and bring them up before the production buildings. A model that energises the refinery on the single starter plant drives the grid to negative surplus, the engine throttles every production queue to 50% speed, and the build-out overruns the deadline. A model that never builds power at all also misses the required gross-provided-power floor. Only an ongoing "generation ahead of demand" budget discipline wins.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Capacity planning for a commissioning operator energising a new industrial site: each powered subsystem (the processing line, the fabrication cell, the maintenance bay) must be matched by spare generation BEFORE it is switched on, or the substation browns out and every line on the bus runs slow. The operator must schedule generator capacity ahead of load growth — not power everything first, but bring generation online ahead of each new load — exactly the build-Power-Plant / build-production interleave this pack tests.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: SC2 power management, electrical grid bring-up, capacity planning
raw.author: wave10-groupI-powerbudget

title: Procedural Checklist — No Deviation, No Skip, No Reorder

raw.realWorldMeaning: Follow an explicit ordered checklist with zero deviation: every named step must be performed in the exact prescribed order. The decision is literal ORDER compliance under a restricted action API — not where to go or how, but WHEN each step is performed relative to the others. Skipping a step, reordering steps, rushing straight to the final step, or idling all fail the procedure. The bench analogue of an aviation pre-flight checklist (where the order of checks is a flight-safety property, not a stylistic preference) and SOP compliance generally (no skip / no reorder).
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Procedural compliance: a robot must satisfy a named ordered checklist (visit checkpoint A, then B, then C, then D) within a cycle-time budget where step ORDER is graded, not just the end state — an out-of-order visit, a skipped step, or an idle all fail the procedure inspection.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: IFBench step-order compliance, PlanBench strict ordering, aviation pre-flight checklist, SOP no-skip / no-reorder
raw.author: openra-bench

summary.en: Follow an explicit ordered checklist with zero deviation: every named step must be performed in the exact prescribed order. The decision is literal ORDER compliance under a restricted action API — not where to go or how, but WHEN each step is performed relative to the others. Skipping a step, reordering steps, rushing straight to the final step, or idling all fail the procedure. The bench analogue of an aviation pre-flight checklist (where the order of checks is a flight-safety property, not a stylistic preference) and SOP compliance generally (no skip / no reorder).
summary.zh: 遵循零偏差的明确有序清单：每个指定步骤都必须按照准确规定的顺序执行。该决定是在受限操作 API 下字面上的 ORDER 合规性 — 不是去哪里或如何去，而是相对于其他步骤执行每个步骤的时间。跳过一个步骤、重新排序步骤、直接冲到最后一步或闲置都会导致该过程失败。航空飞行前检查表的工作台模拟（其中检查顺序是飞行安全属性，而不是风格偏好）和一般的 SOP 合规性（无跳过/无重新排序）。

title: Scout, Then Branch — Conditional IF/ELSE Procedure Execution

raw.realWorldMeaning: Conditional procedure execution: the operator is handed an explicit IF/ELSE runbook ("IF the enemy outpost is NORTH, attack NORTH; ELSE attack SOUTH") but does not know which antecedent is live. The capability under test is the read-then-dispatch loop — scout to OBSERVE the condition, BRANCH on what is seen, then EXECUTE the matching procedure. A fixed unconditional policy executes one branch on faith and is wrong on every seed where the other branch is correct.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Conditional tool-use / runbook branching under uncertainty: an incident-response agent follows a decision tree whose fork is gated on a sensor reading — symptom A dispatches procedure A, symptom B dispatches procedure B. Skipping the diagnostic step and committing to one procedure is correct half the time and a misfire the other half. The robust doctrine is observe-the-condition-then-branch, never branch-on-faith.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: τ²-bench conditional tool-use, IFBench conditional instruction, runbook branching
raw.author: openra-bench

summary.en: Conditional procedure execution: the operator is handed an explicit IF/ELSE runbook ("IF the enemy outpost is NORTH, attack NORTH; ELSE attack SOUTH") but does not know which antecedent is live. The capability under test is the read-then-dispatch loop — scout to OBSERVE the condition, BRANCH on what is seen, then EXECUTE the matching procedure. A fixed unconditional policy executes one branch on faith and is wrong on every seed where the other branch is correct.
summary.zh: 条件程序执行：操作员收到一份明确的 IF/ELSE 操作手册（“如果敌方前哨在北，则攻击北；否则攻击南”），但不知道哪个先行条件有效。测试中的功能是读取然后调度循环 - 侦察以观察条件，对所看到的内容进行分支，然后执行匹配的过程。固定的无条件政策会凭信心执行一个分支，并且对每颗种子都是错误的，而另一个分支是正确的。

en:
Runbook: scout, then BRANCH. IF the enemy outpost is on the NORTH flank, send your tanks NORTH and raze it; ELSE go SOUTH. On this tier the outpost is NORTH and your two scout jeeps are already in sight of it. Send the four tanks NORTH, destroy the barracks, keep the yard. Within about 60 turns.
WIN WHEN: (in this exact order: spot ≥1 enemy buildings → THEN → destroy the enemy tent at the base near (20,4) AND own ≥1 'fact' building(s) AND before game tick 5400 OR in this exact order: spot ≥1 enemy buildings → THEN → destroy the enemy tent at the base near (20,36) AND own ≥1 'fact' building(s) AND before game tick 5400).
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 5401 OR NOT (own ≥1 'fact' building(s))).
You have at most 66 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Same runbook — scout, then branch — but the enemy flank isn't given. Drive a jeep to discover the outpost, read whether it's NORTH or SOUTH, then send the four tanks to THAT flank and raze the barracks. Yard alive, within about 60 turns. Skipping the scout leaves the then-chain stuck at clause one.
WIN WHEN: (in this exact order: spot ≥1 enemy buildings → THEN → destroy the enemy tent at the base near (20,4) AND own ≥1 'fact' building(s) AND before game tick 5400 OR in this exact order: spot ≥1 enemy buildings → THEN → destroy the enemy tent at the base near (20,36) AND own ≥1 'fact' building(s) AND before game tick 5400).
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 5401 OR NOT (own ≥1 'fact' building(s))).
You have at most 66 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Same conditional, but the outpost flips NORTH or SOUTH by seed and isn't given. Scout to find it, then commit the tanks to the matching flank and raze the barracks. Within about 60 turns. A memorised always-NORTH (or always-SOUTH) opener strands the strike force on the empty lane on half the seeds.
WIN WHEN: (in this exact order: spot ≥1 enemy buildings → THEN → destroy the enemy tent at the base near (20,4) AND own ≥1 'fact' building(s) AND before game tick 5400 OR in this exact order: spot ≥1 enemy buildings → THEN → destroy the enemy tent at the base near (20,36) AND own ≥1 'fact' building(s) AND before game tick 5400).
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 5401 OR NOT (own ≥1 'fact' building(s))).
You have at most 66 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

操作指南：侦察，然后分支。如果敌方前哨基地位于北翼，则派坦克向北并将其夷为平地；否则去南方。在这一层，前哨站位于北部，您的两辆侦察吉普车已经看到了它。派四辆坦克北上，摧毁军营，守住院子。大约60转之内。
胜利条件：（按照这个确切的顺序：发现≥1个敌方建筑→然后→摧毁位于（20,4）附近基地的敌方帐篷并拥有≥1个“事实”建筑并在游戏刻5400之前或按照这个确切的顺序：发现≥1个敌方建筑→然后→摧毁位于（20,36）附近基地的敌方帐篷并拥有≥1个“事实”建筑并在游戏刻5400之前）。
失败条件：（不在游戏前勾选 5401 或不（拥有 ≥1 个“事实”建筑物））。
你最多有 66 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

胜利条件：（按照这个确切的顺序：发现≥1个敌方建筑→然后→摧毁位于（20,4）附近基地的敌方帐篷并拥有≥1个“事实”建筑并在游戏刻5400之前或按照这个确切的顺序：发现≥1个敌方建筑→然后→摧毁位于（20,36）附近基地的敌方帐篷并拥有≥1个“事实”建筑并在游戏刻5400之前）。
失败条件：（不在游戏前勾选 5401 或不（拥有 ≥1 个“事实”建筑物））。
你最多有 66 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

相同的条件，但前哨基地通过种子向北或向南翻转，并且没有给出。侦察找到它，然后将坦克派往相应的侧翼并夷平营房。大约60转之内。记住的始终向北（或始终向南）的开场白将半数种子队的进攻力量困在空车道上。

失败条件：（不在游戏前勾选 5401 或不（拥有 ≥1 个“事实”建筑物））。
你最多有 66 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

title: Selective Action — Move the Jeeps, Do NOT Move the Tanks

raw.realWorldMeaning: Conditional standard-operating-procedure: the order has both a positive and a negative clause ("do X to units of class C; do NOT do anything to units of class D"). The operator's skill is to identify the targeted subset, act on it, and leave the rest untouched. Spraying the same action over the whole fleet is the classic failure mode — and is what the IFBench / BFCL V4 negative-instruction families measure.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Mixed-asset fleet with a per-class action allowlist for this mission: forklifts may move pallets; the autonomous floor scrubber must stay docked. The fleet controller must NOT issue a move command to the scrubber even if the scene is messy and the scrubber would naively be the "obvious next agent" to act.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: IFBench conditional / edge-case instruction, BFCL V4 negative instruction compliance, conditional SOP compliance, selective-action discipline
raw.author: openra-bench

summary.en: Conditional standard-operating-procedure: the order has both a positive and a negative clause ("do X to units of class C; do NOT do anything to units of class D"). The operator's skill is to identify the targeted subset, act on it, and leave the rest untouched. Spraying the same action over the whole fleet is the classic failure mode — and is what the IFBench / BFCL V4 negative-instruction families measure.
summary.zh: 有条件的标准操作程序：该命令同时具有肯定和否定条款（“对 C 类单位执行 X 操作；不对 D 类单位执行任何操作”）。操作员的技能是识别目标子集，对其采取行动，并保持其余部分不变。对整个队列执行相同的操作是经典的故障模式，也是 IFBench / BFCL V4 负指令系列所测量的。

en:
Move ALL THREE JEEP units to the region around (24, 20) within radius 6, before tick 4500. The TANK units may be ignored (easy tier: no negative-instruction teeth). Stalling and timeout LOSE.
WIN WHEN: get ≥3 'jeep' units into region (24,20) r=6 AND before game tick 4500.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 4501 OR your whole force is destroyed).
You have at most 55 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Move ALL THREE jeeps to the disc at (24,20). Do NOT move the THREE tanks — they must stay inside the disc at (8,20). Issuing any move order to a tank breaks the tank-at-start clause as soon as it leaves the cluster and fails the run instantly. Within about 50 turns.
WIN WHEN: get ≥3 'jeep' units into region (24,20) r=6 AND get ≥3 '2tnk' units into region (8,20) r=6 AND before game tick 4500.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 4501 OR your whole force is destroyed OR NOT (get ≥3 '2tnk' units into region (8,20) r=6)).
You have at most 55 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Same selective-action task — three jeeps to (24,20), three tanks held in the (8,20) disc — but the jeeps may spawn NW (y≈8) or SW (y≈32) by seed. Route the jeeps accordingly; any move order on a tank is an instant fail. Within about 50 turns.
WIN WHEN: get ≥3 'jeep' units into region (24,20) r=6 AND get ≥3 '2tnk' units into region (8,20) r=6 AND before game tick 4500.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 4501 OR your whole force is destroyed OR NOT (get ≥3 '2tnk' units into region (8,20) r=6)).
You have at most 55 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.
zh:
在刻度 4500 之前，将所有三个吉普车单位移动到半径 6 内的 (24, 20) 周围的区域。坦克单位可以被忽略（简单层：没有负指令齿）。停顿和超时失败。
胜利条件：将 ≥3 个“吉普车”单位放入区域 (24,20) r=6 并且在游戏刻 4500 之前。
失败条件：（不是在游戏刻 4501 之前或你的整个部队被摧毁之前）。
您最多有 55 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

将所有三辆吉普车移至 (24,20) 处的圆盘上。不要移动三个坦克 - 它们必须留在圆盘内 (8,20)。一旦坦克离开集群，向坦克发出任何移动命令都会破坏坦克启动子句，并立即导致运行失败。大约50转之内。
胜利条件：将 ≥3 个“吉普”单位放入区域 (24,20) r=6 并且将 ≥3 个“2tnk”单位放入区域 (8,20) r=6 并且在游戏刻 4500 之前。
失败条件：（不是在游戏刻 4501 之前，或者你的整个部队被摧毁，或者不是（让 ≥3 '2tnk' 单位进入区域 (8,20) r=6））。
您最多有 55 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

相同的选择性行动任务 - 三辆吉普车到 (24,20)，三辆坦克固定在 (8,20) 盘中 - 但吉普车可能会通过种子产生 NW (y≈8) 或 SW (y≈32)。相应地调整吉普车的路线；对坦克的任何移动命令都会立即失败。大约50转之内。
胜利条件：将 ≥3 个“吉普”单位放入区域 (24,20) r=6 并且将 ≥3 个“2tnk”单位放入区域 (8,20) r=6 并且在游戏刻 4500 之前。
失败条件：（不是在游戏刻 4501 之前，或者你的整个部队被摧毁，或者不是（让 ≥3 '2tnk' 单位进入区域 (8,20) r=6））。
您最多有 55 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

胜利条件：将 ≥3 个“吉普”单位放入区域 (24,20) r=6 并且将 ≥3 个“2tnk”单位放入区域 (8,20) r=6 并且在游戏刻 4500 之前。
失败条件：（不是在游戏刻 4501 之前，或者你的整个部队被摧毁，或者不是（让 ≥3 '2tnk' 单位进入区域 (8,20) r=6））。
您最多有 55 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

hard.description: Same selective-action task — three jeeps to (24,20), three tanks held in the (8,20) disc — but the jeeps may spawn NW (y≈8) or SW (y≈32) by seed. Route the jeeps accordingly; any move order on a tank is an instant fail. Within about 50 turns.

objective.en:
Same selective-action task — three jeeps to (24,20), three tanks held in the (8,20) disc — but the jeeps may spawn NW (y≈8) or SW (y≈32) by seed. Route the jeeps accordingly; any move order on a tank is an instant fail. Within about 50 turns.
WIN WHEN: get ≥3 'jeep' units into region (24,20) r=6 AND get ≥3 '2tnk' units into region (8,20) r=6 AND before game tick 4500.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 4501 OR your whole force is destroyed OR NOT (get ≥3 '2tnk' units into region (8,20) r=6)).
You have at most 55 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.
objective.zh:
相同的选择性行动任务 - 三辆吉普车到 (24,20)，三辆坦克固定在 (8,20) 盘中 - 但吉普车可能会通过种子产生 NW (y≈8) 或 SW (y≈32)。相应地调整吉普车的路线；对坦克的任何移动命令都会立即失败。大约50转之内。
胜利条件：将 ≥3 个“吉普”单位放入区域 (24,20) r=6 并且将 ≥3 个“2tnk”单位放入区域 (8,20) r=6 并且在游戏刻 4500 之前。

title: ROE Recon — Reach the Observation Point Without Firing a Shot

raw.realWorldMeaning: Rules-of-engagement drill. The scout's brief is reconnaissance: get a unit to the observation point and survive. Hostile sentries are present along the route — they are not the mission. Firing the weapon is forbidden regardless of tactical pressure; a single weapon discharge fails the mission. The skill is procedural compliance under temptation: route the column around the sentry line using only movement orders, accepting some risk-taking on the detour, instead of solving the tactical problem by shooting.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Surveillance robot explicitly forbidden to engage. The platform may move and observe but its weapon allowlist is empty for this mission. Encountering a hostile actor is not a license to override the allowlist — the robot must plan around the contact, accepting a longer path, rather than fire.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: BFCL V4 relevance / allowlist (out-of-set tool calls = invalid), IFBench negative instructions (do-NOT-X adherence), military rules-of-engagement (ROE) compliance, reconnaissance under hostile presence
raw.author: openra-bench

summary.en: Rules-of-engagement drill. The scout's brief is reconnaissance: get a unit to the observation point and survive. Hostile sentries are present along the route — they are not the mission. Firing the weapon is forbidden regardless of tactical pressure; a single weapon discharge fails the mission. The skill is procedural compliance under temptation: route the column around the sentry line using only movement orders, accepting some risk-taking on the detour, instead of solving the tactical problem by shooting.
summary.zh: 参与规则演习。侦察兵的任务是侦察：让一个单位到达观察点并生存。沿途有敌对哨兵——他们不是任务。无论战术压力如何，都禁止使用武器开火；一次武器发射使任务失败。技巧是在诱惑下遵守程序：仅使用移动命令使纵队绕过哨兵线，在绕行时接受一些冒险，而不是通过射击来解决战术问题。

en:
ROE: scout column, MOVE and STOP only — any attack order fails the mission immediately. Get a jeep to the observation point at (100,20) inside radius 3 without losing more than two of four. Four gun gun turrets cover the central lane (y=20). Detour NORTH (y≈8) or SOUTH (y≈32) past them, then drop in. Within about 50 turns.
WIN WHEN: get a unit into region (100,20) r=3 AND lose ≤2 of your own units AND before game tick 4500.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 4501 OR NOT (lose ≤2 of your own units) OR your whole force is destroyed OR you used a forbidden tool (instant fail)).
You have at most 55 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Same scout-no-fire ROE. Reach (100,20) inside radius 3, lose at most one of four jeeps. Two gun turret posts now hold the central lane — the central corridor is a kill zone. You MUST detour NORTH or SOUTH. Within about 50 turns.
WIN WHEN: get a unit into region (100,20) r=3 AND lose ≤1 of your own units AND before game tick 4500.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 4501 OR NOT (lose ≤1 of your own units) OR your whole force is destroyed OR you used a forbidden tool (instant fail)).
You have at most 55 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Same scout-no-fire ROE, but THREE gun turret posts hold the central lane along seeded anchors — the turret positions shift between runs. The only reliable bypass is the y≈8 or y≈32 corridor. Reach (100,20) inside radius 3 with all four jeeps alive, within about 50 turns.
WIN WHEN: get a unit into region (100,20) r=3 AND lose ≤0 of your own units AND before game tick 4500.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 4501 OR NOT (lose ≤0 of your own units) OR your whole force is destroyed OR you used a forbidden tool (instant fail)).
You have at most 55 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.
zh:
ROE：侦察纵队，仅限移动和停止——任何攻击命令都会立即使任务失败。开一辆吉普车到半径 3 内 (100,20) 处的观察点，且不丢失超过 4 个中的 2 个。四座炮塔覆盖中央车道（y=20）。绕道向北 (y≈8) 或向南 (y≈32) 经过它们，然后下车。大约 50 圈内。
胜利条件：将一个单位放入区域 (100,20) r=3 并且失去 ≤2 个自己的单位并且在游戏刻 4500 之前。
失败条件：（不是在游戏刻 4501 之前，否则（损失 ≤2 个自己的单位）或者你的整个部队被摧毁或者你使用了禁用的工具（立即失败））。
您最多有 55 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

同样的侦察兵不开火交战规则。到达半径 3 内的 (100,20)，最多损失四辆吉普车中的一辆。现在，两个炮塔柱占据了中央车道——中央走廊是杀伤区。您必须绕道向北或向南。大约50转之内。
胜利条件：将一个单位放入区域 (100,20) r=3 并且失去 ≤1 个自己的单位并且在游戏刻 4500 之前。
失败条件：（不是在游戏刻 4501 之前，否则（损失 ≤1 个自己的单位）或者你的整个部队被摧毁或者你使用了禁用的工具（立即失败））。
您最多有 55 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

同样的侦察兵不开火交战规则，但三个炮塔柱沿着播种锚固定着中央车道——炮塔位置在每次运行之间发生变化。唯一可靠的旁路是 y≈8 或 y≈32 走廊。在所有四辆吉普车都存活的情况下，在大约 50 个回合内到达半径 3 内的 (100,20)。
胜利条件：将一个单位放入区域 (100,20) r=3 并且失去 ≤0 个自己的单位并且在游戏开始 4500 之前。
失败条件：（不是在游戏刻 4501 之前，否则（损失 ≤0 个自己的单位）或者你的整个部队被摧毁或者你使用了禁用的工具（立即失败））。
您最多有 55 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

title: Builder-Only Role — Build Under Visible Threat, No Combat Calls

raw.realWorldMeaning: Role-scoped operator must execute the build task without escalating into combat even when the threat is visible. The bench enforces an RBAC allowlist: build / place_building / move_units / stop / observe are permitted; any combat call (attack_unit, attack_move) is a procedure violation and instant LOSS. The point of the cell is separation-of-duties discipline under temptation — a passive (or slowly-encroaching) enemy is visible and chips the base, but reaching for an attack tool fails the run before any damage matters.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Provisioning robot forbidden from any actuator-level attack action. A construction agent scoped to deploy / place must complete the layout even when sensors report a nearby adversary; engaging the adversary is outside the role's capability surface and counts as a policy violation.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: BFCL V4 relevance, RBAC role separation, separation-of-duties drills, Conway-team boundary discipline
raw.author: openra-bench

summary.en: Role-scoped operator must execute the build task without escalating into combat even when the threat is visible. The bench enforces an RBAC allowlist: build / place_building / move_units / stop / observe are permitted; any combat call (attack_unit, attack_move) is a procedure violation and instant LOSS. The point of the cell is separation-of-duties discipline under temptation — a passive (or slowly-encroaching) enemy is visible and chips the base, but reaching for an attack tool fails the run before any damage matters.
summary.zh: 即使威胁可见，角色范围内的操作员也必须执行构建任务，而不会升级为战斗。工作台强制执行 RBAC 允许列表：允许 build / place_building / move_units / stop /observe；任何战斗调用（attack_unit、attack_move）都是程序违规和即时损失。该牢房的要点是诱惑下的职责分离纪律——被动（或缓慢侵入）的敌人是可见的，并且会破坏基地，但在造成任何损害之前，伸手去拿攻击工具就会导致逃跑失败。

en:
You're a BUILDER role: build, place_building, move_units, observe, stop allowed; attack_unit and attack_move are FORBIDDEN — a single forbidden call fails the run. Pre-placed yard, barracks, power, refinery. Add at least two more buildings ending in a war factory for six total. Within about 60 turns.
WIN WHEN: own ≥6 buildings total AND own a 'weap' AND before game tick 5400.
YOU LOSE IF: (NOT (before game tick 5400) OR you used a forbidden tool (instant fail) OR NOT (own a 'fact')).
You have at most 60 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Same builder ROE; same starter base. A visible enemy rifle squad sits to the east — ignore it, your role is build-only. Add buildings to reach six total, ending in a war factory. Within about 60 turns. A single attack call fails the run.
WIN WHEN: own ≥6 buildings total AND own a 'weap' AND before game tick 5400.
YOU LOSE IF: (NOT (before game tick 5400) OR you used a forbidden tool (instant fail) OR NOT (own a 'fact')).
You have at most 60 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Same builder ROE; the hostile rifle squad now approaches and chips your structures, with a second wave inbound. Add buildings to reach SEVEN total, ending in a war factory. You may move your defenders but you may NOT order an attack. Within about 60 turns.
WIN WHEN: own ≥7 buildings total AND own a 'weap' AND before game tick 5400.
YOU LOSE IF: (NOT (before game tick 5400) OR you used a forbidden tool (instant fail) OR NOT (own a 'fact')).
You have at most 60 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.
zh:
您是建造者角色：建造、放置建筑、移动单位、观察、允许停止； Attack_unit 和 Attack_move 是 FORBIDDEN — 单个被禁止的调用会导致运行失败。预先放置的院子、营房、电力、炼油厂。添加至少两座以战争工厂结尾的建筑物，总共六座。大约60转之内。
胜利条件：总共拥有 ≥6 座建筑物并且拥有一个“武器”并且在游戏刻 5400 之前。
失败条件：（不（在游戏刻 5400 之前）或者您使用了禁用工具（立即失败）或者不（拥有“事实”））。
您最多有 60 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

同一建造商 ROE；相同的入门基础。东边有一支可见的敌方步枪班——忽略它，你的角色只是建造。添加建筑物使其总数达到六座，最后是一座战争工厂。大约60转之内。单个攻击调用会使运行失败。
胜利条件：总共拥有 ≥6 座建筑物并且拥有一个“武器”并且在游戏刻 5400 之前。
失败条件：（不（在游戏刻 5400 之前）或者您使用了禁用工具（立即失败）或者不（拥有“事实”））。
您最多有 60 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

同一建造商 ROE；敌方步枪小队现在接近并摧毁你的建筑，第二波攻击即将到来。添加建筑物使其总数达到七座，最后是一座战争工厂。你可以移动你的防守者，但你不能下令进攻。大约60转之内。
胜利条件：总共拥有 ≥7 座建筑物并且拥有“武器”并且在游戏刻 5400 之前。
失败条件：（不（在游戏刻 5400 之前）或者您使用了禁用工具（立即失败）或者不（拥有“事实”））。
您最多有 60 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

title: Defensive ROE — Hold the Base Using Stance and Positioning, Not Attack Orders

raw.realWorldMeaning: A defensive rules-of-engagement drill: the unit's brief is to hold a fixed asset (the base `construction yard`) against probing raiders, but the offensive tool (`attack_unit` / `attack_move`) is OFF-LIMITS. The only permitted commands are positional (`move_units`) and stance changes (`set_stance`) — the defenders auto-fire on intruders once their stance is lifted from HoldFire. A single forbidden attack order forfeits the mission. The skill is procedural: hold the role discipline (react only; do not pursue; do not initiate) even when the obvious local-solve is to call the attack tool.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: A security guard's standing orders. Fire only if engaged; do not pursue, do not initiate. The guard's role is positional plus stance-driven; the offensive command is off the allowlist even when an intruder is in view. The mission succeeds when the asset is intact and the intruders that walked into the defended footprint were neutralised by the stance-driven auto-fire — NOT by the guard issuing an attack order.

title: Strict Ordered Procedure — Place the Buildings in the Exact Mandated Sequence

raw.realWorldMeaning: Execute a procedure whose steps must run in a STRICT order: doing step 3 before step 2 invalidates the procedure, never recovers, and fails the run. The bench analogue of an aviation pre-flight checklist (skipping a step makes the next-step check meaningless) or a database migration where index-create-before-data-load is mandatory. The decision is literal ORDER compliance — not what or where, but WHEN relative to the other steps. A model that "eventually" placed every step in any order STILL fails: the procedure is graded on order, not on the final state.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: An assembly-line robot following a strict sequence (place rivet 1, then bracket, then rivet 2) where reversing a step destroys the earlier work — out-of-order assembly never recovers and fails inspection.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: PlanBench strict-ordering, IFBench step-order compliance, PERT/CPM precedence, aviation pre-flight checklist, database migration ordered DDL
raw.author: autonomous-loop

summary.en: Execute a procedure whose steps must run in a STRICT order: doing step 3 before step 2 invalidates the procedure, never recovers, and fails the run. The bench analogue of an aviation pre-flight checklist (skipping a step makes the next-step check meaningless) or a database migration where index-create-before-data-load is mandatory. The decision is literal ORDER compliance — not what or where, but WHEN relative to the other steps. A model that "eventually" placed every step in any order STILL fails: the procedure is graded on order, not on the final state.
summary.zh: 执行一个过程，其步骤必须按严格顺序运行：在步骤 2 之前执行步骤 3 会使该过程无效，永远不会恢复，并且运行失败。航空飞行前检查表的工作台模拟（跳过一个步骤会使下一步检查变得毫无意义）或强制执行数据加载前索引创建的数据库迁移。该决定是字面上的顺序合规性——不是什么或在哪里，而是相对于其他步骤的时间。 “最终”以任何顺序放置每个步骤的模型仍然会失败：该过程是根据顺序而不是最终状态进行评分的。

title: Strict Tool-Allowlist Fidelity — Transit the Jeeps Using Only Allowed Tools

raw.realWorldMeaning: Clean BFCL-style tool-allowlist fidelity. The agent is briefed with an explicit allowlist [move_units, build, place_building, observe, stop] and an explicit forbidden list [attack_unit, attack_move, set_stance, harvest, repair, sell, set_rally_point]. The mission is satisfiable with only `move_units` (transit four jeeps to an egress region while the pre-placed `construction yard` stays intact). One invocation of any forbidden tool fails the run immediately. No enemy combatants are placed along the corridor; the discipline must hold under quiet conditions, not under distractor pressure. The *-under-pressure sibling adds a patrol-as-temptation; this pack is the quiet baseline.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Service account scoped to a fixed actuator surface (drive + place + sense). The runbook explicitly forbids every other actuator — even when no incident is forcing the decision. The operator must complete the routine task using only the in-scope actuators; one out-of-scope call is a procedure violation.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: BFCL V4 relevance, IFBench instruction-following, SOC runbook strict
raw.author: openra-bench

title: Cluttered Tool Surface — Ignore the Distractor Tools and Just Move

raw.realWorldMeaning: The agent receives a CLUTTERED toolset (9 tools) where only TWO are on the critical path for the current task (move + observe). The other seven are MAXIMALLY SALIENT distractors: a visible weak enemy invites `attack_unit`; cash on hand and a pre-placed base invite `build` / `place_building`; `harvest` / `set_rally_ point` / `set_stance` / `attack_move` look generally useful but do nothing for THIS goal. The discipline is to recognise which subset of a large API is actually relevant and ignore the rest — every off-path tool call either interrupts the unit's move order, lures units into a costly engagement, or burns the model's turn budget while the within_ticks clock keeps ticking.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: A teleoperation panel with dozens of buttons (manipulator, nav, gripper, vision, comms, logging…) but only two are on the critical path for THIS mission. A disciplined operator runs the two-button procedure; a junior operator who reaches for every salient button wastes the window or causes collateral damage. The skill is API/relevance discrimination under no explicit "don't touch X" instruction.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: τ²-bench multi-distractor handling, BFCL V4 cluttered-API relevance, IFBench distraction resistance, junior-operator discipline test
raw.author: openra-bench

summary.en: The agent receives a CLUTTERED toolset (9 tools) where only TWO are on the critical path for the current task (move + observe). The other seven are MAXIMALLY SALIENT distractors: a visible weak enemy invites `attack_unit`; cash on hand and a pre-placed base invite `build` / `place_building`; `harvest` / `set_rally_ point` / `set_stance` / `attack_move` look generally useful but do nothing for THIS goal. The discipline is to recognise which subset of a large API is actually relevant and ignore the rest — every off-path tool call either interrupts the unit's move order, lures units into a costly engagement, or burns the model's turn budget while the within_ticks clock keeps ticking.
summary.zh: 代理收到一个混乱的工具集（9 个工具），其中只有两个位于当前任务的关键路径上（移动 + 观察）。其他七个是最显着的干扰因素：可见的弱敌人会邀请“attack_unit”；手头现金和预先放置的基地邀请“build”/“place_building”； `harvest` / `set_rally_ point` / `set_stance` / `attack_move` 看起来通常很有用，但对这个目标没有任何作用。规则是识别大型 API 的哪个子集实际上是相关的，并忽略其余部分 - 每个偏离路径的工具调用要么中断单位的移动顺序，引诱单位进行代价高昂的交战，要么在 inside_ticks 时钟持续滴答作响时消耗模型的回合预算。

en:
Get a jeep to (110,20) within radius 6 with zero of four lost. You have a nine-tool API — almost all of it irrelevant. Use only move_units and observe. A weak off-path rifleman to the north is a distraction; the base and cash are too. Within about 23 turns.
WIN WHEN: get a unit into region (110,20) r=6 AND lose ≤0 of your own units AND before game tick 2000.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 2001 OR NOT (lose ≤0 of your own units) OR your whole force is destroyed).
You have at most 25 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Get a jeep to (110,20) within radius 6 with zero of four lost, within about 17 turns. Your nine-tool API includes attack, build, harvest, set_stance, set_rally_point — none advance the mission. Use only move_units and observe. A three-rifleman off-path garrison and the west base are tempting but pure distractions.
WIN WHEN: get a unit into region (110,20) r=6 AND lose ≤0 of your own units AND before game tick 1500.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 1501 OR NOT (lose ≤0 of your own units) OR your whole force is destroyed).
You have at most 22 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Same observation-point task; jeeps spawn on the NORTH (y≈5) or SOUTH (y≈35) lane by seed. Two visible distractor groups (off-path NORTH garrison and central corridor sentries) tempt attack_unit / attack_move. Use move_units and observe only; route along your spawn lane, drop in at the end. Within about 17 turns.
WIN WHEN: get a unit into region (110,20) r=6 AND lose ≤0 of your own units AND before game tick 1500.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 1501 OR NOT (lose ≤0 of your own units) OR your whole force is destroyed).
You have at most 20 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.
zh:
开一辆吉普车到半径 6 内的 (110,20)，四次损失为零。您有一个包含九个工具的 API — 几乎所有这些工具都是无关紧要的。仅使用 move_units 并观察。北边一名实力较弱的偏离路径的步枪手会分散他的注意力。基础和现金也是如此。大约23圈之内。
胜利条件：将一个单位放入区域 (110,20) r=6 并且失去 ≤0 个自己的单位并且在游戏刻 2000 之前。
失败条件：（不是在游戏刻 2001 之前，否则（损失 ≤0 个你自己的单位）或者你的整个部队被摧毁）。
您最多有 25 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

在大约 17 个回合内，将一辆吉普车开到半径 6 内的 (110,20)，四次丢失为零。您的九个工具 API 包括攻击、构建、收获、set_stance、set_rally_point - 没有一个可以推进任务。仅使用 move_units 并观察。由三名步枪手组成的偏远驻军和西部基地虽然很诱人，但纯粹是干扰。
胜利条件：将一个单位放入区域 (110,20) r=6 并且失去 ≤0 个自己的单位并且在游戏刻 1500 之前。
失败条件：（不在游戏刻 1501 之前，否则（损失 ≤0 个自己的单位）或你的整个部队被摧毁）。
您最多有 22 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

胜利条件：将一个单位放入区域 (110,20) r=6 并且失去 ≤0 个自己的单位并且在游戏刻 1500 之前。
失败条件：（不在游戏刻 1501 之前，否则（损失 ≤0 个自己的单位）或你的整个部队被摧毁）。

title: Distractor Tool Discipline — Ignore the Tempting Irrelevant Build Palette

raw.realWorldMeaning: Tool-palette discipline under distraction. The operator has a large API surface — movement, attack, build, place_building, observe — but only ONE of those tools is needed to complete the mission. The remaining tools are visible, available, and tempting (the build palette in particular looks like "real work" and feels productive), but they are irrelevant to the win and spending turns on them runs out the deadline. Unlike a strict allowlist scenario (where forbidden tools trip a violation counter and the bench grades you on rule-following), this cell has NO forbidden tools — the test is whether the agent REASONS about which tools are RELEVANT to the task and ignores the others, the way a senior operator ignores the eighteen flags `kubectl apply` exposes and uses only the two they actually need.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Mobile robot with a rich actuator palette (manipulator, weld, cut, drill, inspect, navigate) is assigned a pure navigate-to-waypoint mission. The other actuators are available and many of them produce visible feedback if invoked, but invoking them wastes the energy / time budget. The disciplined policy ignores the irrelevant actuators and just navigates; the kitchen-sink policy exhausts itself running every actuator it can see.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: τ²-bench distractor handling (irrelevant tool in palette), IFBench irrelevant-tool ignoring (no-call-when-not-needed), BFCL V4 relevance / refusing to call an unnecessary tool, operator discipline: kitchen-sink API ergonomics (kubectl --all etc.)
raw.author: openra-bench

title: Commit Under Uncertainty — Pick the One Region That Hides the Survivor

raw.realWorldMeaning: Path planning to any point is solved. The unsolved problem is deciding which of several unexplored regions to commit a time/fuel-limited searcher to when only one hides the target and going to the wrong one first means you never reach the right one in time. That commitment-under-uncertainty step is the real search-and-rescue problem, not the navigation.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: UAV/UGV search-and-rescue frontier selection: with limited endurance and several candidate search cells, choose the cell most likely to contain the survivor before the battery dies.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: PlanBench, ARC spatial reasoning, search-and-rescue frontier selection
raw.author: berta

summary.en: Path planning to any point is solved. The unsolved problem is deciding which of several unexplored regions to commit a time/fuel-limited searcher to when only one hides the target and going to the wrong one first means you never reach the right one in time. That commitment-under-uncertainty step is the real search-and-rescue problem, not the navigation.
summary.zh: 到任意点的路径规划就解决了。未解决的问题是，当只有一个搜索器隐藏目标时，决定将时间/燃料有限的搜索器分配到几个未探索的区域中的哪一个，并且首先到达错误的区域意味着您永远无法及时到达正确的区域。不确定性下的承诺步骤才是真正的搜救问题，而不是导航问题。

en:
Fog-of-war search. One fast scout in the NW corner, several candidate frontiers across the map. Only ONE candidate hides a survivor — a building (not a unit cluster). The clock permits exactly one decisive trip; detouring or sweeping overruns it. Win = discover a building, within about 11 turns.
WIN WHEN: spot ≥1 enemy buildings AND before game tick 950.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 951 OR your whole force is destroyed).
You have at most 14 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Fog-of-war search. One fast scout in the NW corner. Three candidate frontiers, only one of which hides a survivor (a building, not a unit cluster). The clock is tighter — the deadline permits exactly one decisive trip. Win = discover a building, within about 10 turns.
WIN WHEN: spot ≥1 enemy buildings AND before game tick 880.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 881 OR your whole force is destroyed).
You have at most 14 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Fog-of-war search. One fast scout starting at a seed-chosen corner. Three candidate frontiers, only one of which hides a survivor (a building, not a unit cluster). One of the decoy frontiers contains a hostile cluster — careless routing kills the lone scout. ZERO losses allowed. Win = discover a building, within about 12 turns.
WIN WHEN: spot ≥1 enemy buildings AND before game tick 1050 AND lose ≤0 of your own units.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 1051 OR NOT (lose ≤0 of your own units) OR your whole force is destroyed).
You have at most 15 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.
zh:
战争迷雾搜索。西北角有一名快速侦察员，地图上有几个候选边界。只有一个候选者隐藏了幸存者——一座建筑物（而不是一个单元群）。时钟只允许一次决定性的旅行；绕道或扫过就会超出它。获胜 = 在大约 11 回合内发现一座建筑物。
胜利条件：发现 ≥​​1 个敌方建筑且游戏前勾选 950。
失败条件：（不在游戏刻 951 之前或你的整个部队被摧毁之前）。
您最多有 14 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

胜利条件：发现 ≥​​1 个敌方建筑并且在比赛前勾选 880。
失败条件：（不是在游戏刻 881 之前或你的整个部队被摧毁之前）。
您最多有 14 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

战争迷雾搜索。一名快速侦察员从种子选择的角落出发。三个候选边界，其中只有一个隐藏着幸存者（一栋建筑物，而不是一个单位集群）。其中一个诱饵边界包含一个敌对集群——粗心的路线会杀死孤独的侦察兵。允许零损失。获胜 = 在大约 12 回合内发现一座建筑物。
胜利条件：发现 ≥​​1 个敌方建筑并且在游戏前勾选 1050 并且损失 ≤0 个己方单位。
失败条件：（不在游戏刻 1051 之前，否则（失去 ≤0 个自己的单位）或你的整个部队被摧毁）。
您最多有 15 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

胜利条件：发现 ≥​​1 个敌方建筑并且在游戏前勾选 1050 并且损失 ≤0 个己方单位。
失败条件：（不在游戏刻 1051 之前，否则（失去 ≤0 个自己的单位）或你的整个部队被摧毁）。
您最多有 15 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

title: Safe vs Fast — Choose the Survivable Longer Route Over the Deadly Shortcut

raw.realWorldMeaning: Shortest-path is solved. The unsolved decision is whether the shortest path is the right path: a direct corridor may pass through a hazard that destroys the vehicle, while a longer perimeter route completes the mission intact. Choosing the survivable plan over the fastest one, given a deadline that the detour still satisfies, is the actual mission-planning problem.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Field-robot route selection under hazard: a delivery/inspection robot must reject the shortest path when it crosses a no-go hazard zone and instead commit to a longer but survivable route that still meets the time window.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: PlanBench, ARC spatial reasoning, hazard-aware route selection
raw.author: berta

summary.en: Shortest-path is solved. The unsolved decision is whether the shortest path is the right path: a direct corridor may pass through a hazard that destroys the vehicle, while a longer perimeter route completes the mission intact. Choosing the survivable plan over the fastest one, given a deadline that the detour still satisfies, is the actual mission-planning problem.
summary.zh: 最短路径已解决。尚未解决的决定是最短路径是否是正确的路径：直接的走廊可能会穿过摧毁车辆的危险，而较长的周边路线则可以完整地完成任务。考虑到绕道仍然满足的最后期限，选择可生存的计划而不是最快的计划，是实际的任务规划问题。

title: Blockade Bypass — Reach the Objective by the Survivable Detour

raw.realWorldMeaning: Route-risk assessment with a visibly hard direct path and a longer survivable alternative under a binding attrition cap. The cap punishes brute force; the clock punishes infinite detour. The decision is committing the force to the route that actually makes the deadline alive.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Field-robot mission routing rejecting a hazardous shortest path for a survivable longer one within a time window — but the longer path is not free, so the model must weigh attrition vs deadline rather than always preferring the safe option.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: MicroRTS route-risk / hazardous-corridor sub-tasks, PlanBench cost-vs-survival route planning, field-robotics: contested vs detour route under SLA, convoy routing with attrition budget
raw.author: yiyu-tian

summary.en: Route-risk assessment with a visibly hard direct path and a longer survivable alternative under a binding attrition cap. The cap punishes brute force; the clock punishes infinite detour. The decision is committing the force to the route that actually makes the deadline alive.
summary.zh: 路线风险评估，具有明显困难的直接路径和具有约束力的损耗上限下更长的生存替代方案。上限惩罚暴力；时钟惩罚无限的绕道。该决定是将力量投入到实际使最后期限有效的路线上。

en:
Reach the objective region near (110,20) within about 39 turns, losing no more than four units. A heavy enemy garrison sits in the centre of the map (around x=46..57) and out-trades you head- on. Find a way through that does not exceed the attrition cap.
WIN WHEN: get a unit into region (110,20) r=6 AND before game tick 3500 AND lose ≤4 of your own units.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 3501 OR your whole force is destroyed OR NOT (lose ≤4 of your own units)).
You have at most 40 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Same map, tighter cap (≤2 losses) and a 2800-tick deadline. The central garrison still out-trades you head-on; at this cap any direct engagement with it guarantees a fail. Commit decisively — dithering at the centre line burns ticks. Within about 32 turns.
WIN WHEN: get a unit into region (110,20) r=6 AND before game tick 2800 AND lose ≤2 of your own units.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 2801 OR your whole force is destroyed OR NOT (lose ≤2 of your own units)).
You have at most 32 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Reach (110,20) within radius 6 with at most one loss, before about turn 27. The central garrison is lighter (four rocket soldiers, one turret, five rifles) but the cap is brutal. Commit decisively to a route that fits the attrition cap.
WIN WHEN: get a unit into region (110,20) r=6 AND before game tick 2400 AND lose ≤1 of your own units.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 2401 OR your whole force is destroyed OR NOT (lose ≤1 of your own units)).
You have at most 28 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

失败条件：（不是在游戏刻 3501 之前，或者你的整个部队被摧毁或没有（损失 ≤4 个你自己的单位））。

title: Recover From Cash Depletion — Rebuild Refinery After Mid-Episode Strike

raw.realWorldMeaning: Financial recovery after a sudden cash drain caused by an emergency outflow that destroys the operation's income channel. The agent inherits a normal operating economy with just enough reserve cash for ONE refinery rebuild; an exogenous strike is INJECTED mid-episode and destroys the refinery; income halts. The destruction is not pre-announced — the agent discovers it from the live observation channel. The agent must notice the loss, commit the indivisible reserve to rebuilding the refinery, and redirect the harvester back to the patch — fast enough that the revenue bar is still cleared before the deadline. Stalling, ignoring the destruction, or spending the reserve on army units all miss the bar.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Post-disaster operations restart after the critical processing node is destroyed by an external event mid-mission. The autonomous operator has one collector still alive, no working capital beyond a single processing-node rebuild allowance, and a deadline. Recovery requires identifying the lost asset, committing the reserve to rebuilding it (not to defenders or expansion), and re-tasking the collector back to the source once the new node is operational.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: financial cash-crisis recovery, SC2 cash-drain rebuild, DR after critical-infra loss, bankruptcy turnaround under deadline
raw.author: openra-bench-wave-6

summary.en: Financial recovery after a sudden cash drain caused by an emergency outflow that destroys the operation's income channel. The agent inherits a normal operating economy with just enough reserve cash for ONE refinery rebuild; an exogenous strike is INJECTED mid-episode and destroys the refinery; income halts. The destruction is not pre-announced — the agent discovers it from the live observation channel. The agent must notice the loss, commit the indivisible reserve to rebuilding the refinery, and redirect the harvester back to the patch — fast enough that the revenue bar is still cleared before the deadline. Stalling, ignoring the destruction, or spending the reserve on army units all miss the bar.
summary.zh: 因紧急资金外流破坏了运营收入渠道而导致现金突然流失后的财务复苏。代理人继承了正常的运营经济，储备现金仅够 ONE 炼油厂重建；外源攻击在情节中期注入并摧毁了炼油厂；收入停止。破坏不是预先宣布的——特工是通过实时观察频道发现的。代理人必须注意到损失，投入不可分割的储备来重建炼油厂，并将收割机重新引导回补丁 - 速度足够快，以便在截止日期之前仍然清除收入栏。拖延、忽视破坏、或者将储备金花在军队上，这些都不会成功。

en:
You start with a yard, power, refinery, one harvester, two near patches, two heavy-tank defenders, and $1400. A lone enemy heavy tank is staged beside the refinery — your defenders intercept and the refinery survives. The starting harvester begins delivering on its own (vendor auto-routing), but the single-refinery ceiling is below the bar. Commit the $1400 reserve to building a SECOND refinery: queue 'proc' and place it apart from the first (a new harvester auto-spawns at the new refinery and harvests in parallel). Economy value 15000, refinery and yard alive, within about 70 turns.
WIN WHEN: reach economy value ≥15000 (cash+ore) AND own ≥1 'proc' building(s) AND own ≥1 'fact' building(s) AND before game tick 6300.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 6301 OR NOT (own ≥1 'fact' building(s))).
You have at most 70 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Same base and $1400 reserve. An exogenous raid hits the refinery mid-episode and the three defenders cannot stop it in time — the refinery falls and the harvest loop dies. title: Deadline Shortened Midway — Crash the Schedule When the Budget Shrinks

raw.realWorldMeaning: A plan was paced against one deadline; mid-execution the deadline is pulled FORWARD. A team still working to the original date misses entirely — the only recovery is to compress the schedule: drop every slack activity, commit all resources at once, and accelerate. The intended policy does not pace leisurely against a generous nominal budget; it executes fast from the start (or instantly re-paces the moment the budget shrinks), so a mid-episode deadline cut still finds the objective achievable. A leisurely pace that would have met the original deadline now loses.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Real-time task re-planning under a tightened time budget: a delivery robot routed for a 30-minute window is told mid-route the package is now needed in 12 — it must drop optional sub-goals and take the fastest path immediately, not finish the leisurely plan. Likewise a manufacturing line told a shipment moved up must crash its schedule (parallelise, cut slack) rather than run the original cadence.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: project-management schedule compression (crashing the schedule), crashing the schedule / fast-tracking under a pulled-in deadline, deadline pressure — real-time re-planning when the time budget shrinks
raw.author: openra-bench

summary.en: A plan was paced against one deadline; mid-execution the deadline is pulled FORWARD. A team still working to the original date misses entirely — the only recovery is to compress the schedule: drop every slack activity, commit all resources at once, and accelerate. The intended policy does not pace leisurely against a generous nominal budget; it executes fast from the start (or instantly re-paces the moment the budget shrinks), so a mid-episode deadline cut still finds the objective achievable. A leisurely pace that would have met the original deadline now loses.
summary.zh: 一项计划是在最后期限内制定的；执行中期，截止日期被提前。仍在按原定日期工作的团队完全错过了——唯一的补救措施是压缩时间表：放弃所有松弛活动，立即提交所有资源，然后加速。预期的政策不会针对慷慨的名义预算而悠闲地进行；它从一开始就执行得很快（或者在预算缩减的时候立即重新调整节奏），所以中间的最后期限缩短仍然可以实现目标。本来可以按时完成任务的悠闲节奏现在消失了。

en:
Four medium tanks at the WEST base, enemy yard far EAST. DEADLINE WARNING: at tick 1000 the time budget gets CUT to tick 2000. Commit all four tanks east at full speed from turn 1 and switch to attack the enemy yard the moment it appears. Stalling or a leisurely opening loses the compressed budget.
WIN WHEN: destroy the enemy fact AND before game tick 2000.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 2001 OR NOT (own ≥1 'fact' building(s))).
You have at most 60 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Same task: four tanks west, enemy yard east, tick-1000 cut drops the deadline to tick 2000. The compressed budget leaves no slack — commit all four tanks east on turn one and switch to attack the moment the building surfaces.
WIN WHEN: destroy the enemy fact AND before game tick 2000.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 2001 OR NOT (own ≥1 'fact' building(s))).
You have at most 60 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Same crash-the-schedule setup, but the western base's latitude varies by seed. Tick-1000 cut drops the deadline to tick 2050. Commit all tanks east on turn one from whichever band you spawn in; switch to attack on contact. Memorised openings lose.
WIN WHEN: destroy the enemy fact AND before game tick 2050.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 2051 OR NOT (own ≥1 'fact' building(s))).
You have at most 60 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

您最多有 60 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

title: Compound Incident — Multi-Front Simultaneous Pressure (Defence + Economy + Tech)

raw.realWorldMeaning: Ops triage during a compound incident — three independent failures must be handled simultaneously, none of which can be sequenced or paused. Your base is under a hunt charge (defence), the harvesters feeding income are being raided (economy), and a tech objective (war factory) must be completed before a hard deadline. Focusing on any single pressure forfeits the others; the intended play keeps all three loops running in parallel, funding the tech with the harvest income that the defenders are simultaneously protecting.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Disaster-recovery multi-system failure — a control room handles a security event (perimeter under attack), a throughput event (data pipeline workers under harassment), and a planned upgrade (capability rollout) at the same time. Pausing the upgrade to fight the security incident misses the rollout SLA; abandoning the pipeline to harden the perimeter starves the upgrade of resources. The capability under test is parallel-task triage under genuine simultaneous pressure.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: SC2 multi-front simultaneous pressure, ops triage during compound incident, DR multi-system failure, military theater-wide simultaneous threats
raw.author: openra-bench

summary.en: Ops triage during a compound incident — three independent failures must be handled simultaneously, none of which can be sequenced or paused. Your base is under a hunt charge (defence), the harvesters feeding income are being raided (economy), and a tech objective (war factory) must be completed before a hard deadline. Focusing on any single pressure forfeits the others; the intended play keeps all three loops running in parallel, funding the tech with the harvest income that the defenders are simultaneously protecting.
summary.zh: 复合事件期间的操作分类——必须同时处理三个独立的故障，其中任何一个故障都不能排序或暂停。你的基地受到狩猎费用（防御），收割机的饲养收入正在遭到袭击（经济），并且必须在严格的截止日期之前完成技术目标（战争工厂）。专注于任何单一压力就会丧失其他压力；预期的玩法使所有三个循环并行运行，用防御者同时保护的收获收入为技术提供资金。

en:
Compound incident: base with yard, refinery, power, two harvesters on a near patch, four tank defenders, $2000. THREE pressures hit at once — a 3-rifle hunt squad charging the base, four enemy raider tanks targeting your harvesters from the patch lane, AND a tech bar (war factory required by tick 5400). Command the defenders actively, build the war factory, keep at least one harvester alive. Yard standing, economy value 1000, within about 60 turns.
WIN WHEN: own a 'weap' AND own a 'proc' AND have ≥1 'harv' AND own a 'fact' AND reach economy value ≥1000 (cash+ore) AND before game tick 5400.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 5401 OR NOT (own a 'fact') OR NOT (have ≥1 'harv')).
You have at most 61 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Same compound incident scaled up: four-rifle hunt squad on the north flank and FIVE raider tanks across both harvester latitudes. Same $2000 budget, same tech bar (war factory by tick 5400). Active defence on both axes plus the tech build is the only winning play. Yard standing, one harvester alive, economy value 1000, within about 60 turns.
WIN WHEN: own a 'weap' AND own a 'proc' AND have ≥1 'harv' AND own a 'fact' AND reach economy value ≥1000 (cash+ore) AND before game tick 5400.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 5401 OR NOT (own a 'fact') OR NOT (have ≥1 'harv')).
You have at most 61 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Compound incident: base with yard, refinery, power, two harvesters on a near patch, four tank defenders, $2000. Three pressures hit at once — a 3-rifle hunt squad charging the base, four enemy raider tanks targeting your harvesters from the patch lane, AND a tech bar (war factory required by tick 4500). Your base stages from a seed-chosen latitude (NORTH y=14 or SOUTH y=26) on a tighter clock than the easier tier. Command the defenders actively, build the war factory, keep at least one harvester alive. Yard standing, economy value 1000, within about 50 turns.
WIN WHEN: own a 'weap' AND own a 'proc' AND have ≥1 'harv' AND own a 'fact' AND reach economy value ≥1000 (cash+ore) AND before game tick 4500.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 4501 OR NOT (own a 'fact') OR NOT (have ≥1 'harv')).
You have at most 51 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

title: Objective Change Midway — Pivot When the Goal Shifts

raw.realWorldMeaning: The mission objective changes mid-episode. Phase 1 is an early goal — stage the force at a forward region; once that is achieved a DIFFERENT phase-2 goal is revealed — raze the enemy construction yard at a far region. The agent must pursue the early goal first and only then pivot to the new one. A policy that commits to the phase-2 goal from the start fails phase 1 (the ordered chain never latches its first clause); a policy that only completes phase 1 and stops fails phase 2. The win is the ordered `then` chain over both goals AND a deadline — only a genuine goal-conditional pivot satisfies it.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Goal-conditional task execution with a mid-task re-spec: a mobile robot is dispatched to reach a staging waypoint; on arrival the operator updates the task — now also clear a target at a second, further site. The robot must complete the original navigation goal first and then re-condition its policy on the new goal, finishing the revised task inside the same energy budget rather than either ignoring the update or abandoning the first leg.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: goal-conditional RL, ALFWorld goal change, changing requirements
raw.author: openra-bench

summary.zh: 任务目标在情节中期发生变化。第一阶段是一个早期目标——将部队部署在前沿地区；一旦实现了这一点，就会出现一个不同的第二阶段目标——将远处的敌人建筑场夷为平地。智能体必须首先追求早期目标，然后才转向新目标。从一开始就致力于第二阶段目标的策略会在第一阶段失败（有序链永远不会锁存其第一个子句）；只完成第一阶段并停止第二阶段失败的策略。胜利是两个目标和最后期限的有序“then”链——只有真正的目标条件枢轴才能满足它。

en:
Five medium tanks at the western edge. PHASE 1: move three tanks into the forward staging region around (55,8) in the north. Once latched, PHASE 2: drive south-east and raze the enemy yard at (100,30) (two-rifle guard). Both phases IN ORDER. Beelining straight to the yard never registers phase 1; stopping at the staging area never satisfies phase 2. Within about 60 turns.
WIN WHEN: in this exact order: get ≥3 units into region (55,8) r=6 → THEN → destroy the enemy fact at the base near (100,30) AND before game tick 5400.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 5401 OR NOT (own ≥1 'fact' building(s))).
You have at most 65 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Same five tanks at the west; PHASE 1 staging region shifts to (55,12) and the yard target moves to (105,34). The two regions are NOT on the same line — a straight drive to the yard never enters the staging disc. Stage three tanks at (55,12), then pivot south-east to the yard. Within about 60 turns.
WIN WHEN: in this exact order: get ≥3 units into region (55,12) r=6 → THEN → destroy the enemy fact at the base near (105,34) AND before game tick 5400.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 5401 OR NOT (own ≥1 'fact' building(s))).
You have at most 65 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Five tanks stage in the NORTH or SOUTH band by seed. PHASE 1: three tanks in the central staging disc at (55,20). PHASE 2: drive on east and raze the enemy yard at (100,30) (two-rifle guard). Phases enforced in order; the route to staging must be planned, not memorised. Within about 60 turns.
WIN WHEN: in this exact order: get ≥3 units into region (55,20) r=6 → THEN → destroy the enemy fact at the base near (100,30) AND before game tick 5400.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 5401 OR NOT (own ≥1 'fact' building(s))).
You have at most 65 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.
zh:
西边有五辆中型坦克。第一阶段：将三辆坦克移至北部（55,8）附近的前方集结区域。一旦锁定，第二阶段：向东南方向行驶，将（100,30）处的敌人院子夷为平地（两枪守卫）。两个阶段都按顺序进行。径直走向院子永远不会记录第一阶段；在停靠区域停止永远不会满足第 2 阶段。大约 60 圈内。
胜利条件：按照这个确切的顺序：让 ≥3 个单位进入区域 (55,8) r=6 → 然后 → 在 (100,30) 附近的基地和游戏刻 5400 之前摧毁敌人。
失败条件：（不在游戏前勾选 5401 或不（拥有 ≥1 个“事实”建筑物））。
您最多有 65 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

西边同样有五辆坦克；第 1 阶段暂存区域移至 (55,12)，码目标移至 (105,34)。这两个区域并不在同一条线上——直接开到院子里永远不会进入暂存盘。在 (55,12) 放置三辆坦克，然后转向东南方到达院子。大约60转之内。
胜利条件：按照这个确切的顺序：让 ≥3 个单位进入区域 (55,12) r=6 → 然后 → 摧毁 (105,34) 附近基地的敌人并在游戏刻 5400 之前。
失败条件：（不在游戏前勾选 5401 或不（拥有 ≥1 个“事实”建筑物））。
您最多有 65 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

五辆坦克以种子形式进入北区或南区。第 1 阶段：位于 (55,20) 的中央暂存盘中的三个储罐。第 2 阶段：向东行驶，将 (100,30) 处的敌人庭院夷为平地（两枪守卫）。按顺序执行的阶段；必须规划登台路线，而不是记住。大约60转之内。
胜利条件：按照这个确切的顺序：让 ≥3 个单位进入区域 (55,20) r=6 → 然后 → 摧毁 (100,30) 附近基地的敌人，并且在游戏刻 5400 之前。
失败条件：（不在游戏前勾选 5401 或不（拥有 ≥1 个“事实”建筑物））。
您最多有 65 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。
