title: Objective Shift with OR-Clause — Pivot to the Feasible Path

raw.realWorldMeaning: Two acceptable objectives are on the table; mid-episode it becomes clear the originally-natural one is infeasible inside the budget; the agent must abandon that path and re-target the second (still-acceptable) objective without exhausting its means. The win is the `any_of` over the two paths AND a hard attrition cap AND a deadline — a brute-force commit to the heavy path overruns the cap; stalling overruns the deadline; only the recognise-and-pivot policy converges inside both teeth.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Mid-mission objective change: a robotic survey platform sent to sample Site A finds Site A inaccessible (unexpected obstacle / hazard exceeds the platform's risk envelope); the science plan accepted EITHER Site A or Site B as the day's sample, so the platform must re-plan to Site B inside the same energy / daylight budget instead of returning empty-handed.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: PlanBench replanning / goal-conditional adaptation, SC2 reactive macro pivot, product pivot under market signal, military objective change during ops
raw.author: openra-bench

summary.en: Two acceptable objectives are on the table; mid-episode it becomes clear the originally-natural one is infeasible inside the budget; the agent must abandon that path and re-target the second (still-acceptable) objective without exhausting its means. The win is the `any_of` over the two paths AND a hard attrition cap AND a deadline — a brute-force commit to the heavy path overruns the cap; stalling overruns the deadline; only the recognise-and-pivot policy converges inside both teeth.
summary.zh: 有两个可接受的目标摆在桌面上：到了中间，很明显原来自然的方案在预算范围内是不可行的；代理必须放弃该路径并重新瞄准第二个（仍然可以接受的）目标，而不用尽其手段。胜利是两条路径上的“any_of”、严格的损耗上限和最后期限——对重路径的强力承诺超出了上限；拖延超过最后期限；只有识别和旋转策略会聚在两颗牙齿内。

title: Graceful Degradation — Press On After a Non-Critical Base Loss

raw.realWorldMeaning: Triage an exogenous partial loss. Mid-mission, a scripted strike razes a NON-CRITICAL slice of the agent's base — an outer pillbox and one of two harvesters — while the war-critical core (construction yard, refinery, power, war factory, service depot) is untouched. The intended policy performs battle-damage assessment: it recognises the lost assets are NOT on the win path and PRESSES ON with the core objective — field the heavy-armour establishment UP to the required strength and clear the eastern garrison defending the enemy construction yard — rather than diverting its decision turns to panic-rebuilding the non-essentials. Rebuilding the razed pillbox + harvester burns the turns the agent needed to commission the war-critical tanks; the establishment and kill bars then go unmet.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Graceful degradation under partial subsystem loss. A field robot loses a non-mission-essential sensor or a spare battery pack mid-task; a brittle controller halts the primary task to restore the lost component, blowing the mission deadline, while a robust one assesses that the loss does not block the objective and continues. The discrimination is incident triage — distinguishing a critical failure (which DOES require a stop-and-fix) from a cosmetic / redundant one (which must be ignored so the main effort stays on schedule).
raw.benchmarkAnchor: graceful degradation, incident triage, critical-vs-noncritical assessment, PlanBench replanning under exogenous loss, military battle-damage assessment
raw.author: openra-bench

summary.zh: 对外源部分损失进行分类。任务进行到一半时，一场有计划的袭击将特工基地的非关键部分夷为平地——一个外部碉堡和两台收割机中的一台——而战争关键核心（建筑场、炼油厂、电力、军工厂、服务站）则未受影响。预期的政策执行战斗损失评估：它认识到损失的资产不在胜利道路上，并继续执行核心目标——将重装甲部队部署到所需的兵力并清除保卫敌方建筑场的东部驻军——而不是将其决策转向恐慌性地重建非必需品。重建被夷为平地的碉堡+收割机会消耗特工委托战争关键坦克所需的时间；然后建立和杀戮酒吧就得不到满足。

en:
Four medium tanks staged at (22, 18..24) in front of a full core base (yard, refinery, power, war factory, depot). A south outpost holds an outer pillbox and one of two harvesters. Around tick 1200 a strike RAZES the south outpost — pillbox and harvester gone, core untouched. Don't rebuild the lost outpost. Build ONE more medium tank, then attack-move east to clear five rifles guarding the enemy yard. Five tanks alive, five kills, yard standing, within about 60 turns.
WIN WHEN: have ≥5 '2tnk' AND destroy ≥5 enemy units AND own ≥1 'fact' building(s) AND before game tick 5400.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 5401 OR your whole force is destroyed OR NOT (own ≥1 'fact' building(s))).
You have at most 60 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Same press-on setup, but TWO outer pillboxes plus one harvester are razed at the south outpost around tick 1200 (core base untouched). Three enemy light tanks now picket the lane mouth and the eastern garrison grows to six rifles. Build one more medium tank, attack east. Five tanks alive, five kills, yard standing, within about 60 turns.
WIN WHEN: have ≥5 '2tnk' AND destroy ≥5 enemy units AND own ≥1 'fact' building(s) AND before game tick 5400.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 5401 OR your whole force is destroyed OR NOT (own ≥1 'fact' building(s))).
You have at most 60 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Same partial-loss task on a seed-chosen NORTH (y=12) or SOUTH (y=32) flank scout. South outpost razed around tick 1200; core survives. $3000 reserve covers TWO more medium tanks (column starts at four, needs six). Build both, attack east, six tanks alive, five kills, yard standing, within about 60 turns.
WIN WHEN: have ≥6 '2tnk' AND destroy ≥5 enemy units AND own ≥1 'fact' building(s) AND before game tick 5400.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 5401 OR your whole force is destroyed OR NOT (own ≥1 'fact' building(s))).
You have at most 60 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.
zh:
四辆中型坦克停放在（22, 18..24）一个完整的核心基地（堆场、炼油厂、电力、军工厂、仓库）前。南部前哨站设有一个外碉堡和两台收割机中的一台。大约在 1200 点左右，一次袭击将南部前哨夷为平地——碉堡和收割机消失了，核心却未受影响。不要重建失去的前哨站。再建造一辆中型坦克，然后攻击并向东移动以清除守卫敌人院子的五支步枪。大约 60 回合内，五辆坦克活着，五次击杀，站在院子里。
胜利条件：拥有 ≥5 个“2tnk”并摧毁 ≥5 个敌方单位并拥有 ≥1 个“事实”建筑物且在游戏刻 5400 之前。
失败条件：（不是在游戏刻 5401 之前或者你的整个部队被摧毁或者没有（拥有 ≥1 个“事实”建筑物））。
您最多有 60 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

胜利条件：拥有 ≥5 个“2tnk”并摧毁 ≥5 个敌方单位并拥有 ≥1 个“事实”建筑物且在游戏刻 5400 之前。

title: Surprise Second Wave — Reserve Forces for the Follow-On

raw.realWorldMeaning: Adversarial robustness on the temporal axis: the obvious threat (a 4-unit cluster near the agent's starting vision) is just the OPENING; an UNDISCLOSED follow-on wave is injected mid-episode from an unexpected bearing in a hunt pattern. The agent must DISCOVER the second wave from the live observation channel rather than from a pre-announced rule. Winning requires destroying both threats AND keeping the base AND keeping enough force alive. The relevant capability is RESERVING capacity for the follow-on — not committing every defender to the visible battle and chasing routers far from the base. "Battle finished, push deep" is the canonical military / SRE failure mode this trains against.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Incident-after-incident triage: a fresh page arrives from a different subsystem the moment the operator resolves the visible incident; the operator was NOT pre-warned about the second incident and must detect it from the live telemetry. The operator must keep enough on-call capacity in reserve to handle the follow-on instead of fully committing every responder to the first symptom. Adversarial robustness: treating the first observable threat as ground truth and over-fitting the response to it leaves the system exposed when the adversary stages a second engagement from a different angle.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: adversarial robustness: surprise wave handling, military follow-on wave doctrine, ops: incident-after-incident triage, SC2 second-attack timing
raw.author: openra-bench

title: Force-Regen After Attrition — Rebuild Combat Force Mid-Episode

raw.realWorldMeaning: Reactive replan to bring a force up to establishment. An ongoing offensive operation begins UNDER-STRENGTH — the standing column is below the force structure the mission requires; the agent has reserve cash to commission the missing units from the war factory; the offensive deadline is real. The model must notice the gap (units_summary shows fewer combat tanks than the required establishment), commit the reserve to building the combat type (not to a different unit or to nothing), AND continue the original mission (clear the eastern garrison defending the enemy construction yard) fast enough that the deadline still bites.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Military force-regen / SC2 rebuild-after-trade. A theater operation is fielded below establishment and must build up to strength from the rear-area production base mid-mission; the supervisor has a discrete replacement budget; the operational objective and timeline are fixed. The discrimination is whether the model recognises the gap in the advertised force structure AND issues the production order in time to keep the offensive on schedule; ignoring the gap (assaulting with the reduced force) under-strengths the assault and busts the establishment bar; spending the budget on the wrong unit type breaks the offensive composition; doing nothing busts the deadline.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: PlanBench replanning under exogenous loss, ScienceWorld error recovery, military force-regen / unit replacement, SC2 rebuild-after-trade
raw.author: openra-bench

summary.zh: 积极重新计划以建立一支部队。正在进行的进攻行动开始时兵力不足——常备纵队低于任务所需的兵力结构；特工有储备现金来委托军工厂中缺失的单位；进攻截止日期是真实的。该模型必须注意到差距（units_summary 显示的作战坦克数量少于所需编制），将预备队用于建造战斗类型（不是建造不同的单位或什么都不建造），并以足够快的速度继续执行原始任务（清除东部驻军，保卫敌人的建造场），以便在截止日期前完成。

title: Search & Destroy - Sweep a Scattered Enemy Off the Arena

raw.realWorldMeaning: A wide arena hides a chain of separate enemy squads, scattered in a zigzag across the whole map and in fog. The task is to SWEEP the arena - spread a small armoured team across the off-axis groups, reveal and destroy enough of them before the clock runs out, without losing the team. The skill is coordinated coverage of unknown space (spread out, scout, converge), not single-unit micro or a one-spot auto-brawl. This is the find-the-enemy counterpart to the close-range 1v1 duel.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Multi-robot search-and-destroy: sweep and clear a bounded area with several dispersed targets within a time budget, keeping the team intact.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: SC2 unit micro, MicroRTS, multi-robot search-and-destroy

summary.zh: 广阔的竞技场隐藏着一连串独立的敌方小队，它们以之字形分散在整个地图和雾中。任务是横扫竞技场——将一支小型装甲部队分散到轴外部队中，在时间耗尽之前揭露并摧毁足够多的装甲部队，同时不失去队伍。该技能是对未知空间的协调覆盖（分散、侦察、汇聚），而不是单个单元的微观或单点自动斗殴。这是与近距离 1v1 决斗相对应的寻找敌人。

en:
Commander, this is a reconnaissance-and-destroy sweep. You are given four armies, one at each corner of the 128×40 arena — 24 medium tanks and 8 jeeps in total (six units per corner). The enemy is 22 rifle infantry scattered across the arena in small groups, all hidden by fog of war on the north, mid, and south rows. Spread the armies, reveal the fog as you move, find and destroy the enemy. Score at least seven kills, reveal at least 18% of the map, lose no more than five of your own, within about 41 turns. Sitting still or marching down a single row fails both bars.
WIN WHEN: destroy ≥7 enemy units AND reveal ≥18% of the map AND before game tick 3603 AND lose ≤5 of your own units.
YOU LOSE IF: (your whole force is destroyed OR NOT (lose ≤5 of your own units) OR not before game tick 3603).
You have at most 41 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Commander, this is a wider reconnaissance-and-destroy sweep. You are given four corner armies — 24 medium tanks and 8 jeeps in total. The enemy is 22 rifle infantry scattered across the 128×40 arena in small groups, all hidden by fog of war on the north, mid, and south rows. Spread the armies, reveal the fog, and find and destroy the enemy. Score at least nine kills, reveal at least 28% of the map, lose no more than four of your own, within about 41 turns. A single-row pass tops out at eight kills — clearing both the north and south bands is required.
WIN WHEN: destroy ≥9 enemy units AND reveal ≥28% of the map AND before game tick 3603 AND lose ≤4 of your own units.
YOU LOSE IF: (your whole force is destroyed OR NOT (lose ≤4 of your own units) OR not before game tick 3603).
You have at most 41 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Commander, this is a reconnaissance-and-destroy sweep across the whole 128×40 arena. Your team round-robins between four spawn corners by seed (compass-only briefing): you may stage at any of NW, NE, SW, or SE — read your own starting corner from the map. You are given 24 medium tanks and 8 jeeps in total (six units per corner). The enemy is 22 rifle infantry scattered across the arena in small groups, all hidden by fog of war on the north, mid, and south rows; localise them on the minimap yourself. Score at least ten kills, reveal at least 32% of the map, lose no more than four of your own, within about 41 turns. Only a real spread across all three rows clears the bar.
WIN WHEN: destroy ≥10 enemy units AND reveal ≥32% of the map AND before game tick 3603 AND lose ≤4 of your own units.
YOU LOSE IF: (your whole force is destroyed OR NOT (lose ≤4 of your own units) OR not before game tick 3603).
You have at most 41 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.
zh:
指挥官，这是一次侦察歼灭行动。你有四支军队，在 128×40 竞技场的每个角落都有一支——总共 24 辆中型坦克和 8 辆吉普车（每个角落有 6 辆）。敌人是22名步枪步兵，分散在竞技场中，分成小队，全部隐藏在北、中、南三排的战争迷雾中。分散军队，移动时揭开迷雾，找到并消灭敌人。在大约 41 个回合内，完成至少 7 次击杀，暴露至少 18% 的地图，损失不超过 5 名己方敌人。静静地坐着或沿着单行行进，这两个栏都失败了。
胜利条件：摧毁 ≥7 个敌方单位并显露 ≥18% 的地图，并在游戏刻 3603 之前并损失 ≤5 个己方单位。
失败条件：（你的整个部队被摧毁或没有（损失≤5个你自己的单位）或在游戏刻3603之前没有被摧毁）。
你最多有 41 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

指挥官，这是一次更广泛的侦察和摧毁扫荡。你有四个角军——总共 24 辆中型坦克和 8 辆吉普车。敌人是 22 名步枪步兵，分散在 128×40 的竞技场中，分成小股，全部隐藏在北、中、南三排的战争迷雾中。分散军队，揭开迷雾，找到并消灭敌人。在大约 41 回合内，完成至少 9 次击杀，暴露至少 28% 的地图，损失不超过 4 名己方敌人。单排通行证最多可击杀 8 只——需要清除北带和南带。
胜利条件：摧毁 ≥9 个敌方单位并显露 ≥28% 的地图，并在游戏刻 3603 之前并损失 ≤4 个己方单位。
失败条件：（你的整个部队被摧毁或没有（损失≤4个你自己的单位）或在游戏刻3603之前没有被摧毁）。
你最多有 41 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

指挥官，这是对整个 128×40 竞技场的侦察摧毁式扫荡。你的团队按种子在四个重生角之间进行循环赛（仅限指南针简报）：你可以在西北、东北、西南或东南的任何一个位置进行比赛——从地图上读取你自己的起始角。您总共拥有 24 辆中型坦克和 8 辆吉普车（每个角落 6 辆）。敌人是22名步枪步兵，分散在竞技场中，分成小队，全部隐藏在北、中、南三排的战争迷雾中；自己在小地图上定位它们。在大约 41 回合内，完成至少 10 次击杀，暴露至少 32% 的地图，损失不超过 4 名己方敌人。只有真正分布在所有三行上才能清除障碍。
胜利条件：摧毁 ≥10 个敌方单位并显露 ≥32% 的地图，并在游戏刻 3603 之前并损失 ≤4 个己方单位。
失败条件：（你的整个部队被摧毁或没有（损失≤4个你自己的单位）或在游戏刻3603之前没有被摧毁）。
你最多有 41 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

title: Scout and Report — Reveal the Far Target, Then Extract the Team

raw.realWorldMeaning: Military intelligence reconnaissance with mandatory full-team recovery. The scout team must surface a specific FAR enemy installation AND bring the entire team back INTACT for the intelligence to be delivered. Real intel-and-extract doctrine treats neither bare discovery NOR a partial-team return as a success — the channel is the report (requires return) AND the asset is the team (requires zero losses). The pack tests whether the agent treats "saw the target" or "one jeep made it home" as success rather than the binding "discovered AND full team extracted" criterion.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Multi-drone reconnaissance overflight with return-to-base + zero-attrition acceptance: the mission counts as a success only if the platforms reveal the named target AND ALL platforms recover. A one-way commit that surfaces the target but loses any drone is a partial failure, not a win — the report channel requires both the data AND the platforms back at base for the next mission.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: military intelligence reconnaissance (recon-and-extract), SC2 scout-and-return for info, drone surveillance with return-to-base, intel ops: gather then withdraw
raw.author: openra-bench

summary.en: Military intelligence reconnaissance with mandatory full-team recovery. The scout team must surface a specific FAR enemy installation AND bring the entire team back INTACT for the intelligence to be delivered. Real intel-and-extract doctrine treats neither bare discovery NOR a partial-team return as a success — the channel is the report (requires return) AND the asset is the team (requires zero losses). The pack tests whether the agent treats "saw the target" or "one jeep made it home" as success rather than the binding "discovered AND full team extracted" criterion.
summary.zh: 军事情报侦察，强制全队恢复。侦察小队必须发现远方的特定敌方设施，并将整个小队完好无损地带回来，以便传递情报。真正的情报提取原则既不将纯粹的发现也不将部分团队的回报视为成功——渠道就是报告（要求回报），而资产就是团队（要求零损失）。该包测试特工是否将“看到目标”或“一辆吉普车回家”视为成功，而不是具有约束力的“发现并提取整个团队”标准。

en:
Commander, two jeep scouts at your west base. A specific far enemy yard is the discovery target — surface it with vision. Two enemy rifles block the direct east lane partway across. Drive around the pickets, reveal the yard, bring BOTH jeeps back into the start disc. ZERO losses, within about 50 turns. Bruting the pickets bleeds a jeep.
WIN WHEN: spot ≥1 enemy buildings AND get ≥2 units into region (10,20) r=5 AND lose ≤0 of your own units AND before game tick 4500.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 4501 OR NOT (lose ≤0 of your own units) OR your whole force is destroyed).
You have at most 52 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

FOUR enemy rifles now form a defended bottleneck across the central lane partway across — the direct east route is closed. Detour above the bottleneck or below it, surface the yard, return BOTH jeeps to the start disc. Zero losses, within about 50 turns.
WIN WHEN: spot ≥1 enemy buildings AND get ≥2 units into region (10,20) r=5 AND lose ≤0 of your own units AND before game tick 4500.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 4501 OR NOT (lose ≤0 of your own units) OR your whole force is destroyed).
You have at most 52 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

SIX enemy rifles thicken the central bottleneck and two flank pickets contest the inner detour bands. Only the far edge of the map matching your spawn corner clears the bottleneck. Surface the yard, return BOTH jeeps to the matched corner disc. Zero losses, within about 50 turns.
WIN WHEN: spot ≥1 enemy buildings AND (get ≥2 units into region (10,8) r=5 OR get ≥2 units into region (10,32) r=5) AND lose ≤0 of your own units AND before game tick 4500.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 4501 OR NOT (lose ≤0 of your own units) OR your whole force is destroyed).

title: Scout and Survive — Reveal the Objective, Then Return Alive

raw.realWorldMeaning: Reconnaissance with mandatory recovery. The scout is both the sensor and the worker — losing it costs the info channel and the asset. Real scout doctrine never treats discovery as the terminal goal; the scout must come back so the information is delivered AND the unit is preserved for the next mission. The pack tests whether the agent treats "saw the objective" or "scout returned home alive" as the success criterion.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: UAV/UGV reconnaissance with return-to-base endurance: the mission succeeds only if the platform reveals the target AND lands safely. A one-way commit that surfaces the target but ditches the platform is a partial failure, not a win.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: SC2 worker-scout micro (scout must survive), ERQA partial-observability under preservation, military UAV reconnaissance with return-to-base, intelligence-gather-and-extract missions
raw.author: openra-bench

title: Scout Count Defenders — Build Force EXACTLY Matched to Counted Threat

raw.realWorldMeaning: Exact-count perception coupled to a binding force-sizing decision. The agent must drive a scout into the fog to read EXACTLY how many enemy defenders are at the objective, then commission an attack force sized to defeat THAT count — no more (over-build wastes the production queue past the deadline), no less (under-build loses the attrition trade). The capability under test is COUNT-AWARE PRODUCTION SIZING, not bare scouting and not bare construction.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Inventory-driven dispatch under a binding deadline: an autonomous fleet manager must observe how many obstacles block a corridor before allocating the right number of clearing robots — sending too few robots fails the corridor opening, sending the whole fleet wastes the dispatch window on already-cleared sectors. The advertised capability is count-then-allocate, not over-allocate-to-be-safe.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: POMDP exact-count, ScienceWorld census, SC2 scout-count
raw.author: openra-bench

summary.en: Exact-count perception coupled to a binding force-sizing decision. The agent must drive a scout into the fog to read EXACTLY how many enemy defenders are at the objective, then commission an attack force sized to defeat THAT count — no more (over-build wastes the production queue past the deadline), no less (under-build loses the attrition trade). The capability under test is COUNT-AWARE PRODUCTION SIZING, not bare scouting and not bare construction.
summary.zh: 精确的计数感知与具有约束力的兵力规模决策相结合。特工必须驾驶侦察兵进入雾中，准确读取目标处有多少敌方防御者，然后委托一支规模足以击败该数量的攻击部队——不多（过度建设会浪费超过截止日期的生产队列），也不少（建设不足会失去消耗贸易）。所测试的能力是“COUNT-AARE 生产规模”，而不是单纯的侦察和构建。

en:
Exactly TWO enemy medium tanks plus two pillboxes guard the far-east enemy yard. You have a full base, two jeeps, and $5100. Scout the defenders, then commit only what you actually need — over-building misses the deadline. Discover two enemies, attack-move east, two kills. Yard alive, within about 29 turns.
WIN WHEN: spot ≥2 enemy units AND destroy ≥2 enemy units AND own ≥1 'fact' building(s) AND before game tick 2600.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 2601 OR NOT (own ≥1 'fact' building(s))).
You have at most 30 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

An UNKNOWN number of enemy tanks plus a pillbox guard the far-east yard in fog. Your base and two jeeps; $5100 cash. Drive a jeep east to count the defenders, queue 2tnks to match, attack-move east. Three kills, three discovered, yard alive, within about 34 turns.
WIN WHEN: spot ≥3 enemy units AND destroy ≥3 enemy units AND own ≥1 'fact' building(s) AND before game tick 3000.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 3001 OR NOT (own ≥1 'fact' building(s))).
You have at most 35 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

An UNKNOWN tank cloud plus two pillboxes guards the eastern yard; your base's latitude flips by seed. Count with the two jeeps, build EXACTLY enough medium tanks, attack-move east. Four kills, four discovered, yard alive, within about 43 turns. Under-build loses the trade; over-build misses the clock.
WIN WHEN: spot ≥4 enemy units AND destroy ≥4 enemy units AND own ≥1 'fact' building(s) AND before game tick 3800.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 3801 OR NOT (own ≥1 'fact' building(s))).
You have at most 44 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

title: Scout Cycle — Keep Information Fresh as the Battlefield Changes

raw.realWorldMeaning: Observation is not a one-shot. The agent scouts the battlefield, sees the visible enemy force, and commits a plan; mid-engagement, the battlefield changes (reinforcements arrive, the enemy maneuvers behind fog) and a stale picture is wrong. The intended policy CYCLES the scout — keeps pushing perception probes back into the previously-observed area to detect the change before the plan is invalidated. This is the perception cell that uniquely tests information FRESHNESS, not just initial reading.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Continuous SLAM / re-localisation: a robot that maps the room once and then drives by dead-reckoning crashes the instant a chair moves. A re-perceiving robot loops the lidar back across seen-but-stale regions. Similarly, an autonomous-vehicle perception stack cannot rely on a single frame — it must continually re-observe to detect lane changes, new pedestrians, and obstacles that appeared since the last glance.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: SC2 information refresh (scout cycling for army-position updates), continuous-SLAM re-localisation under environmental change, autonomous-vehicle perception (per-frame re-detection of dynamic obstacles), wargame intelligence cycle — collection → analysis → re-collection
raw.author: openra-bench

title: Counter-Recon — Deny Enemy Vision: Kill the Scouts Before They Report

raw.realWorldMeaning: An enemy scout has taken up an observation post overlooking your base; left alone it completes its report and the enemy gains a full picture of your disposition. The agent must locate and DESTROY every enemy scout before the report window closes. Sitting still lets the report complete; covering only ONE recon vector leaves the other scout's report intact. The pack tests counter-reconnaissance: actively denying the adversary vision by hunting down EVERY scout, not merely defending one approach.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Counter-surveillance / intrusion prevention: an adversary's reconnaissance probes are mapping the defended site, and each probe exfiltrates its findings once it has observed long enough. The defender must detect and neutralise EVERY probe before its report window elapses — a passive posture that merely watches the probes loses the information war, and neutralising one probe while ignoring another still leaks the map.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: military counter-reconnaissance, SC2 scout denial, intrusion prevention
raw.author: openra-bench

summary.en: An enemy scout has taken up an observation post overlooking your base; left alone it completes its report and the enemy gains a full picture of your disposition. The agent must locate and DESTROY every enemy scout before the report window closes. Sitting still lets the report complete; covering only ONE recon vector leaves the other scout's report intact. The pack tests counter-reconnaissance: actively denying the adversary vision by hunting down EVERY scout, not merely defending one approach.
summary.zh: 敌方侦察兵占据了俯瞰您基地的观察哨；如果不去管它，它就会完成报告，敌人就会全面了解你的部署。特工必须在报告窗口关闭之前找到并摧毁每个敌方侦察兵。静坐让报告完成；仅覆盖一个侦察向量，使其他侦察兵的报告完好无损。该狼群测试反侦察：通过追捕每一个侦察员来积极否认对手的视野，而不仅仅是防御一种方法。

en:
An enemy rocket soldier scout sits at the observation post (55,20), watching your disposition. Your two medium tanks HoldFire — they won't engage unless ordered. Drive them out and kill the scout before tick 1100. If the scout survives the report window, you lose.
WIN WHEN: destroy ≥1 enemy units AND before game tick 1100.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 1101).
You have at most 25 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

TWO enemy scouts hold observation posts on separate vectors — one at (55,12), one at (55,28). Your four medium tanks HoldFire. Split the force to cover BOTH vectors and kill both scouts before tick 1300. Committing the whole force to one lane leaves the other scout to file its report.
WIN WHEN: destroy ≥2 enemy units AND before game tick 1300.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 1301).
You have at most 25 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Two scouts at (55,12) and (55,28); your eight tanks stage at the NORTH or SOUTH base by seed and HoldFire. Split the force to kill both scouts before tick 1100 — a tight report window. A memorised intercept plan fails on the flipped seed; committing to one lane lets the other scout report.
WIN WHEN: destroy ≥2 enemy units AND before game tick 1100.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 1101).
You have at most 25 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.
zh:
一名敌方火箭兵侦察兵坐在观察哨（55,20），观察你的部署。你的两辆中型坦克保持火力——除非接到命令，否则它们不会交战。在 1100 点之前把他们赶出去并杀死侦察兵。如果侦察兵在报告窗口中幸存下来，你就输了。
胜利条件：消灭 ≥1 个敌方单位并且在游戏刻 1100 之前。
失败条件：（不在游戏刻 1101 之前）。
您最多有 25 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

两名敌方侦察兵在不同的矢量上持有观察哨——一名位于 (55,12)，一名位于 (55,28)。你的四辆中型坦克保持火力。在 1300 秒之前，将兵力分散到覆盖两个向量并杀死两个侦察兵。将整个兵力集中到一条车道上，让另一个侦察兵提交报告。
胜利条件：在游戏时间点 1300 之前消灭 ≥2 个敌方单位。
失败条件：（不在游戏刻 1301 之前）。
您最多有 25 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

两个侦察兵位于 (55,12) 和 (55,28)；你的八辆坦克通过种子和 HoldFire 在北或南基地进行攻击。在 1100 点之前分兵消灭两名侦察兵——这是一个紧张的报告窗口。记忆的拦截计划在翻转的种子上失败；致力于一条车道让另一位侦察兵报告。
胜利条件：消灭 ≥2 个敌方单位并且在游戏刻 1100 之前。
失败条件：（不在游戏刻 1101 之前）。
您最多有 25 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

title: Scout the Two Corners — Find the Enemy Base Direction Before Striking

raw.realWorldMeaning: Direction-of-target perception with two candidate locations and a finite reconnaissance budget. The enemy base could be at ONE OF TWO far corners; the agent must dispatch scouts to confirm each candidate, then commit the main strike force to the correct corner. Picking a corner blind half-wins and half-busts the clock on the round trip; only the deliberate scout-both-then-commit play converges every time. The capability under test is the model's discipline to PERFORM AND READ the perception step before committing the main resource.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Military intelligence triage: a battalion commander has two reported enemy locations and a small reconnaissance asset; the commander dispatches scouts to BOTH candidate sites, identifies which holds the actionable target, and commits the main force only after the intel is back. Pre-committing the main force without the scout trip strikes the wrong site half the time and burns the operational window. The doctrine under test is scout-then-strike, not commit-on-faith.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: ERQA direction-reading, military intelligence triage, SC2 scout direction
raw.author: openra-bench

title: Detect Enemy Tech — Identify the Doctrine from Observable Buildings

raw.realWorldMeaning: Recognising what your opponent is doing — their doctrine, tech path, or build axis — from the buildings you can observe. The binding skill is reading enough of the enemy footprint to identify the meaningful infrastructure (construction yard + production + tech), not just spotting any one building. Over-scouting wastes the clock and under-scouting commits blind to the wrong counter.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Competitive-intelligence overflight: a UAV scout must observe enough of a rival facility (the main yard + the production line + the distinguishing tech installation) to identify the operator's capability tier — a single building is ambiguous, mapping the whole site burns the loiter window.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: PlanBench observation-then-plan, SC2 tech detection (recognize enemy build-order from buildings), military doctrine-recognition from observed infrastructure, industrial competitive intelligence: detect supplier capacity
raw.author: openra-bench

summary.en: Recognising what your opponent is doing — their doctrine, tech path, or build axis — from the buildings you can observe. The binding skill is reading enough of the enemy footprint to identify the meaningful infrastructure (construction yard + production + tech), not just spotting any one building. Over-scouting wastes the clock and under-scouting commits blind to the wrong counter.
summary.zh: 从你可以观察到的建筑物中识别你的对手正在做什么——他们的学说、技术路径或建筑轴。绑定技能是读取足够的敌人足迹来识别有意义的基础设施（施工场地+生产+技术），而不仅仅是发现任何一栋建筑物。过度侦查会浪费时间，而侦查不足则会导致盲目地犯错。

en:
Just two enemy buildings sit in a tight cluster at the far east — a yard and a war factory. Drive both jeeps east, register the pair, halt. Two discoveries within about 25 turns. Brute-attacking the buildings bleeds the jeeps to the garrison; stalling never reaches the cluster.
WIN WHEN: spot ≥2 enemy buildings AND before game tick 2200.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 2201 OR your whole force is destroyed).
You have at most 26 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

THREE enemy buildings spaced across the east strip — yard, war factory, and a tech building. One-cell nudges or a fixed one-corner push won't see all three. Split the jeeps — one sweeps the north band, one the south, both cross the middle. At most one loss, within about 40 turns.
WIN WHEN: spot ≥3 enemy buildings AND lose ≤1 of your own units AND before game tick 3600.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 3601 OR NOT (lose ≤1 of your own units) OR your whole force is destroyed).
You have at most 40 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Three meaningful enemy buildings (yard, war factory, plus a tech tile — Tesla coil OR SAM site placed by seed). Your spawn (NW or SW) also flips by seed, so the "near" tech building changes per run. Discover three, ZERO losses, within about 40 turns. Brute attack wipes the jeeps; a fixed reading order misses the seed-placed tech tile.
WIN WHEN: spot ≥3 enemy buildings AND lose ≤0 of your own units AND before game tick 3600.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 3601 OR NOT (lose ≤0 of your own units) OR your whole force is destroyed).
You have at most 40 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.
zh:
在远东，只有两座敌方建筑紧密地坐落在一起——一个院子和一个军工工厂。将两辆吉普车向东行驶，登记两人，然后停下来。大约 25 回合内有两个发现。对建筑物的猛烈攻击会让吉普车流血到驻军；停顿永远不会到达集群。
胜利条件：发现 ≥​​2 个敌方建筑并且在游戏刻 2200 之前。
失败条件：（不是在游戏刻 2201 之前或你的整个部队被摧毁之前）。
您最多有 26 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

东边地带分布着三座敌方建筑——庭院、军工厂和一座科技大楼。单格轻推或固定的一角推动不会看到所有这三个。将吉普车分开——一辆扫过北带，一辆扫过南带，两辆都穿过中间。最多输一次，大概40回合之内。
胜利条件：发现 ≥​​3 个敌方建筑并损失 ≤1 个己方单位且在游戏刻 3600 之前。
失败条件：（不在游戏刻 3601 之前，否则（失去 ≤1 个自己的单位）或你的整个部队被摧毁）。
你最多有 40 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

三个有意义的敌人建筑（院子、战争工厂，加上一个科技板块——特斯拉线圈或种子放置的 SAM 站点）。你的出生点（西北或西南）也会按种子翻转，因此“附近”的科技建筑每次运行都会发生变化。在大约 40 回合内发现三个，零损失。暴力攻击将吉普车擦得一干二净；固定的阅读顺序会错过种子放置的科技板块。
胜利条件：发现 ≥​​3 个敌方建筑并损失 ≤0 个己方单位且在游戏刻 3600 之前。
失败条件：（不在游戏刻 3601 之前，否则（损失 ≤0 个自己的单位）或你的整个部队被摧毁）。
你最多有 40 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

title: Early Warning — Scout to Detect the Incoming Army Axis, Then Intercept

raw.realWorldMeaning: Early-warning intrusion detection paired with a targeted response. An enemy force is inbound and the agent's defenders are at the base, but the agent does NOT know which axis the army will arrive on. Pure defence-without-scouting cannot pre-position the defenders correctly; pure offence-without-scouting commits the defenders to the wrong lane; only a deliberate scout step — push sensors out, READ the approach axis, then re-position the defenders FORWARD on the correct lane — wins. This is the perception decision that precedes a targeted defensive commitment.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: NORAD-style early-warning network paired with QRF dispatch: sparse perimeter sensors LOCALISE an incoming threat; the response force is then vectored to the localised lane, not spread across the whole perimeter. An IDS that detects the breach lane lets the SecOps response target the right subnet instead of fortifying every host. A reconnaissance-in-force screen detects the enemy axis of advance so the main body deploys on the correct lane.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: SC2 early-warn scout / scout-for-attack, NORAD-style early-warning systems, intrusion detection systems (IDS), military reconnaissance-in-force detection
raw.author: openra-bench

title: Scout the Hidden Base — Search Off the Obvious Axis

raw.realWorldMeaning: Deep reconnaissance against an opponent that has DELIBERATELY deployed surface-level decoys on the obvious axis (eastward pickets) to draw your scouts the wrong way. The actual enemy base of operations is in an unconventional corner you must explicitly choose to look at — typically the corner near your own spawn, "behind" your forward direction. A model that anchors on the loudest indicator (the visible eastern pickets) will sweep the decoy zone and miss the base; the capability under test is whether the model proactively searches OFF the salient axis when the obvious axis returns no high-value finding.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: SAR / counter-IED reconnaissance where the obvious threat cue (a scatter of low-value targets along the apparent approach corridor) is a feint; the high-value cache sits in an unconventional location operators must explicitly elect to sweep instead of following the obvious line.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: CICERO/Diplomacy deep recon (enemy hidden where you don't expect), ERQA off-axis perception (answer is off the salient compass axis), intelligence ops: search unconventional locations, SC2 hidden-base detection (proxy/hidden expansion)
raw.author: openra-bench

summary.en: Deep reconnaissance against an opponent that has DELIBERATELY deployed surface-level decoys on the obvious axis (eastward pickets) to draw your scouts the wrong way. The actual enemy base of operations is in an unconventional corner you must explicitly choose to look at — typically the corner near your own spawn, "behind" your forward direction. A model that anchors on the loudest indicator (the visible eastern pickets) will sweep the decoy zone and miss the base; the capability under test is whether the model proactively searches OFF the salient axis when the obvious axis returns no high-value finding.
summary.zh: 对故意在明显轴线（向东的尖桩）上部署地面诱饵以吸引侦察兵的对手进行深入侦察。敌人的实际行动基地位于一个非常规的角落，你必须明确选择查看——通常是你自己的出生点附近的角落，在你的前进方向“后面”。锚定在最响亮的指示器（可见的东部尖桩）上的模型将扫过诱饵区域并错过基地；所测试的能力是当显着轴没有返回高值发现时，模型是否主动搜索显着轴。

en:
Commander, two jeep scouts at your west-centre base. Sensors report an enemy presence to the east — a couple of rifle pickets. Intelligence warns the real enemy base may be somewhere else entirely. The pickets are on hold-fire orders. Discover the real enemy yard within about eight turns, losing at most one jeep.
WIN WHEN: spot ≥1 enemy buildings AND before game tick 700 AND lose ≤1 of your own units.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 701 OR NOT (lose ≤1 of your own units) OR your whole force is destroyed).
You have at most 9 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Commander, two jeep scouts at your west-centre base. Sensors report a more convincing enemy presence to the east — three rifle pickets clustered around the east edge. Intelligence warns the real enemy base may be somewhere else entirely. The pickets are on hold-fire. Discover the real enemy yard within about seven turns, losing at most one jeep. The clock will not admit a wrong-direction sweep followed by a reverse.
WIN WHEN: spot ≥1 enemy buildings AND before game tick 600 AND lose ≤1 of your own units.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 601 OR NOT (lose ≤1 of your own units) OR your whole force is destroyed).
You have at most 8 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Commander, four jeep scouts stage at a north-leaning or south-leaning west-centre by seed. Sensors report a rifle picket cluster to the east. Intelligence warns the real enemy base may be in either of the corners flanking your stage, and your spawn latitude controls which corner is the closer reach. Discover any real enemy yard within about six turns, losing at most one jeep.
WIN WHEN: spot ≥1 enemy buildings AND before game tick 500 AND lose ≤1 of your own units.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 501 OR NOT (lose ≤1 of your own units) OR your whole force is destroyed).
You have at most 7 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.
zh:
指挥官，你的中西部基地有两名吉普车侦察兵。传感器报告东边有敌人存在——几个步枪哨兵。情报警告说，真正的敌人基地可能完全在其他地方。纠察队已接到停火令。在大约八个回合内发现真正的敌人院子，最多损失一辆吉普车。
胜利条件：发现 ≥​​1 个敌方建筑并且在游戏前勾选 700 并且损失 ≤1 个己方单位。
失败条件：（不是在游戏刻 701 之前，否则（损失 ≤1 个你自己的单位）或者你的整个部队被摧毁）。
你最多有 9 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

胜利条件：发现 ≥​​1 个敌方建筑并且在游戏前勾选 600 并且损失 ≤1 个己方单位。
失败条件：（不在游戏刻 601 之前，否则（损失 ≤1 个自己的单位）或你的整个部队被摧毁）。

胜利条件：发现 ≥​​1 个敌方建筑并且在游戏前勾选 500 并且损失 ≤1 个己方单位。
失败条件：（不在游戏刻 501 之前，否则（损失 ≤1 个你自己的单位）或你的整个部队被摧毁）。

title: Cost-Effective Recon — Buy the Jeep, Not the Tank or the Rifle Squad

raw.realWorldMeaning: A fixed intelligence budget ($900) funds EITHER a dedicated scout vehicle (1× jeep, $500, wheeled, sight 7c — the cost-effective optimum), OR a light tank that's slower AND more expensive (1× light tank, $700, tracked, sight 6c — the over-investment), OR a rifle company that's cheap-per-body but too slow on foot (9× rifle infantry, $100 ea, sight 4c — the under-investment). The mission is "put eyes on the far frontier inside a tight clock". The correct decision is to spend the MINIMUM that buys the FASTEST eyes at range: the jeep. Picking the tank wastes capital on armour you don't need AND fields a slower mover; picking infantry buys cheaper bodies that physically can't cover the distance inside the deadline. The capability under test is cost-effective tool selection for a reconnaissance objective.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: UAV / sensor-platform procurement under an intelligence budget: the mission is to read a remote location inside a deadline, not to engage anything. A small/cheap drone with the right sensor payload and the right cruise speed dominates either a heavier armoured platform (over-spend on capability you don't need) or a swarm of slow ground sensors (under-spend on mobility). The procurement decision is cost-vs-speed for an information goal, not raw capability or raw unit count.

title: Scout Coverage — Reveal X% of the Map in Budget

raw.realWorldMeaning: Broad-area reconnaissance with a coverage objective. The task is not to find one hidden landmark but to DOMINATE the map's visibility — distribute a small scout force so the union of their sensor footprints sweeps a target fraction of the playable area within a deadline. Bunching the force onto one swath, stranding a single scout with the rest idle, or stalling all fail the coverage bar; only a deliberate spread covers the map in time.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Multi-robot lawn-mower / Voronoi-partitioned area-coverage planning under a time budget — pick disjoint regions for each scout so the union sweeps the workspace before the clock.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: SC2 map-control / vision objectives, ERQA coverage, military area dominance / coverage objective, drone search coverage planning
raw.author: openra-bench

summary.en: Broad-area reconnaissance with a coverage objective. The task is not to find one hidden landmark but to DOMINATE the map's visibility — distribute a small scout force so the union of their sensor footprints sweeps a target fraction of the playable area within a deadline. Bunching the force onto one swath, stranding a single scout with the rest idle, or stalling all fail the coverage bar; only a deliberate spread covers the map in time.
summary.zh: 具有覆盖目标的大范围侦察。任务不是找到一个隐藏的地标，而是控制地图的可见性——分配一支小型侦察部队，以便他们的传感器足迹联合起来在最后期限内扫荡可玩区域的目标部分。将兵力集中在一个区域上，让一名侦察兵滞留而让其他侦察兵闲置，或者让所有侦察兵都无法覆盖范围；只有故意的传播才能及时覆盖地图。

en:
Four jeep scouts at the SW edge. Reveal at least 30% of the map by about turn 6. Bunching the jeeps onto one destination caps coverage on a single swath and just misses the bar; only fanning the four jeeps to the four FAR edges crosses 30% in time. No enemies.
WIN WHEN: reveal ≥48% of the map AND before game tick 453 AND lose ≤0 of your own units.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 454 OR your whole force is destroyed).
You have at most 8 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Four jeep scouts at the SW edge. Reveal at least 50% of the map by about turn 10. A bunched one-swath push tops out near 50% but only at tick 903 — past the deadline. Fan the jeeps to the SE, NE, SW-far, and NW-far edges; the union crosses ~56% in time.
WIN WHEN: reveal ≥50% of the map AND before game tick 825 AND lose ≤0 of your own units.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 826 OR your whole force is destroyed).
You have at most 12 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Five (or ten) jeep scouts stage at the SW or NW edge by seed. Reveal at least 70% of the map by about turn 15. A bunched push asymptotes near 69% and never crosses 70%. Fan to four corners plus a diagonal, then redirect each jeep to the opposite quadrant once its first edge is reached.
WIN WHEN: reveal ≥70% of the map AND before game tick 1350 AND lose ≤0 of your own units.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 1351 OR your whole force is destroyed).
You have at most 15 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.
zh:
四辆吉普车侦察兵在西南边缘。在第 6 回合左右时，至少显示 30% 的地图。将吉普车聚集到一个目的地会限制单条带的覆盖范围，但会错过目标；仅将四辆吉普车扇动到四个 FAR 边缘就可以及时跨越 30%。没有敌人。
胜利条件：揭示 ≥48% 的地图，并且在游戏刻 453 之前，并且损失 ≤0 个自己的单位。
失败条件：（不是在游戏刻 454 之前或你的整个部队被摧毁之前）。
您最多有 8 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

四辆吉普车侦察兵在西南边缘。大约在第 10 回合时，显示至少 50% 的地图。一堆单行推进接近 50%，但仅在刻度 903 时达到顶峰——超过了截止日期。将吉普车扇向东南、东北、西南和西北边缘；联盟的时间跨度约为 56%。
胜利条件：揭示 ≥50% 的地图，并在游戏前勾选 825 并损失 ≤0 的己方单位。
失败条件：（不是在游戏刻 826 之前或你的整个部队被摧毁之前）。
您最多有 12 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

五（或十）辆吉普车侦察兵在西南或西北边缘按种子进行比赛。到第 15 回合左右时，至少显示出地图的 70%。成群的推力渐近线接近 69%，并且永远不会超过 70%。扇形到四个角加上一条对角线，然后在到达第一个边缘后将每辆吉普车重定向到相反的象限。
胜利条件：显示 ≥70% 的地图并且在游戏刻 1350 之前并且损失 ≤0 个自己的单位。
失败条件：（不在游戏刻 1351 之前或你的整个部队被摧毁之前）。
您最多有 15 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

title: Scout Multiple Fog Areas — Split, Don't Tour

raw.realWorldMeaning: Multi-region reconnaissance under a hard intelligence deadline: every sector must be eyed before commit. A single patrol cycled A→B→C blows the deadline because B and C wait while A is read; sending the whole team to one sector leaves the others blank. The advertised capability is concurrent multi-sector dispatch — one sensor per region, all arriving roughly together.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Multi-robot area surveillance with one drone per sector and a bounded intel-window: drones must launch in parallel so every sector is observed before the window closes; serialising one drone across all sectors misses the deadline, and committing the full fleet to one sector leaves the others unobserved.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: Watch-And-Help concurrent multi-task scout, SMAC distributed exploration, SC2 multi-scout coverage, military distributed reconnaissance doctrine
raw.author: openra-bench

summary.en: Multi-region reconnaissance under a hard intelligence deadline: every sector must be eyed before commit. A single patrol cycled A→B→C blows the deadline because B and C wait while A is read; sending the whole team to one sector leaves the others blank. The advertised capability is concurrent multi-sector dispatch — one sensor per region, all arriving roughly together.
summary.zh: 硬情报期限下的多区域侦察：在提交之前必须关注每个区域。循环 A→B→C 的单个巡逻会超出最后期限，因为 B 和 C 在读取 A 时等待；将整个团队派往一个区域，其他区域则空白。宣传的功能是并发多部门调度——每个区域一个传感器，所有传感器大致一起到达。

en:
Two foggy regions each hide one marker building — NE corner (~124,4) and SE corner (~124,36). Three jeeps in the west staging column. Dispatch one jeep to each corner in parallel; a one-corner commit leaves the other in fog. At most one loss, within about 20 turns.
WIN WHEN: spot ≥2 enemy buildings AND lose ≤1 of your own units AND before game tick 1800.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 1801 OR NOT (lose ≤1 of your own units) OR your whole force is destroyed).
You have at most 22 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

THREE foggy regions each hide a marker building — NE (~124,4), SE (~124,36), and far-east mid-band (~124,20). Three jeeps; one per region in parallel. A serial tour with one jeep can't reach the third before about turn 12. At most one loss.
WIN WHEN: spot ≥3 enemy buildings AND lose ≤1 of your own units AND before game tick 1050.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 1051 OR NOT (lose ≤1 of your own units) OR your whole force is destroyed).
You have at most 13 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

FOUR fog regions, three jeeps — one jeep must sweep two regions on a single edge corridor (NW→NE on the north edge, SW→SE on the south). Your spawn corner round-robins NW/SW by seed; re-derive which jeep sweeps which pair from your actual start row. Four discoveries, one loss max, within about 15 turns.
WIN WHEN: spot ≥4 enemy buildings AND lose ≤1 of your own units AND before game tick 1300.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 1301 OR NOT (lose ≤1 of your own units) OR your whole force is destroyed).
You have at most 16 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.
zh:
两个雾区域各隐藏一栋标记建筑——东北角 (~124,4) 和东南角 (~124,36)。三辆吉普车停在西边的集结纵队里。派一辆吉普车平行到每个角落；一个角落的提交让另一个角落陷入迷雾。最多输一次，大概20回合之内。
胜利条件：发现 ≥​​2 个敌方建筑并损失 ≤1 个己方单位且在游戏刻 1800 之前。
失败条件：（不在游戏刻 1801 之前，否则（损失 ≤1 个你自己的单位）或你的整个部队被摧毁）。
您最多有 22 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

三个雾区域各自隐藏着一座标记建筑——东北 (~124,4)、东南 (~124,36) 和远东中带 (~124,20)。三辆吉普车；每个区域并行一个。一辆吉普车的连环游在12号弯左右之前无法到达第三个。最多输一次。
胜利条件：发现 ≥​​3 个敌方建筑并损失 ≤1 个己方单位且在游戏刻 1050 之前。
失败条件：（不在游戏刻 1051 之前，否则（失去 ≤1 个自己的单位）或你的整个部队被摧毁）。
您最多有 13 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

四个雾区，三辆吉普车 - 一辆吉普车必须扫过单个边缘走廊上的两个区域（北边缘的 NW→NE，南边缘的 SW→SE）。你的重生角按种子进行西北/西南循环赛；从您的实际起始行重新导出哪辆吉普车扫过哪对。大约 15 回合内有 4 项发现，最多 1 项损失。
胜利条件：发现 ≥​​4 个敌方建筑并损失 ≤1 个己方单位且在游戏刻 1300 之前。
失败条件：（不在游戏刻 1301 之前，否则（损失 ≤1 个自己的单位）或你的整个部队被摧毁）。
您最多有 16 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

title: Track the March — Keep a Moving Enemy Army in Vision Over Time

raw.realWorldMeaning: Tracking a mobile target is not a one-shot observation. An enemy army marches across the map on a multi-leg route; a scout that glances at it once, at its starting position, loses the track the instant the army moves on. The intended policy keeps a scout MOVING WITH the army — re-observing it at each successive position — so the agent always knows where the target is and can vector its strike force to intercept. This is the perception cell that tests CONTINUOUS TARGET TRACKING: the target itself is mobile, and a stale fixed observation is worse than useless.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Persistent military target tracking and intrusion-detection continuous monitoring: a radar / ISR asset that fixes a moving convoy once and then assumes it stayed put vectors the interceptor to empty ground. A tracking system must hand the target from sensor to sensor, continuously re-observing it as it travels, to maintain a live track. Likewise an autonomous surveillance robot following a moving subject must keep it in the camera frame frame-after-frame — a single detection decays into a stale, wrong position the moment the subject walks away.

raw.author: openra-bench

en:

WIN WHEN: in this exact order: spot ≥3 enemy units → THEN → not before game tick 1400 → THEN → spot ≥6 enemy units → THEN → not before game tick 2700 → THEN → spot ≥9 enemy units AND destroy ≥2 enemy units AND before game tick 4000.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 4001 OR NOT (own ≥1 'fact' building(s)) OR not before game tick 300 AND your whole force is destroyed).
You have at most 50 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

title: Engineer Capture — Seize an Enemy Building

raw.realWorldMeaning: Specialist re-assignment of an enemy asset's OWNERSHIP — the win condition is "the target is mine now", not "the target is destroyed". The only worker that can do it is the engineer; attacking it with anything else either no-ops or destroys the asset and loses the capture window.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: A non-combat utility robot dispatched to an unattended adversary facility to flip its ownership (load fresh credentials / re-key a lock / claim a derelict), consuming the agent in the process.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: BFCL tool fidelity, specialist unit action
raw.author: engine-capture-task

summary.en: Specialist re-assignment of an enemy asset's OWNERSHIP — the win condition is "the target is mine now", not "the target is destroyed". The only worker that can do it is the engineer; attacking it with anything else either no-ops or destroys the asset and loses the capture window.
summary.zh: 专家重新分配敌方资产的所有权——获胜条件是“目标现在是我的了”，而不是“目标已被摧毁”。唯一能做到这一点的工人是工程师；使用其他任何方式攻击它，要么无操作，要么破坏资产并失去捕获窗口。

en:
Engineer next door to an undefended enemy refinery on a small open arena. One capture_actor call wins.
WIN WHEN: own a 'proc' AND before game tick 2000.
YOU LOSE IF: not before game tick 2001.
You have at most 25 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Engineer in the west lobe must traverse a single 4-cell corridor (the only opening through a vertical water wall) to reach the enemy refinery on the east side. Pathing finds the corridor automatically; the deadline is tight.
WIN WHEN: own a 'proc' AND before game tick 3000.
YOU LOSE IF: not before game tick 3001.
You have at most 35 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Long escort: two staggered water-obstacle clusters force a serpentine route across the map. The engineer reaches an enemy refinery on the far east; a stance:2 enemy rifleman south of the ore refinery denies a south approach. The agent has two engineers (redundancy) but the clock is tight.
WIN WHEN: own a 'proc' AND before game tick 4000.
YOU LOSE IF: not before game tick 4001.
You have at most 50 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

在一个不设防的敌方炼油厂隔壁的一个小型开放场地上进行工程师。一次 capture_actor 调用获胜。

title: Nuclear Strike — Fire the mslo on the Enemy Cluster

raw.realWorldMeaning: The agent owns a nuclear missile silo and must commit a single high-damage strike to the correct target cell. The capability under test is SPATIAL COMMIT × CORRECT VERB — read the observed enemy cluster, take its centroid, wait the recharge window, and fire the superweapon at that cell. Every non-fire policy (stall, blind-fire at an empty cell) loses.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Discrete high-stakes one-shot actuation under a charge constraint — a directed-energy / EMP weapon with a long recharge cycle aimed at a transient cluster (riot-control AoE deployment, missile intercept with a single available interceptor). The operator must wait for the system to arm, identify the correct target volume, then commit irreversibly; a mis-aimed shot wastes the entire charge window and the threat persists.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: RA1 / RA2 Nuclear Missile silo, TA / SC2 nuke launch sequence, real-world: discrete one-shot high-stakes actuation under recharge
raw.author: openra-bench

en:
Your missile silo at (10,10) charges in about 100 ticks. A cluster of five enemy ore silos sits across the map; a friendly jeep already has eyes on it. Read the observation, fire the nuke at the cluster center, take out all five silos in one shot.
WIN WHEN: destroy ≥5 enemy buildings AND before game tick 1800.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 1801).
You have at most 22 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Your missile silo at (10,10) charges in about 100 ticks. The cluster is now in the south-east corner of the map; six enemy ore silos, your jeep is in eyeshot. Find the center, fire the nuke, take out all six.
WIN WHEN: destroy ≥6 enemy buildings AND before game tick 1800.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 1801).
You have at most 22 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Same charge-and-fire capability, but the dense cluster of six ore silos spawns in the NE OR SW corner by seed. Your missile silo is fixed at (10,10) so either target is in range, and a jeep spotter ships in with the cluster. Read the observation, pick the center, fire the nuke.
WIN WHEN: destroy ≥6 enemy buildings AND before game tick 1800.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 1801).
You have at most 22 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.
zh:
您位于 (10,10) 的导弹发射井大约需要 100 个刻度。地图上分布着五个敌人的矿井群；一辆友好的吉普车已经注意到了它。阅读观察结果，向星团中心发射核弹，一枪摧毁所有五个发射井。
胜利条件：摧毁 ≥5 个敌方建筑并在游戏刻 1800 之前。
失败条件：（不在游戏刻 1801 之前）。
您最多有 22 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

您位于 (10,10) 的导弹发射井大约需要 100 个刻度。该集群现在位于地图的东南角；六个敌人的矿石筒仓，你的吉普车就在视野范围内。找到中心，发射核武器，消灭所有六个。
胜利条件：在游戏刻 1800 之前摧毁 ≥6 个敌方建筑。
失败条件：（不在游戏刻 1801 之前）。
您最多有 22 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

具有相同的冲锋能力，但六个矿石筒仓的密集簇会通过种子在东北角或西南角生成。您的导弹发射井固定在 (10,10)，因此任一目标都在射程内，并且吉普车观测器会随集群一起进入。阅读观察结果，选择中心，发射核武器。
胜利条件：在游戏刻 1800 之前摧毁 ≥6 个敌方建筑。
失败条件：（不在游戏刻 1801 之前）。
您最多有 22 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

title: Spy Infiltrate — One-Shot Scan of an Enemy Network

raw.realWorldMeaning: Specialist re-tasked from "observe-by-line-of-sight" to "observe-by-infiltration" — entering a single facility reveals the operator's FULL portfolio of structures, not just the visited node. The spy is consumed in the process, so the decision is irreversible and the operator chooses WHICH facility to enter (only one chance per spy).
raw.roboticsAnalogue: A passive sensor smuggled inside an unattended adversary node that, on arrival, beacons home an inventory of every other node on the operator's network. Single-use; the sensor cannot be recovered.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: BFCL tool fidelity, specialist unit action
raw.author: engine-infiltrate-task

summary.en: Specialist re-tasked from "observe-by-line-of-sight" to "observe-by-infiltration" — entering a single facility reveals the operator's FULL portfolio of structures, not just the visited node. The spy is consumed in the process, so the decision is irreversible and the operator chooses WHICH facility to enter (only one chance per spy).
summary.zh: 专家的任务从“视线观察”改为“渗透观察”——进入单个设施会显示操作员的完整结构组合，而不仅仅是访问的节点。间谍在此过程中被消耗，因此该决定是不可逆转的，操作员选择进入哪个设施（每个间谍只有一次机会）。

en:
Walk your spy into the enemy refinery (ore refinery) to scan the enemy network. The scan reveals every enemy structure on the map, including ones outside your spy's line of sight. Win = ≥4 enemy buildings discovered before tick 2000.
WIN WHEN: spot ≥4 enemy buildings AND before game tick 2000.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 2001 OR NOT (have ≥1 'spy')).
You have at most 25 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Walk your spy past a cover cluster into the enemy refinery (ore refinery), then infiltrate to scan their network. Win = ≥6 enemy buildings discovered before tick 3000.
WIN WHEN: spot ≥6 enemy buildings AND before game tick 3000.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 3001 OR NOT (have ≥1 'spy')).
You have at most 35 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Defended target: a stance:2 enemy rifle infantry guards the south approach to the ore refinery. The agent has two spies (redundancy); a direct walk to the ore refinery stays out of rifle range, but any south detour or wander dies. Win = ≥7 enemy buildings discovered before tick 4000.
WIN WHEN: spot ≥7 enemy buildings AND before game tick 4000.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 4001 OR NOT (have ≥1 'spy')).
You have at most 50 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.
zh:
让你的间谍走进敌人的精炼厂（矿石精炼厂）来扫描敌人的网络。扫描会显示地图上的每个敌人结构，包括间谍视线之外的结构。胜利 = 在 2000 年刻度之前发现 ≥4 个敌方建筑。
胜利条件：发现 ≥​​4 个敌方建筑并且在游戏刻 2000 之前。
失败条件：（不在游戏刻 2001 或否之前（有 ≥1 个“间谍”））。
您最多有 25 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

让你的间谍穿过掩护集群进入敌方精炼厂（矿石精炼厂），然后渗透扫描他们的网络。胜利=在刻度3000之前发现≥6个敌方建筑。
胜利条件：发现 ≥​​6 个敌方建筑并且在游戏前勾选 3000。
失败条件：（不在游戏前勾选 3001 或不（有 ≥1 个“间谍”））。
您最多有 35 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

防御目标：姿态：2名敌方步枪步兵守卫精炼厂南面通道。特工有两名间谍（冗余）；直接步行到矿石精炼厂不会受到步枪射程的影响，但任何向南绕行或徘徊都会失败。胜利 = 在 4000 点之前发现 ≥7 个敌方建筑。
胜利条件：发现 ≥​​7 个敌方建筑并且在比赛前勾选 4000。
失败条件：（不在游戏前勾选 4001 或不（有 ≥1 个“间谍”））。
您最多有 50 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

title: Tanya C4 Strike — Instant-Destroy an Enemy Building

raw.realWorldMeaning: Demolition doctrine — a specialist hero asset (Tanya commando) plants C4 on an enemy STRUCTURE and instantly destroys it, surviving the blast. The decision is "commit the hero to the walk-up + plant", not "trade fire". A stall policy or a generic attack-with-pistol policy is too slow.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: A demolition / EOD asset dispatched to a hardened adversary structure: walk to it, place the charge, exfil. The asset survives; the target does not. The verb is "demolish in one action", distinct from "wear down by fire" or "seize ownership".
raw.benchmarkAnchor: BFCL tool fidelity, specialist unit action
raw.author: engine-tanya-task

summary.en: Demolition doctrine — a specialist hero asset (Tanya commando) plants C4 on an enemy STRUCTURE and instantly destroys it, surviving the blast. The decision is "commit the hero to the walk-up + plant", not "trade fire". A stall policy or a generic attack-with-pistol policy is too slow.
summary.zh: 拆除原则 — 一名专业英雄资产（Tanya 突击队）将 C4 放置在敌方建筑物上，并立即将其摧毁，并在爆炸中幸存。这个决定是“让英雄去无电梯+工厂”，而不是“贸易火力”。失速策略或通用手枪攻击策略太慢。

en:
Tanya stands next to an undefended enemy refinery. One c4_detonate call walks her up and demolishes the ore refinery.
WIN WHEN: destroy ≥1 enemy buildings AND before game tick 1500.
YOU LOSE IF: not before game tick 1501.
You have at most 20 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Two stance:0 enemy riflemen idle next to the enemy ore refinery; they will not open fire. The agent must walk Tanya past them and C4 the ore refinery, ignoring the bait.
WIN WHEN: destroy ≥1 enemy buildings AND before game tick 2000.
YOU LOSE IF: not before game tick 2001.
You have at most 25 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Two stance:2 riflemen cover the approach to an enemy refinery roughly 12 cells east. Tanya's HP comfortably absorbs the trade — commit her to a direct C4 strike on the refinery. A brute pistol attack on the ore refinery times out before the clock. Within about 30 turns.
WIN WHEN: destroy ≥1 enemy buildings AND before game tick 2700.
YOU LOSE IF: not before game tick 2701.
You have at most 30 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.
zh:
塔尼娅站在一个不设防的敌方炼油厂旁边。一个 c4_detonate 呼叫让她走上前并摧毁了矿石精炼厂。
胜利条件：摧毁 ≥1 个敌方建筑并且在游戏刻 1500 之前。
失败条件：不在游戏刻 1501 之前。
您最多有 20 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

两种姿态：0敌方步枪兵在敌方矿石精炼厂旁闲逛；他们不会开火。特工必须带领坦尼娅经过他们和 C4 矿石精炼厂，忽略诱饵。
胜利条件：在游戏时间 2000 之前摧毁 ≥1 个敌方建筑。
失败条件：不是在 2001 年比赛之前。
您最多有 25 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

两种姿态：2 名步枪手掩护通往东边约 12 个单元的敌方炼油厂的通道。坦尼娅的生命值轻松吸收了交易——让她对炼油厂进行直接 C4 攻击。对矿石精炼厂的野蛮手枪袭击在时间结束前超时。大约30转之内。
胜利条件：摧毁 ≥1 个敌方建筑并且在游戏时间点 2700 之前。
失败条件：不在游戏刻 2701 之前。
您最多有 30 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

title: Thief Steal Cash — Drain an Enemy Depot

raw.realWorldMeaning: Specialist tasked with VALUE EXTRACTION rather than destruction: proximity to an enemy cash-store transfers a fixed quantum to the operator's wallet and consumes the asset. The decision is "which depot to hit" under a single-use crew constraint.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: A loadout-extraction drone dispatched to an under-defended cache; on arrival it transfers a fixed inventory quantum to the operator's pool and is consumed in the process.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: BFCL tool fidelity, specialist unit action
raw.author: engine-infiltrate-task

summary.en: Specialist tasked with VALUE EXTRACTION rather than destruction: proximity to an enemy cash-store transfers a fixed quantum to the operator's wallet and consumes the asset. The decision is "which depot to hit" under a single-use crew constraint.
summary.zh: 专家的任务是提取价值而不是破坏：靠近敌方现金商店会将固定数量转移到操作员的钱包中并消耗资产。该决定是在一次性船员限制下“攻击哪个仓库”。

en:
Thief at the west corridor mouth, undefended enemy refinery one step into the corridor. One infiltrate call drains some enemy cash into your wallet. Win = own cash ≥400 before tick 1350.
WIN WHEN: hold ≥400 credits AND before game tick 1350.

title: Risk Dilemma — Destroy the Enemy Economy via the Safer Route

raw.realWorldMeaning: Two routes to the objective: a safe-but-long path vs a short-but-lethal one. The decision is route risk assessment under a deadline, not pathfinding itself.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Field-robot route selection rejecting a hazardous shortest path for a survivable longer one within a time window.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: PlanBench, ARC spatial reasoning, risk-aware route selection
raw.author: ported-from-training

summary.en: Two routes to the objective: a safe-but-long path vs a short-but-lethal one. The decision is route risk assessment under a deadline, not pathfinding itself.
summary.zh: 达到目标有两条路：一条安全但漫长的道路和一条短但致命的道路。该决定是在最后期限内进行路线风险评估，而不是寻路本身。

en:
Raze the enemy's economic core (construction yard and ore refinery) to the east. A heavy defensive cluster — two pillboxes (stationary defensive turrets), one Tesla coil, four rifle and rocket infantry — sits across the middle of the map and shreds anything that drives straight through. Reach the base and eliminate construction yard and ore refinery within about 50 turns.
WIN WHEN: destroy the enemy fact+proc AND before game tick 4500.
YOU LOSE IF: (NOT (before game tick 4500) OR your whole force is destroyed).
You have at most 55 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Raze the enemy's economic core (construction yard and ore refinery) to the east. A heavy defensive cluster — two pillboxes, one Tesla coil, four rifle and rocket infantry — sits across the middle of the map and shreds anything driving straight through. The clock tightens to about 40 turns and you may lose at most seven units; a costly brawl no longer wins even if you reach the base.
WIN WHEN: destroy the enemy fact+proc AND before game tick 3600 AND lose ≤7 of your own units.
YOU LOSE IF: (NOT (before game tick 3600) OR NOT (lose ≤7 of your own units) OR your whole force is destroyed).
You have at most 45 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Same yard-plus-refinery objective and the same central cluster of pillboxes, Tesla coil, and rocket soldiers. The clock tightens to about 30 turns and the loss cap drops to five. The direct lane is unsurvivable at this attrition cap.
WIN WHEN: destroy the enemy fact+proc AND before game tick 2700 AND lose ≤5 of your own units.
YOU LOSE IF: (NOT (before game tick 2700) OR NOT (lose ≤5 of your own units) OR your whole force is destroyed).
You have at most 35 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

title: Capital Trilemma — Commit One Indivisible Quarter to Expand / Tech / Army

raw.realWorldMeaning: Capital allocation under one indivisible quarter-budget across three mutually exclusive product directions: a startup deciding between hiring (ARMY), R&D (TECH), or geographic expansion (a second base). Choosing two starves the third — and starves all three — because the quarter's burn funds exactly one full path. The test is the commit, not the mechanics of any single path: the binding budget makes hedging a strict loss.

title: Exact Build Order — Produce the Precise Bill of Materials Under Budget

raw.realWorldMeaning: Produce an EXACT bill of materials under a hard budget and a deadline: build only the tech-tree prerequisites needed, in the right order, and produce exactly the specified units — no more, no less. Overproducing one type, erecting an unnecessary structure, or under-delivering exhausts the budget / misses the spec and fails. The objective is instruction/spec fidelity itself, not combat — the OpenRA analogue of strict tool/function-calling benchmarks (BFCL / τ²-bench): do exactly and only what was asked, on time.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Manufacturing-cell order fulfilment under a resource cap and a shift deadline: satisfy a precise parts list respecting assembly prerequisites without over-building, under-building, or wasting stock.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: BFCL tool fidelity, StarCraft build order, manufacturing order fulfilment
raw.author: openra-bench

summary.en: Produce an EXACT bill of materials under a hard budget and a deadline: build only the tech-tree prerequisites needed, in the right order, and produce exactly the specified units — no more, no less. Overproducing one type, erecting an unnecessary structure, or under-delivering exhausts the budget / misses the spec and fails. The objective is instruction/spec fidelity itself, not combat — the OpenRA analogue of strict tool/function-calling benchmarks (BFCL / τ²-bench): do exactly and only what was asked, on time.
summary.zh: 在严格的预算和期限内制作精确的物料清单：仅以正确的顺序构建所需的技术树先决条件，并精确地生产指定的单元 - 不多也不少。过度生产一种类型、建立不必要的结构或交付不足会耗尽预算/未达到规格并失败。目标是指令/规范保真度本身，而不是战斗 - OpenRA 类似于严格的工具/函数调用基准（BFCL / τ²-bench）：准确且仅按时执行要求的操作。

en:
Bill of materials: EXACTLY three rifles AND EXACTLY one grenadier. Both need a barracks first. The budget covers the barracks plus the precise mix — a fourth rifle, a second grenadier, or any extra structure breaks the spec. Deliver within about 30 turns.
WIN WHEN: have EXACTLY 3 'e1' (no more, no fewer) AND have EXACTLY 1 'e2' (no more, no fewer) AND before game tick 2700.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 2701 OR have ≥4 'e1' OR have ≥2 'e2').
You have at most 40 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Spec: build EXACTLY 3 rifle infantry + EXACTLY 2 rocket soldiers. Rocket soldiers share the barracks tech but costs more — the budget forces correct allocation, no waste. Over- or under-producing either type, or missing the deadline, is a loss.
WIN WHEN: have EXACTLY 3 'e1' (no more, no fewer) AND have EXACTLY 2 'e3' (no more, no fewer) AND before game tick 3000.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 3001 OR have ≥4 'e1' OR have ≥3 'e3').
You have at most 45 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Bill of materials: EXACTLY three rifles AND EXACTLY two rocket soldiers, PLUS a working Tesla coil — the Soviet tech path ore refinery → war factory → Tesla coil. Tesla draws heavy power, so extra power plants are required to keep the surplus non-negative. The tight budget leaves no room for overproduction. Within about 70 turns.
WIN WHEN: have EXACTLY 3 'e1' (no more, no fewer) AND have EXACTLY 2 'e3' (no more, no fewer) AND own ≥1 'tsla' building(s) AND keep power surplus ≥0 AND before game tick 6300.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 6301 OR have ≥4 'e1' OR have ≥3 'e3' OR own ≥2 'tsla' building(s)).
You have at most 75 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.
zh:
材料清单：恰好三支步枪和一支掷弹兵。两者都首先需要一个营房。预算涵盖营房以及精确的组合——第四支步枪、第二支掷弹兵或任何违反规格的额外结构。大约 30 圈内交付。
胜利条件：恰好有 3 个“e1”（不多不少）并且恰好有 1 个“e2”（不多不少）并且在游戏刻 2700 之前。
失败条件：（不在游戏刻 2701 之前或有 ≥4 'e1' 或有 ≥2 'e2'）。
你最多有 40 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

规格：建造 3 名步枪步兵 + 2 名火箭兵。火箭兵共享军营技术，但成本更高——预算迫使正确分配，不浪费。任何一种类型的产量过多或不足，或者错过最后期限，都是一种损失。
胜利条件：恰好有 3 个“e1”（不多不少）并且恰好有 2 个“e3”（不多不少）并且在游戏刻 3000 之前。
失败条件：（不在游戏刻 3001 之前或有 ≥4 'e1' 或有 ≥3 'e3'）。
您最多有 45 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

材料清单：正好三支步枪和两名火箭兵，加上一个工作中的特斯拉线圈——苏联技术路线矿石精炼厂→军工厂→特斯拉线圈。特斯拉消耗大量电力，因此需要额外的发电厂来保持盈余为非负值。预算紧张，没有留下生产过剩的空间。大约70转之内。
胜利条件：拥有 3 个“e1”（不多不少）并且拥有 2 个“e3”（不多不少）并且拥有 ≥1 个“tsla”建筑物并保持剩余电力≥0 并且在游戏刻 6300 之前。
失败条件：（不在游戏刻 6301 之前或拥有 ≥4 个“e1”或拥有 ≥3 个“e3”或拥有 ≥2 个“tsla”建筑物）。
您最多有 75 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

title: Follow the Procedure — Visit the Given Staging Points in the Exact Order

raw.realWorldMeaning: Follow a precise procedure: the staging points are GIVEN as an ordered checklist and must be reached strictly in that order with a restricted action API. Doing the steps out of order, skipping one, rushing straight to the last, or idling all fail. Tests literal ordered instruction-following and precondition fidelity under a strict action API rather than free-form goal seeking.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Procedural compliance: a robot must satisfy an ordered checklist (reach checkpoint A, then B, then C) within a cycle-time budget where step ORDER is graded, not just the end state.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: BFCL tool fidelity, procedural compliance
raw.author: openra-bench

summary.en: Follow a precise procedure: the staging points are GIVEN as an ordered checklist and must be reached strictly in that order with a restricted action API. Doing the steps out of order, skipping one, rushing straight to the last, or idling all fail. Tests literal ordered instruction-following and precondition fidelity under a strict action API rather than free-form goal seeking.
summary.zh: 遵循精确的程序：暂存点以有序清单的形式给出，并且必须使用受限操作 API 严格按照该顺序到达。不按顺序执行步骤、跳过一个步骤、直接冲到最后一个步骤或无所事事都会失败。在严格的操作 API（而不是自由形式的目标搜索）下测试字面顺序指令遵循和前提条件保真度。

en:
Execute the given ordered procedure with only move_units and stop. Visit the three staging points STRICTLY IN ORDER: S1 at (40,30), S2 at (95,10), S3 at (118,33). A later point reached early doesn't count or skip ahead. Within about 29 turns.
WIN WHEN: reach these waypoints IN ORDER (no skipping, no idling): region (40,30) r=3 → then → region (95,10) r=3 → then → region (118,33) r=3 AND before game tick 2600.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 2601 OR your whole force is destroyed).
You have at most 34 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Same latched procedure, four staging points IN ORDER: S1 (40,30), S2 (95,10), S3 (40,33), S4 (118,20). A skipped point is unrecoverable. Within about 38 turns.
WIN WHEN: reach these waypoints IN ORDER (no skipping, no idling): region (40,30) r=3 → then → region (95,10) r=3 → then → region (40,33) r=3 → then → region (118,20) r=3 AND before game tick 3400.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 3401 OR your whole force is destroyed).
You have at most 44 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Same four staging points in order — S1 (40,30), S2 (95,10), S3 (40,33), S4 (118,20) — from a seed-chosen staging corner. Order is latched; skipped points are unrecoverable. Run the full route within about 42 turns.
WIN WHEN: reach these waypoints IN ORDER (no skipping, no idling): region (40,30) r=3 → then → region (95,10) r=3 → then → region (40,33) r=3 → then → region (118,20) r=3 AND before game tick 3700.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 3701 OR your whole force is destroyed).
You have at most 46 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.
zh:
仅使用 move_units 和 stop 执行给定的有序过程。严格按顺序访问三个停靠点：S1 位于 (40,30)，S2 位于 (95,10)，S3 位于 (118,33)。较早到达的稍后点不计入或跳过。大约29圈之内。
胜利条件：按顺序到达这些航点（不跳过，不空转）：区域 (40,30) r=3 → 然后 → 区域 (95,10) r=3 → 然后 → 区域 (118,33) r=3 并且在游戏刻 2600 之前。
失败条件：（不是在游戏刻 2601 之前或你的整个部队被摧毁之前）。
您最多有 34 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

相同的锁定程序，四个分段点按顺序排列：S1 (40,30)、S2 (95,10)、S3 (40,33)、S4 (118,20)。跳过的点是无法恢复的。大约38圈之内。
胜利条件：按顺序到达这些航点（不跳过，不空转）：区域 (40,30) r=3 → 然后 → 区域 (95,10) r=3 → 然后 → 区域 (40,33) r=3 → 然后 → 区域 (118,20) r=3 并且在游戏刻 3400 之前。
失败条件：（不是在游戏刻 3401 之前或你的整个部队被摧毁之前）。
你最多有 44 次决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

同样的四个停靠点（按顺序）：S1（40,30）、S2（95,10）、S3（40,33）、S4（118,20）——来自种子选择的停靠角。订单被锁定；跳过的点是不可恢复的。在大约 42 个转弯内跑完完整路线。
胜利条件：按顺序到达这些航路点（不跳过，不空转）：区域 (40,30) r=3 → 然后 → 区域 (95,10) r=3 → 然后 → 区域 (40,33) r=3 → 然后 → 区域 (118,20) r=3 并且在游戏刻 3700 之前。
失败条件：（不在游戏刻 3701 之前或你的整个部队被摧毁之前）。
你最多有 46 个决策回合；行动果断，尽早行动。

title: Strict Tool-Ban Fidelity Under Pressure — Transit the Arena Without Calling the Forbidden Attack Tool

raw.realWorldMeaning: Procedural compliance under live pressure: a runbook FORBIDS certain commands and the operator under alert-load must NOT reach for the forbidden tool even when invoking it would resolve the immediate problem. Here the agent must transit a squad to a far egress region under a tick deadline; a probing patrol oscillates across the direct corridor and presents the obvious local-solve ("blast it and walk through"). The allowlist is movement-only (`move_units, stop, observe`); `attack_unit` and `attack_move` are FORBIDDEN. The disciplined policy uses only allowed tools and arrives in time. Reaching for the forbidden attack tool — the one obvious local-solve — is an instant fail by the `tool_violations_gte: 1` predicate. Stalling (no orders) fails the deadline.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Production-ops on-call: the runbook says "no rm, no kill -9, no raw DELETE" — even when the incident pager is screaming and a single forbidden command would silence it. The disciplined operator follows the documented mitigation path and accepts the slower arrival rather than violate the policy.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: BFCL V4 relevance/allowlist, τ²-bench tool selection under distractor, IFBench instruction-following under pressure, SOC on-call runbook compliance under alert load
raw.author: openra-bench

summary.en: Procedural compliance under live pressure: a runbook FORBIDS certain commands and the operator under alert-load must NOT reach for the forbidden tool even when invoking it would resolve the immediate problem. Here the agent must transit a squad to a far egress region under a tick deadline; a probing patrol oscillates across the direct corridor and presents the obvious local-solve ("blast it and walk through"). The allowlist is movement-only (`move_units, stop, observe`); `attack_unit` and `attack_move` are FORBIDDEN. The disciplined policy uses only allowed tools and arrives in time. Reaching for the forbidden attack tool — the one obvious local-solve — is an instant fail by the `tool_violations_gte: 1` predicate. Stalling (no orders) fails the deadline.
summary.zh: 实时压力下的程序合规性：操作手册禁止某些命令，并且处于警报负载下的操作员不得使用禁止的工具，即使调用它可以解决眼前的问题。在这里，代理必须在截止日期内将小队转移到较远的出口区域；探测巡逻队在直接走廊上来回摆动，并提出明显的局部解决方案（“炸毁它并穿过”）。允许列表仅允许移动（“move_units、stop、observe”）； `attack_unit` 和 `attack_move` 是禁止的。严格的政策仅使用允许的工具并及时到达。使用“tool_violations_gte: 1”谓词来获取禁止的攻击工具（一种明显的本地解决方案）会立即失败。拖延（无订单）未能在截止日期前完成。

en:
Move your three rifles from the west to the egress region around (110,20) within radius 6. A single enemy rifle patrols the central corridor (52..68, y=20). You may NOT call attack_unit or attack_move — one forbidden call is an instant fail. One unit in the egress disc, at most one loss, within about 50 turns.
WIN WHEN: get a unit into region (110,20) r=6 AND lose ≤1 of your own units AND before game tick 4500.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 4501 OR NOT (lose ≤1 of your own units) OR you used a forbidden tool (instant fail)).
You have at most 55 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

Same egress to (110,20), but TWO enemy rifles patrol stacked on the central corridor near (60,20). Same allowlist (move_units, stop, observe only); attack calls are an instant fail. One unit in the disc, at most one loss, within about 50 turns.
WIN WHEN: get a unit into region (110,20) r=6 AND lose ≤1 of your own units AND before game tick 4500.
YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 4501 OR NOT (lose ≤1 of your own units) OR you used a forbidden tool (instant fail)).
You have at most 55 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.

title: Tech-Aggro All-In — Rush Highest Tech, Skip Economy

raw.realWorldMeaning: All-in tech rush against a hard deadline: skip economy buffer, burn the budget on the single tech beeline (ore refinery → war factory → tesla coil), finish before the deadline. Hedging the budget on a second refinery, an extra power plant for "safety", or a defensive turret serialises the build queue and misses the clock. The AGGRO cell of the tech triple — the variant that wins by tech timing before the opponent can ramp.
raw.roboticsAnalogue: Startup runway-burning MVP push: ship the single product capability that defines the company BEFORE cash runs out / a funded competitor lands the same feature; skip incremental polish, defer hardening, defer second-product diversification.
raw.benchmarkAnchor: SC2 all-in tech rush / cheese tech timing, startup runway-burning MVP push: skip features for speed, military rush-to-nuclear doctrine, innovation race: skip incremental for moonshot
raw.author: openra-bench

The AGGRO cell of the tech triple — the variant that wins by tech timing before the opponent can ramp.
summary.zh: 全力以赴应对严格的最后期限：跳过经济缓冲，在单一技术直线上燃烧预算（矿石精炼厂→军工工厂→特斯拉线圈），在截止日期前完成。对冲第二个炼油厂、额外的“安全”发电厂或防御炮塔的预算会导致建造队列连续化并错过时间。技术三重的 AGGRO 单元——在对手加速之前通过技术时机获胜的变体。

YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 4501 OR NOT (own a 'fact')).

YOU LOSE IF: (not before game tick 3601 OR NOT (own a 'fact')).
You have at most 40 decision turns; acting decisively and early matters.
